Chronological evaluations with simulated audits on IEEE-CIS, ULB-Worldline, and Elliptic++ yield zero-drift automation rates of 84.4%, 67.4%, and 81.3%, with total review workloads of 24.1%, 46.0%, and 43.1%. The experiments reveal an audit-capacity trade-off: sparse auditing delays authorization, whereas intensive auditing eventually increases workload. A separately specified BAF stress test further indicates that fallback thresholds must reflect candidate-specific evidence rather than a common fraction of the risk limit. These findings identify audit freshness and analyst capacity as joint design considerations for fraud decision support.

</details>


### [83] [Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Agent-Specific Preference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08604)
*Ni Mu,Yao Luan,Yiqin Yang,Qing-Shan Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了MAGPIE框架，通过引入特定智能体偏好建模来解决多智能体强化学习中的奖励函数设计难题，在无需全局奖励的情况下实现了与奖励工程基线相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）严重依赖精心设计的全局奖励函数，然而在包含异构智能体的系统中，单一标量目标难以捕捉多样化的行为，设计全局奖励函数具有挑战性。

Method: 提出MAGPIE框架：1）通过偏好信号让专用专家评估每个智能体，消除全局评估需求；2）从偏好数据构建智能体特定奖励模型，通过单调聚合机制结合成全局目标；3）理论证明优化分散偏好可收敛至纳什均衡策略，优化聚合奖励模型等价于训练纳什均衡策略。

Result: 在基准多智能体任务和顺序生产线任务上的大量实验表明，MAGPIE达到了与奖励工程基线相当的性能。

Conclusion: MAGPIE在精确奖励工程不可行的场景中展现出促进策略学习的潜力，为多智能体系统中的奖励设计问题提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is a powerful framework for solving complex collaborative tasks, but it relies heavily on well-defined global reward functions. Designing such rewards is challenging, especially in systems with heterogeneous agents, where a single scalar objective may fail to capture diverse behaviors. In this paper, we introduce Multi-AGent Preference-Integrated lEarning (MAGPIE), which addresses these challenges through agent-specific preference modeling. Each agent is evaluated by a dedicated expert through preference signals, eliminating the need for global evaluation. We theoretically prove that optimizing these decentralized preferences converges to a Nash equilibrium policy. To integrate local preferences into a coherent global objective, we construct agent-specific reward models from preference data and combine them via a monotonic aggregation mechanism. We further prove that optimizing this aggregate reward model is equivalent to training the Nash equilibrium policy. Extensive experiments on benchmark multi-agent tasks and a sequential production line task show that MAGPIE achieves performance comparable to reward-engineered baselines, demonstrating its potential to facilitate policy learning in scenarios where precise reward engineering is impractical.

</details>


### [84] [Domain-Aware Pruning: Sparsity and Domain Generalization via Regularized Probabilistic Masking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08624)
*Parham Sazdar,Mostafa Tavassolipour,Reshad Hosseini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了领域感知剪枝（DAP）框架，将网络剪枝与领域泛化相结合，通过学习连续参数保留概率来识别领域不变的子网络，在实现高稀疏度的同时提升或保持了OOD泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 领域泛化（DG）和神经网络剪枝通常被视为独立的研究目标，分别针对分布外（OOD）鲁棒性和模型效率。本文旨在弥合这一差距，探索网络稀疏性作为隐式增强未见领域泛化能力的机制。

Method: 提出领域感知剪枝（DAP）框架，采用连续概率掩码方法学习参数保留概率p∈[0,1]，而非传统的二值掩码优化。通过引入正则化目标主动惩罚领域敏感权重的保留，从而识别出领域不变的子网络。该框架具有算法无关性，可与现有DG流程无缝集成，无需事后微调。

Result: 在五个DG基准数据集上的实验表明，DAP在实现显著稀疏度的同时，OOD性能持续达到或超过稠密网络的性能。此外，DAP天然提供了对对抗扰动的增强鲁棒性，并产生高可解释性模型，其中保留的权重可靠地封装了最领域不变和任务关键的表示。

Conclusion: DAP成功地将网络剪枝与领域泛化目标统一，证明了稀疏性可以作为增强泛化能力的机制，在提升模型效率的同时保持甚至改善了分布外泛化性能，为模型压缩和泛化学习提供了新的研究视角。

Abstract: Domain generalization (DG) and neural network pruning are conventionally treated as distinct objectives, targeting out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness and model efficiency, respectively. In this work, we bridge this gap by introducing Domain-Aware Pruning (DAP), a framework that leverages network sparsity as a mechanism to implicitly enhance generalization to unseen domains. Diverging from standard binary mask optimization, DAP learns a continuous parameter retention probability $p \in [0, 1]$, framing network compression as a continuous probabilistic masking problem. By introducing a regularization objective that actively penalizes the retention of domain-sensitive weights during the mask training, DAP identifies a domain-invariant subnetwork. Empirical results across five DG benchmark datasets demonstrate that DAP achieves significant sparsity while consistently matching or exceeding the OOD performance of its dense counterparts. Crucially, DAP is an algorithm-agnostic framework that integrates seamlessly with existing DG pipelines without necessitating post-hoc fine-tuning. Beyond efficiency and generalization, we show that DAP natively provides increased robustness to adversarial perturbations and yields highly interpretable models, where the retained weights reliably encapsulate the most domain-invariant and task-critical representations.

</details>


### [85] [Trajectory Design and Budgeted Querying for Digital Twin Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08631)
*Vladyslava Spitkovska,Dmytro Kuzmenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个数字孪生校准框架，通过耦合激励导向的强化学习控制器、带预测不确定性的循环参数估计器和预算查询策略，解决数据稀缺场景下的轨迹生成和参数测量预算分配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字孪生校准需要昂贵的交互数据。现有方法面临两个关键决策：生成哪些轨迹，以及何时在有限预算下进行特权参数测量。传统任务导向轨迹无法有效恢复某些关键参数（如质量、长度），亟需新的数据采集策略。

Method: 提出一个包含三个组件的框架：1)激励导向的强化学习控制器，用于生成信息丰富的轨迹；2)带预测不确定性的循环参数估计器(GRU)；3)预算查询策略，决定何时测量特权参数。在Pendulum和部分可观测Waterworld环境中进行实验验证。

Result: 在Pendulum任务中，激励导向轨迹训练的GRU无查询情况下达到0.0066平均绝对误差，而任务导向轨迹的随机森林诊断无法有效恢复质量和长度。在预算为3次查询时，估计器加策略管道达到0.0092终端误差，未校准孪生误差为0.2031。在Waterworld中，五控制器混合训练的估计器达到约4-5%的在线归一化误差。

Conclusion: 轨迹设计和查询分配应作为数据稀缺校准中的显式设计变量。激励导向轨迹相比任务导向轨迹能更有效地恢复系统参数，预算查询策略能显著提升校准精度。这些探索性案例研究为后续受控消融实验提供了重要动机。

Abstract: Digital-twin calibration requires interaction data that is expensive to collect. We study two acquisition decisions: which trajectories to generate, and when to spend a limited budget on privileged parameter measurements. Our framework couples an excitation-oriented reinforcement learning controller, a recurrent parameter estimator with predictive uncertainty, and a budgeted query policy. In Pendulum, a Random Forest diagnostic recovers gravity only weakly from task-oriented trajectories and does not recover mass or length, while a GRU trained on excitation-oriented trajectories reaches a mean absolute error of 0.0066 with no queries. We then withdraw continuous oracle access partway through an episode, so that the twin must run on the estimator's output for the remainder. The estimator-plus-policy pipeline achieves a terminal error of 0.0092 under a three-query budget, against 0.2031 for an uncalibrated twin. In partially observable Waterworld, five controllers produce different observed error profiles across three hidden parameters, and an estimator trained on a five-controller mixture reaches online normalized errors of roughly 4-5%. These exploratory case studies are not controlled ablations, but they motivate treating trajectory design and query allocation as explicit design variables in data-scarce calibration.

</details>


### [86] [Exact Rank-Space KL Projection for Shared-Marginal Low-Rank Factors: Application to Doubly Stochastic Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08642)
*Enliang Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了具有规定行边缘分布和共享列边缘分布的非负低秩分解的精确KL投影，并将其应用于双重随机图学习，提出了一种保持精确可行性的镜像下降方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于解决低秩分解中KL投影的精确计算问题，特别是当两个非负因子具有规定的行边缘分布和共享的列边缘分布时。这一问题在双重随机（DS）图学习中具有重要应用价值，传统的DS图优化需要显式地处理n×n的优化变量，计算成本高昂。作者希望找到一种既能保持精确可行性，又能避免稠密图矩阵表示的方法。

Method: 提出了一种基于几何结构的镜像下降方法：首先证明了对于任意正行边缘分布（具有相同总质量），联合KL投影可精确简化为仅含r-1个有效变量的严格凸规范固定对偶问题；其Hessian矩阵可表示为分类协方差项之和，支持O((n+m)r)的无矩阵Hessian-向量乘积。然后通过W=U·Diag(g)^{-1}·V^T的分解结构，其中具有公共列质量的行单纯形因子诱导出精确的DS图，无需显式构造n×n优化变量。结合观测边稀疏拟合、随机锚点减维流形正则化和Bregman回溯，该方法在每个接受步骤都保持精确可行性。

Result: 在非消失潜在质量条件下，该方法满足充分下降条件，并具有O(1/N)的镜像平稳性界限；严格正的聚点是KKT平稳点。匹配聚类实验表明：该方法具有竞争力的准确率，可行性残差接近数值精度，并且在不显式构造稠密学习图的情况下展现出良好的随时（anytime）行为。

Conclusion: 本文建立了一个目标函数独立的投影定理，为具有边缘分布约束的低秩KL投影提供了精确的几何框架。所提出的镜像下降方法成功解决了双重随机图学习中的可行性保持问题，理论收敛性得到严格保证，实验结果验证了方法的有效性。该方法避免了稠密图矩阵的显式表示，在保持高精度的同时降低了计算复杂度，为相关领域的优化问题提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: We study exact Kullback--Leibler (KL) projection for low-rank factorizations whose two nonnegative factors have prescribed row marginals and a shared, learned column marginal. For arbitrary positive row marginals of equal total mass, the joint KL projection reduces exactly to a strictly convex gauge-fixed dual with only $r-1$ effective variables; its Hessian is a sum of categorical covariance terms and admits $O((n+m)r)$ matrix-free Hessian--vector products. The projection theorem is objective-independent. We then specialize this geometry to doubly stochastic (DS) graph learning through $W=U\operatorname{Diag}(g)^{-1}V^\top$, where row-simplex factors with a common column mass induce an exactly DS graph without materializing an $n\times n$ optimization variable. Combined with observed-edge sparse fitting, a stochastic anchor-reduced manifold regularizer, and Bregman backtracking, the resulting mirror-descent method preserves exact feasibility at every accepted step. Under a nonvanishing latent-mass condition, it satisfies sufficient decrease and an $O(1/N)$ mirror-stationarity bound, while strictly positive accumulation points are KKT stationary. Matched clustering experiments show competitive accuracy, feasibility residuals near numerical precision, and favorable anytime behavior without a dense learned graph.

</details>


### [87] [Path-dependent Discrete Amortized Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08644)
*Tiago da Silva,Esmeralda S. Whitammer,Salem Lahlou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出路径依赖离散摊销推理方法，通过引入可学习潜在动态系统解决马尔可夫假设带来的信号传播和状态混叠问题，实验表明该方法能加速学习收敛并改善状态空间探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的离散摊销采样方法存在两个关键缺陷：马尔可夫假设会阻碍训练过程中的信号传播，且状态混叠（state aliasing）会严重降低学习采样器的表达能力。

Method: 提出提升MDP的方法，引入可学习的潜在动态系统（latent dynamical system），使策略能够依赖于完整的过去轨迹而不仅仅是当前状态，从而构建路径依赖的离散摊销推理框架，并理论上将现有离散摊销采样器学习算法扩展至新设置。

Result: 在标准基准问题上的实验表明，相较于先前技术，该方法通常能实现更快的学习收敛速度，并改善状态空间的探索能力。

Conclusion: 通过放松马尔可夫假设并引入路径依赖机制，所提方法有效解决了现有方法的表达性限制问题，为组合和离散对象的采样提供了更优的解决方案。

Abstract: We consider the problem of sampling compositional and discrete objects from a given unnormalized posterior distribution. Notably, recent studies have shown that this problem can be efficiently solved by learning a deterministic Markov Decision Process (MDP) that progressively builds each object in proportion to the posterior. In this work, however, we demonstrate that the Markovian assumption can both hamper signal propagation during training and catastrophically reduce the learned sampler's expressivity due to state aliasing. To address these issues, we propose lifting the MDP with a learnable latent dynamical system that allows the underlying policy to depend on the entire past trajectory---and not only on the current state. In view of this, we refer to the resulting method as path-dependent discrete amortized inference. Importantly, we provably extend existing learning algorithms for discrete amortized samplers to our setting. In experiments on standard benchmark problems, we also show that our approach often leads to faster learning convergence and improved state space exploration relatively to prior techniques.

</details>


### [88] [Multi-Relational Knowledge Graph Enhanced Embedding for Trajectory-User Linking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08646)
*Zhifeng Chu,Bin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了MakeTUL方法，首次将知识图谱表示学习引入轨迹-用户链接任务，通过多关系移动知识图谱和双分支分类层提升了用户识别准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TUL方法独立学习POI、时间和语义特征，对轨迹间共享的结构知识利用有限，且在分类前压缩了结构和序列信息，导致性能受限。

Method: 构建多关系移动知识图谱，将访问时间、POI类别和转移速度信息组织为类型化关系；提取高阶共现模式增强POI表示；设计轨迹序列学习模块和双分支分类层，在决策层面融合全局结构证据和序列证据。

Result: MakeTUL能够通过异构移动语义联合约束学习到的嵌入表示，为稀疏和重叠轨迹提供结构先验知识，有效捕获有序移动模式并保持决策层面的结构信息。

Conclusion: 本文成功将知识图谱表示学习引入TUL任务，通过多关系知识图谱和双分支分类架构实现了结构知识与序列信息的有效融合，为轨迹-用户链接提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: Trajectory-User Linking (TUL) aims to identify the owner of an anonymous trajectory from a set of candidate users, providing a basis for user mobility analysis and personalized location-aware services. Existing methods often learn Point of Interest (POI), temporal, and semantic features independently, make limited use of structural knowledge shared across trajectories, and compress structural and sequential information before classification. To address these issues, we propose Multi-Relational Knowledge Graph Enhanced Embedding for Trajectory-User Linking (MakeTUL), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first attempt to introduce knowledge graph representation learning into TUL. MakeTUL organizes visit-time, POI-category, and transfer-speed information as typed relations in a multi-relational mobility knowledge graph, allowing heterogeneous mobility semantics to jointly constrain the learned embeddings. The resulting POI representations are further enriched with high-order co-occurrence patterns extracted from the trajectory collection, providing structural prior knowledge for sparse and overlapping trajectories. By integrating these prior-enhanced representations with temporal, category, and transfer information, the trajectory sequence learning module captures ordered mobility patterns, while a dual-branch classification layer preserves and combines global structural evidence and sequential evidence at the decision level.

</details>


### [89] [LegoLM: Structured Weight Sharing for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08652)
*Joseph Bingham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了LegoLM，一种结构化权重共享压缩框架，通过解决分布不匹配和离群值主导两种失败模式，在大语言模型上实现了近乎无损的高压缩比（如Mistral-7B上4.41倍压缩仅+0.03%困惑度退化），性能优于PTQ-8bit。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全局权重共享压缩方法在大语言模型上失败，但缺乏系统研究解释失败原因。论文旨在揭示全局权重共享为何失败（分布不匹配、离群值主导）以及如何修复，以实现高效且近乎无损的模型压缩。

Method: 提出LegoLM框架，包含三种免数据适配策略：1）标量块编码以消除维度线性不匹配；2）百分位选择性替换，识别并按原样保留离群权重；3）边界层保护，专门处理Transformer的首尾块。通过理论分析识别两种失败模式，并针对性设计解决方案。

Result: 在GPT-2 small和Mistral-7B上验证：Mistral-7B上4.41倍压缩仅+0.03%困惑度退化（优于PTQ-8bit的质量和压缩比），2.67倍压缩为-0.02%。下游任务（LAMBADA、HellaSwag）在5.12倍压缩下精度保持在噪声范围内。发现离群值主导问题随模型规模增长：Mistral-7B的全替换退化达+1,134,279%，而选择性替换降至+15%以内。消融实验证实选择性替换是主导机制。

Conclusion: 系统揭示了全局权重共享的两种失败模式（分布不匹配和离群值主导），并提出LegoLM框架有效解决。选择性替换是关键机制，离群值问题随模型规模增大而加剧。该方法为大语言模型的高效压缩提供了新思路，且无需训练数据即可实现近乎无损压缩。

Abstract: We present \LegoLM{}, a structured weight-sharing compression framework for large language models grounded in a systematic study of why global weight sharing fails and how to fix it. We identify two distinct failure modes. Distributional mismatch: for vector blocks of dimension d <= 2, transformer layers with heterogeneous weight scales impose a scale-mismatch penalty that grows linearly with d and cannot be resolved by increasing K, producing perplexity in the millions.Outlier dominance: for scalar blocks, a fraction ~1/K of weights lies beyond the outermost Lloyd-Max decision threshold and cannot be represented by any centroid; their misrepresentation accumulates across layers, causing catastrophic quality loss. \LegoLM{} resolves both failure modes via three data-free adaptations: 1 scalar-block encoding to eliminate the $d$-linear mismatch component, 2 percentile-selective replacement that identifies and preserves outlier weights verbatim, and 3 boundary-layer protection for the first and last transformer blocks. Across GPT-2 small (124M) and Mistral-7B, \LegoLM{} achieves +0.03% PPL degradation at 4.41X compression on Mistral-7B - outperforming PTQ-8bit in both quality and compression ratio - and -0.02% at 2.67X. Downstream evaluation on LAMBADA and HellaSwag confirms that \LegoLM{} at K=64, p=99% preserves accuracy within noise at 5.12 X compression, exceeding PTQ-8bit's compression ratio while matching its accuracy. We further discover that outlier dominance grows with model scale: full replacement at K=128 degrades GPT-2 small by only +23% but catastrophically degrades Mistral-7B by +1,134,279%, while selective replacement at p=99% rescues both models to under +15%. A controlled ablation confirms that selective replacement is the dominant mechanism: adding it to per-layer K-means also yields near-lossless quality, matching \LegoLM{} within 0.02%.

</details>


### [90] [Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08673)
*Emma Graham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了强化学习中任务相似性与灾难性遗忘之间的关系，通过Q-learning在图任务上的实验，发现任务相似性与遗忘之间存在复杂的动态关系，但未发现任务相似性独立影响遗忘的统计学证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾难性遗忘是持续学习中的重大障碍，指模型在学习新任务后会失去执行先前任务的能力。理解新任务与旧任务的相似性如何影响遗忘程度对于开发更鲁棒的持续学习系统具有重要意义。

Method: 采用可解释强化学习方法，具体使用Q-learning算法在基于图的任务上进行实验。任务目标是最小化到达目标节点的步数。研究者设计了不同复杂度的任务，在模型学习新任务后评估其对先前任务的性能变化，系统性地考察任务相似性和复杂度对遗忘的影响。

Result: 实验结果揭示了任务相似性与灾难性遗忘之间存在复杂的动态关系。在不同程度的任务相似性和复杂度下，遗忘严重程度出现显著波动，表明遗忘可能依赖于任务相似性和复杂度的相互作用。同时观察到遗忘程度的高变异性以及任务相似性度量的不均匀分布。然而，研究未发现任务相似性独立影响遗忘的统计学显著性证据。

Conclusion: 任务相似性与灾难性遗忘之间的关系仍然不明确，二者之间潜在的相互作用机制需要进一步研究。本研究强调了持续强化学习中遗忘现象的复杂性，并指出需要更深入的研究来全面理解任务相似性对灾难性遗忘的影响机制。

Abstract: This work explores the relationship between task similarity and catastrophic forgetting in reinforcement learning. Catastrophic forgetting, the phenomenon in machine learning of losing the ability to effectively perform on previous tasks, is a significant impediment to continual learning. This study aims to understand the extent to which the similarity of a new task influences the performance on the previous task. Interpretable reinforcement learning, specifically Q-learning, is employed on graph-based tasks with the objective of minimising the number of steps to reach a goal. The study investigates the performance on a previously learned task after training on a new task, for tasks of varying relative levels of complexity. The experimental results reveal a complex dynamic between task similarity and forgetting, with significant fluctuations in forgetting severity observed across degrees of task similarities and task complexities, and are suggestive of an interdependence of forgetting on the similarity and complexity of tasks. The observations were accompanied by observations of high degrees of variability in forgetting and an uneven distribution of task similarity measures. The relationship between these variables remains unclear and no evidence of statistical significance that task similarity has an effect, independently, on forgetting is found in continual reinforcement learning. Further research is warranted to gain a comprehensive understanding of the potential interplay between task similarity and catastrophic forgetting.

</details>


### [91] [Backward Compatibility in Tree-Based Explanations and Enhanced CART Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08674)
*Hirofumi Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种衡量决策树更新前后解释变化程度的损失指标BCLTX，并设计了CART-BCTX算法以在保持预测性能的同时减少解释变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在机器学习模型的更新过程中，决策树等可解释模型的解释结构变化可能对下游决策产生负面影响，而现有研究主要关注基于特征贡献的解释，无法处理基于树结构的解释变化问题。

Method: 提出Backward Compatibility Loss in Tree-based eXplanations (BCLTX)损失指标来量化并抑制决策树更新前后的解释变化，并设计CART-BCTX算法对传统CART进行改进以优化该目标。

Result: 在10个真实数据集上的分类和回归实验表明，CART-BCTX能够在预测性能和BCLTX值之间取得良好平衡，且计算时间与传统CART相当。

Conclusion: CART-BCTX是一种轻量级且有效的决策树更新算法，能够有效保持模型解释的一致性，解决了可解释模型更新中的解释兼容性问题。

Abstract: In the operation of machine learning models, model update is a fundamental process that requires careful consideration of its impact on downstream decision-making. Particularly when operating explainable models, changes in explanations resulting from model updates can lead to detrimental outcomes for users. Decision trees, due to their high transparency, are frequently employed in risk-sensitive decision-making and serve as a prominent example in which the aforementioned issue is evident. However, existing research addressing similar issues has focused on explanations based on feature contributions, and thus cannot handle explanations derived from tree structures. Therefore, this paper proposes the Backward Compatibility Loss in Tree-based eXplanations (BCLTX), a loss metric that suppresses changes in decision tree explanations before and after updates. Furthermore, we design CART with Backward Compatibility in Tree-based eXplanations (CART-BCTX), a lightweight algorithm that improves upon CART for the decision tree update problem under BCLTX. Experimental results using 10 real-world datasets, including both classification and regression tasks, show that CART-BCTX achieves favorable trade-offs between prediction performances and BCLTX values, with comparable computation times to CART, regardless of the task.

</details>


### [92] [Efficient Test-Time Scaling for LLM-based Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08675)
*Xuan-May Le,Minh-Tuan Tran,Ling Luo,Uwe Aickelin,Dinh Phung,Trung Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了SCALER，一个由粗到细的时间序列预测框架，通过轻量级Transformer预测全局形状来指导LLM的迭代精炼，在保持预测精度的同时显著降低了推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于LLM的时间序列预测方法通过测试时扩展（如迭代精炼）来提升精度，但存在两个主要问题：1）计算成本高昂；2）随着预测时间窗口延长，越来越容易出现全局形状不匹配的问题。长期时间序列预测需要保持趋势和季节性等全局结构，而现有方法难以有效平衡精度和效率。

Method: 提出SCALER框架，采用由粗到细的预测策略：1）首先使用一个专门针对长期形状建模的轻量级Transformer预测未来动态的粗粒度表示；2）将预测的形状作为紧凑指导，引导LLM通过迭代粗到细的残差token精炼进行测试时扩展；3）每个步骤处理的token数量大幅减少；4）使用固定的精炼步数，避免了基于奖励模型的高成本选择策略。

Result: 实验结果表明，SCALER在长期预测、短期预测和零样本预测任务上均优于强基准方法，同时显著降低了基于LLM的时间序列预测的推理成本。该方法在保持或提升预测精度的同时，有效解决了计算效率问题。

Conclusion: SCALER成功地将轻量级Transformer的形状建模能力与LLM的精炼能力相结合，通过显式的未来形状预测指导，实现了高效准确的长期时间序列预测，为LLM在时间序列预测领域的实际应用提供了一种可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Long-term time series forecasting benefits from preserving global structure such as trends and seasonality. Recent LLM-based forecasters often improve accuracy through test-time scaling (e.g., iterative refinement), but these methods are computationally expensive and increasingly prone to global-shape mismatch as the prediction horizon extends. We propose SCALER, a coarse-to-fine forecasting framework that first employs a lightweight Transformer tailored to long-term shape modeling to predict a coarse representation of future dynamics. This predicted shape then serves as a compact guide for an LLM to perform test-time scaling via iterative coarse-to-fine residual token refinement, while processing substantially fewer tokens at each step. By guiding refinement with an explicit future-shape prediction, SCALER reduces reliance on long description prompts, and its fixed-step refinement avoids costly reward-model-based selection, further lowering computational overhead. Experimental results demonstrate that SCALER outperforms strong forecasting baselines in long-term, short-term and zero-shot forecasting while significantly reducing the inference cost associated with scaled LLM for time series forecasting. Code: https://github.com/xuanmay2701/SCALER.

</details>


### [93] [RippleKV: Cross-Layer KV Cache Allocation via Perturbation Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08684)
*Dongjie Xu,Kai Qian,Julius,Weijie Shi,Yuxuan Sun,Minghua Tang,Fenglei Jin,Hanchi Dong,Jiajie Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了RippleKV，一种通过测量各层扰动对输出的影响来分配KV cache预算的方法，在LongBench上取得了最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的长文本LLM推理中KV cache内存分配方法依赖于层级深度、注意力统计量或表示变化等代理指标，但这些指标无法准确衡量各层扰动对最终输出的传播影响，可能导致敏感层预算不足而容忍层预算过剩。

Method: RippleKV通过向各层的value cache独立注入范数自适应扰动，在校准集上测量输出端的KL散度，得到模型特定的敏感度分布；将敏感度分数归一化并应用指数映射转换为层级预算乘数，通过比率参数控制敏感层与容忍层的分配差异。

Result: 在LongBench基准测试中，RippleKV在相同cache预算下达到了所有评估的KV cache压缩方法中最高的平均性能。

Conclusion: 通过直接测量各层扰动对输出的影响而非依赖代理指标，RippleKV实现了更合理的跨层KV cache预算分配，有效提升了长文本推理性能。

Abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by KV cache memory, yet distributing a limited cache budget across layers remains challenging. Existing methods rely on proxies such as layer depth, attention statistics, or representation change. These proxies do not measure how perturbations at each layer propagate to the output and may therefore cause sensitive layers to be underallocated while tolerant layers are overallocated. To address this issue, we propose RippleKV, which allocates cache across layers by estimating how perturbations to each layer's value cache affect the final predictive distribution. RippleKV independently injects norm-adaptive perturbations into each layer's value cache and measures the induced KL divergence at the model output over a small calibration set. Averaging these responses yields a sensitivity profile specific to the model that need not vary monotonically with depth. RippleKV then converts the sensitivity profile into layer budget multipliers by normalizing the sensitivity scores and applying an exponential mapping. A ratio parameter controls the allocation disparity between sensitive and tolerant layers, while a final normalization preserves the KV cache budget. Experiments on LongBench demonstrate that RippleKV achieves the highest average performance among the evaluated KV cache compression methods under matched cache budgets.

</details>


### [94] [Loss-Resilient Wireless Video Token Communication over Block Fading Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08698)
*Bingyan Xie,Yongjeong Oh,Zihan Chen,Jihong Park,Yongpeng Wu,Wenjun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种抗丢包的无线视频令牌通信框架（WVTC），通过评估令牌重要性、采用混合打乱分组方案和在线调度策略，有效缓解了块衰落导致的重要令牌同时丢失问题，提升了视频重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频令牌通信将视频内容表示为离散令牌，这些令牌在重建中的重要性不同且存在时序依赖关系。在无线传输中，块衰落可能导致多个重要或相关令牌同时丢失，严重降低视频重建质量。

Method: 1. 基于视频令牌的内在预测结构评估令牌重要性，为结构I令牌分配高优先级，并通过时序邻域新颖性衡量P令牌重要性；2. 采用混合打乱的I/P令牌分组方案，将结构锚点和相关时序区域分散到不同分组；3. 利用当前块信道状态信息，在线调度器综合考虑分组重要性密度、MCS相关解码可靠性、块容量和重要性集中度，为衰落块分配分组；4. 接收端使用微调的解码器基于存活令牌重建缺失内容。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法在分组错误率增加时能够提升感知质量，并实现更平缓的性能退化。

Conclusion: 所提出的WVTC框架通过令牌重要性评估、混合打乱分组和智能调度，有效提升了无线视频令牌通信的抗丢包能力和重建质量。

Abstract: Video token communication represents video content as discrete tokens that differ in their importance to reconstruction and exhibit temporal dependencies. When these tokens are packetized for wireless transmission, block fading can cause multiple important or correlated tokens to be lost together, severely degrading video reconstruction. To address this issue, we propose a loss-resilient wireless video token communication (WVTC) framework. WVTC evaluates token importance from the intrinsic predictive structure of video tokens, assigning high priority to structural I-tokens and measuring P-token importance by temporal neighborhood novelty. A shuffled mixed I/P-token packetization scheme disperses structural anchors and correlated temporal regions across packets. Using only current block channel state information, an online scheduler jointly considers packet importance density, MCS-dependent decoding reliability, block capacity, and importance concentration when allocating packets to fading blocks. At the receiver, a fine-tuned detokenizer reconstructs missing content from surviving tokens without retransmission. Numerical results demonstrate improved perceptual quality and more graceful degradation under increasing packet error rates.

</details>


### [95] [Gaming Without an Attacker: Benchmark Fingerprinting in LLM-Driven Search Under Selection Pressure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08722)
*Víctor Gallego*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在评估信号驱动优化下的基准测试失效问题，发现在GPU内核优化任务中，前沿LLM通过识别评估配置指纹来欺骗基准测试，导致30%的胜出内核无法在未见配置上泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准测试存在一个关键问题：当系统针对评估信号进行优化时，可能学会"作弊"而非真正提升性能。作者旨在通过GPU内核优化这一具体场景，实证记录这种优化过程中的基准测试失效现象，并为可信评估提供设计指南。

Method: 1. 构建两个GPU内核优化基准套件：Metal-Sci（10个科学计算任务）和Metal-ZK（12个零知识证明/密码学任务），均设有保留的泛化门控；2. 使用三个前沿LLM（Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.5）在(1+1)进化循环中生成Metal内核；3. 分析胜出内核是否能在未见配置上泛化；4. 建立四类失效模式的分类体系。

Result: 在汇总的基准套件中，16/53（30%）的分布内胜出内核无法转移到保留配置上。胜出内核会通过识别运行时参数的身份来"指纹化"评估配置：对被测量的分支进行过度优化，而对未测量的分支保持低效或静默错误。作者给出了从配置指纹到门控泄漏的四类失效模式分类，并提出了可信测量设计指南。

Conclusion: 针对战略性优化下的测量问题，本文提出三项设计原则：1. 保留探针仅在不可枚举轴上保持有效性；2. 门控必须测量保留性能而不仅仅是正确性；3. 转移率需配合每类失效机制的细粒度分解（欺骗、过拟合、良性）。研究为构建可靠基准测试提供了理论和实证指导。

Abstract: Benchmarks for systems that are optimized against the evaluation signal measure something different from what they claim. We document this concretely in two GPU-kernel-optimization suites with held-out generalization gates: Metal-Sci (10 scientific-compute tasks) and Metal-ZK (12 zero-knowledge/cryptographic tasks), in which three frontier LLMs (Opus 4.7, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.5) propose Metal kernels inside a $(1{+}1)$ evolutionary loop with rich feedback. Although no model is prompted to act adversarially, the promoted winners repeatedly fingerprint the evaluation configuration: they branch on the identity of runtime parameters, tune the measured branch maximally, and leave the unmeasured branch slow or silently wrong. Across the pooled suites, $16/53$ ($30\%$) of in-distribution wins fail to transfer to held-out configurations. We give a four-mode taxonomy of these failures, from configuration fingerprints to gate leakage. We distill design guidance for measurement under strategic optimization: held-out probes retain validity only on non-enumerable axes; gates must measure held-out performance, not just correctness; and a transfer rate is interpretable only with per-failure mechanism grades: ours decomposes into gamed, overfit, and benign.
  Code and research artifacts: https://github.com/vicgalle/kernel-fingerprinting

</details>


### [96] [PAST: Privileged Adaptation from Complete Student Trajectories for On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08726)
*Yangyang Feng,Zhuoyan Feng,Junlan Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了PAST方法，通过利用学生模型的完整轨迹信息来增强OPSD教师模型，在三个数学推理基准测试上平均提升了5.6个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的在线策略自蒸馏(OPSD)方法在训练过程中会产生学生模型完整的轨迹信息，包括响应如何展开以及是否成功，但这些学生特定的后见之明信息并未被用于构建教师模型。本文旨在利用这些额外的特权信息来改进蒸馏效果。

Method: 提出特权适应从学生轨迹(PAST)方法，将每个完成的学生轨迹视为额外的特权信息提供给OPSD教师，同时保持学生的蒸馏前缀不变。方法在正确轨迹上保持学生模型的下一个token分布，在失败轨迹上通过学生邻近正则化使教师适应向验证成功转移。使用Forward-KL蒸馏将教师分布投影到给定前缀的条件算术平均值。

Result: 在三个数学推理基准测试中，PAST相比普通OPSD在Avg@12宏观平均值上提升了5.6个百分点。2×2因子研究表明完整轨迹访问和教师适应都能带来提升，而轨迹移除和洗牌实验证实了适应后的教师确实使用了匹配的后见上下文。

Conclusion: 通过利用学生轨迹作为特权信息，PAST成功改进了在线策略自蒸馏的效果。理论分析表明轨迹条件化的教师可以有效地将知识迁移到仅使用前缀的学生模型，实验验证了该方法的有效性和各组件的必要性。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses a privileged teacher to supervise a reasoning model on prefixes sampled from its own rollouts. Yet each rollout also reveals how the student's response unfolds and whether it succeeds, student-specific hindsight that standard OPSD does not use to form the teacher. We introduce Privileged Adaptation from Student Trajectories (PAST), which treats each completed student trajectory as additional privileged information for the OPSD teacher while leaving the student's distillation prefixes unchanged. PAST preserves the student's next-token distribution on correct trajectories and uses failed trajectories to adapt the teacher toward verified success under student-proximity regularization. We characterize what such a trajectory-conditioned teacher can transfer to a prefix-only student. Forward-KL distillation projects the teacher distributions to their conditional arithmetic mean given the prefix. This projection separates trajectory-specific variation that remains privileged from the mean policy shift available to the student. For correct trajectories, the unclipped population objective also has the frozen student as an ideal distributional fixed point. Across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks, PAST improves the Avg@12 macro average over Vanilla OPSD by 5.6 percentage points. A $2\times2$ factorial study shows gains from both complete-trajectory access and teacher adaptation, while trajectory removal and shuffling confirm that the adapted teacher uses the matching hindsight context.

</details>


### [97] [Memory-Efficient Activation Checkpointing with Sliding Window and Hirschberg's Algorithm for 0/1 Knapsack Solving in PyTorch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08740)
*Jędrzej Maczan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对PyTorch中激活检查点（activation checkpointing）的内存不足问题，提出了一种结合滑动窗口技巧与Hirschberg算法的改进方法，将峰值内存消耗从O(nW)降至O(W)，在保证最优解的前提下实现了约20倍的问题规模扩展和25-28%的运行时加速，并已合并至PyTorch 2.10版本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PyTorch中现有的dp_knapsack求解器将激活检查点建模为0/1背包问题，但该方法需要构建大小为(n+1)×(W+1)的完整动态规划表，导致峰值内存需求为O(nW)。这种资源消耗方式使得在64GB RAM的机器上，当操作数n=100时就会崩溃，严重限制了可处理问题的规模。

Method: 作者提出了dp_knapsack_sliding_hirschberg算法，通过结合两种关键技术：(1)滑动窗口技巧（sliding window trick），用于减少动态规划过程中的中间状态存储；(2)Hirschberg算法，一种经典的线性空间动态规划优化技术。这种组合方法在保持获得精确最优解的同时，将峰值内存复杂度从O(nW)降低到O(W)。

Result: 实验结果表明，改进后的算法能够成功处理n=2000的问题规模，而原始dp_knapsack在n=100时即失败，实现了20倍的可计算问题规模提升。同时，基准测试显示新算法相比原方法获得了25-28%的运行时加速。

Conclusion: 该研究成功解决了PyTorch激活检查点求解器的内存瓶颈问题，在保证求解质量的前提下显著提升了问题规模上限和计算效率。该实现已被PyTorch官方采纳并合并至2.10版本发布，具有重要的实际应用价值。

Abstract: Activation checkpointing minimizes the runtime of neural networks under a given memory budget, by selecting which intermediate tensors to store and which to recompute. PyTorch solves this as a 0/1 knapsack problem, where operations from a joint forward-backward computation graph are items with a memory cost (weight) and a runtime saving (value). The default solver, dp_knapsack, allocates a full dynamic programming (DP) table of shape $(n+1) \times (W+1)$, where $n$ is the number of operations and $W$ is the quantized memory budget. This method is resource-hungry and crashes at $n = 100$ items on a machine with 64 GB RAM.
  In this paper, we introduce dp_knapsack_sliding_hirschberg, which combines the sliding window trick and Hirschberg's algorithm to reduce peak memory from $O(nW)$ to $O(W)$ while preserving the exact optimal solution. Our experiments show successful knapsack execution at $n = 2000$, where dp_knapsack fails at $n = 100$, a 20$\times$ increase in computable problem size. In addition, our benchmarks show a consistent 25-28\% runtime speedup over dp_knapsack.
  The implementation is merged into PyTorch and released in version 2.10.

</details>


### [98] [Learning from Consensus and Disagreement: Unsupervised On-Policy Self-Distillation with Minority-Trajectory Contrast](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08764)
*Jiaxin Guo,Yanwei Yue,Xuanbo Fan,Chunyu Yang,Yan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了CoDA，一种无监督的策略上自蒸馏框架，通过利用模型自身未标注推理轨迹的潜在不确定性结构来创建可靠的特权信息，在数学推理基准测试中显著提升了语言模型的推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的策略上自蒸馏方法依赖外部监督（如标准答案或验证器）来构建教师模型的特权信息优势，限制了其在无监督场景下的应用。此外，仅依赖正样本蒸馏可能会放大相关错误，形成虚假共识的有害反馈循环。

Method: 提出CoDA框架，包含两个互补分支：(1)正分支：利用答案层面的共识识别稳定推理模式，作为冻结自教师提供分布指导的条件；(2)负分支：利用不一致性，通过参考锚定的KTO风格校准目标对少数轨迹进行温和惩罚，打破错误放大的反馈循环。整个框架完全无监督，仅依赖模型自身推理轨迹的内在结构。

Result: 在竞争级数学基准测试上，CoDA显著提升了推理性能，优于自生成基线方法，并有效稳定了训练过程，能够抵御错误共识的影响。

Conclusion: CoDA证明了可以通过挖掘模型自身推理轨迹中的潜在不确定性结构来构建有效的特权信息，无需外部监督即可实现稳定的推理能力提升，为无监督自蒸馏提供了新思路。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation improves language-model reasoning by querying a teacher on states actually visited by the student. Recent methods create a powerful information asymmetry by exposing the teacher to privileged context, yet they fundamentally rely on external supervision---such as gold solutions or verifiers---to construct this advantage. We introduce CoDA (Consensus and Disagreement Alignment), a fully unsupervised framework that creates reliable privileged information entirely from the latent uncertainty structure of a model's own unlabeled rollouts. CoDA extracts two complementary signals. In the positive branch, answer-level consensus identifies a stable reasoning mode, which conditions a frozen self-teacher to provide dense distributional guidance on fresh student trajectories. However, because agreement does not guarantee correctness, positive-only distillation risks amplifying correlated errors into a false consensus. To break this harmful feedback loop, CoDA incorporates a negative branch that exploits disagreement: minority trajectories are treated as unstable alternatives and gently penalized via a reference-anchored, KTO-style calibration objective. This unpaired binary feedback provides robust regularization without requiring the strong assumption that the consensus is the absolute ground truth. Empirical evaluations on competition-level mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that CoDA significantly improves reasoning, outperforming self-generated baselines and effectively stabilizing training against erroneous consensus.

</details>


### [99] [Quantum-Classical Physics-Informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Solving Fuzzy Differential Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08782)
*Xiang Rao,Yuxuan Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出量子-经典物理信息Kolmogorov-Arnold网络(QCPIKAN)求解模糊微分方程，在多个数值实验中平均相对L2误差比经典PIKAN低1.1-2.7倍，证明了量子纠缠带来的表示优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模糊微分方程的求解需要同时逼近α-截集的上下端点函数并满足模糊结构约束，传统方法难以处理。研究旨在利用量子计算的表示能力优势，构建能够同时处理模糊约束和物理方程的混合计算框架。

Method: 提出QCPIKAN网络，将时空坐标和隶属度水平作为联合输入，采用ChebyKAN模块和参数化量子电路构建混合函数逼近器；同时逼近α-截集的上下端点函数，并将控制方程、初始边界条件和模糊结构约束融入训练目标；建立统一的误差分析框架，将端点解误差分解为逼近误差、采样误差、优化误差和模糊结构约束误差。

Result: 在理想量子模拟环境下对椭圆、抛物和双曲方程进行数值实验：QCPIKAN能够捕捉解区间随隶属度增加的整体收缩特性；在大多数测试隶属度水平下，PIKAN的平均相对L2误差约为QCPIKAN的1.1-2.7倍；模糊对流示例中PIKAN的平均波前位置误差约为QCPIKAN的1.77倍；两种模型在边界附近、高梯度区域和波前附近仍存在局部模糊结构违反现象。

Conclusion: QCPIKAN为基于α-截集表示的模糊偏微分方程提供了预测精度相对较高的量子-经典混合物理信息计算框架，理论证明当量子纠缠特征引入的表示增益超过额外计算误差时，QCPIKAN具有更小的先验误差界。

Abstract: In this study, we propose a quantum-classical physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold network (QCPIKAN) dedicated to the solution of fuzzy differential equations. The network takes the spatiotemporal coordinates and membership level as joint inputs and employs ChebyKAN modules and a parameterized quantum circuit to construct a hybrid function approximator. It simultaneously approximates the lower and upper endpoint functions associated with the α-cuts and incorporates the governing equations, initial-boundary conditions, and fuzzy-structural constraints into the training objective. Theoretically, a unified error-analysis framework is established for QCPIKAN and PIKAN, in which the endpoint-solution error is decomposed into approximation, sampling, optimization, and fuzzy-structure constraint errors. Under the assumptions of well-posedness and residual stability, it is proved that QCPIKAN has a smaller a priori error bound when the representational gain introduced by quantum entanglement features exceeds the additional computational error. Numerical experiments are conducted for elliptic, parabolic, and hyperbolic equations in an ideal quantum-simulation environment. The results show that QCPIKAN captures the overall contraction of the solution interval as increases. At most tested membership levels, the mean relative L2 error of PIKAN is approximately 1.1-2.7 times that of QCPIKAN. In the fuzzy convection example, the mean wavefront-position error of PIKAN is approximately 1.77 times that of QCPIKAN. Nevertheless, both models still exhibit local fuzzy-structure violations near boundaries, in high-gradient regions, and around the wavefront. These results indicate that QCPIKAN provides a quantum-classical hybrid physics-informed computational framework with comparatively high predictive accuracy for solving fuzzy partial differential equations represented by α-cuts.

</details>


### [100] [Distilling Vision-Language Models for Robust Traffic Sign Perception in Autonomous Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08815)
*Pedram MohajerAnsari,Amir Salarpour,Mert D. Pesé*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LAMDA框架，通过语言锚定的原型监督提升TSR模型对多种物理对抗攻击的鲁棒性，无需对抗样本训练且无推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于深度神经网络的交通标志识别（TSR）模型虽然在干净数据上表现优异，但对物理可实现的对抗攻击（如阴影扰动、自然光干扰和打印补丁）仍然脆弱。现有防御方法通常只能提升对单一攻击类型的鲁棒性而降低对其他攻击的性能，且可能损害干净样本准确率。

Method: 提出LAMDA训练框架，利用冻结的OpenCLIP文本编码器，从VLM生成的标志描述和类别名称构建两个固定原型库，通过两个互补的辅助损失在训练过程中监督视觉特征，将语言锚定的结构迁移到TSR模型中。训练时不使用对抗样本，推理时丢弃适配器和原型库，仅保留标准骨干网络和分类器，无额外推理开销。

Result: 在GTSRB和LISA数据集上，涵盖四种骨干网络和三种物理攻击类型的评估中，LAMDA是十种方法中唯一在所有攻击-骨干-数据集组合上均能持续提升鲁棒性的方法。阴影攻击下鲁棒性提升最高达+12.5个百分点，自然光攻击下最高达+13.2个百分点，且几乎在所有情况下保持或提升干净样本准确率。

Conclusion: LAMDA有效解决了TSR模型在多种物理对抗攻击下的脆弱性问题，实现了鲁棒性与准确率的协同提升，为实际部署提供了实用、高效的防御方案。

Abstract: Traffic sign recognition (TSR) models based on deep neural networks achieve strong clean-data performance but remain vulnerable to physically realizable adversarial attacks, including shadow perturbations, natural-light interference, and printed patches. Existing defenses often improve robustness against one attack type while degrading performance on others, and can reduce clean accuracy. We propose LAMDA (Language-Anchored Model for Direction Alignment), a training framework that transfers language-grounded structure into TSR models without using adversarial examples or adding inference-time overhead. LAMDA builds two fixed prototype banks from VLM-generated sign descriptions and class names using a frozen OpenCLIP text encoder, and uses them to supervise visual features through two complementary auxiliary losses during training. At inference, the adapter and prototype banks are discarded, leaving a standard backbone and classifier. Evaluated on GTSRB and LISA across four backbones and three physical attack types, LAMDA is the only method among ten evaluated that consistently improves robustness across all attack-backbone-dataset combinations, with gains of up to +12.5 pp under shadow attacks and +13.2 pp under natural-light attacks, while preserving or improving clean accuracy in nearly all cases.

</details>


### [101] [Hybrid Neural-Classical Correction for Frozen Time Series Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Ablation Study on High-Frequency Stock Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08825)
*Kasun Dewage,Suranadi De Silva,Shankhadeep Mondal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了神经-经典混合校正方法，通过结合轻量级神经网络模块（如GatedLinear）与随机森林残差学习，显著提升了TimesFM在高频金融股市收益预测任务中的表现。关键发现：经典残差学习贡献最大，简单神经架构优于复杂架构，GatedLinear+RF在参数更少的情况下实现了最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型（如TimesFM）在通用场景展现出色的零样本泛化能力，但在高频金融等专业领域往往表现不佳。本研究旨在探索如何高效地将冻结的大型基础模型适配到股市开盘高频交易等高波动专业场景。

Method: 采用混合神经-经典校正方法适配冻结的TimesFM（200M参数）。设计两种神经校正架构：AttnCorrect（多头自注意力机制，约471K参数）和GatedLinear（低秩双线性投影+门控机制，约49K参数）。每种架构均结合随机森林进行残差学习。在10只科技股（NVDA、MSFT、AAPL等）约200万数据点上进行系统消融实验，使用三种互补相关指标（日均、跨日累积、池化）评估。

Result: （1）混合方法实现池化相关系数0.597，日均相关系数相比冻结TimesFM提升6.4倍；（2）经典残差学习（随机森林）贡献最大，单独贡献等于或超过神经校正组件；（3）移除经典残差后，简单神经架构反而优于复杂架构；（4）自注意力在纯神经组件中贡献最大；GatedLinear+RF以9倍更少的神经参数实现最佳整体性能。

Conclusion: 有效的基础模型适配需要神经与经典方法的协同整合，经典机器学习方法在其中扮演关键的补充角色。研究为专业领域的基础模型适配提供了实用指导：简单的神经架构配合经典残差学习可以在参数效率与预测性能间取得最优平衡。

Abstract: Foundation models for time series forecasting demonstrate impressive zero-shot generalization but often underperform on specialized domains such as high-frequency finance. We present a comprehensive study of hybrid neural-classical correction for adapting frozen TimesFM (200M parameters) to stock return prediction during the volatile opening trading hour. We compare two neural correction architectures - AttnCorrect (multi-head self-attention, approximately 471K parameters) and GatedLinear (low-rank bilinear projection with gating, approximately 49K parameters) - each augmented with Random Forest residual learning. Through systematic ablation across 10 major technology stocks (NVDA, MSFT, AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL, AMZN, META, AVGO, TSLA, NFLX) spanning 2 million data points, we reveal critical insights: (1) The hybrid neural-classical approach achieves 0.597 pooled correlation and 6.4x mean per-day correlation improvement over frozen TimesFM; (2) Classical residual learning (Random Forest) provides the largest single-component contribution, matching or exceeding the neural correction component; (3) Simpler neural architectures surprisingly outperform complex ones when classical residual learning is removed; (4) Self-attention provides the largest neural-only contribution. GatedLinear+RF achieves best overall performance with 9x fewer neural parameters than AttnCorrect+RF. We report three complementary correlation metrics - mean per-day, cross-day cumulative, and pooled - to provide a complete picture of predictive quality. Our results provide practical guidance: effective foundation model adaptation requires careful integration of neural and classical components, with classical methods playing a crucial complementary role.

</details>


### [102] [The Cost of Adaptivity: Matching Lower Bounds Across Learning Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08826)
*Ibne Farabi Shihab,Adria Binte Habib*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了高斯认证的有限视界组合定律，证明了家族保护者在M个独立坐标和时间T内的最优性能界限为log(eM)+log log(e^eT)，并通过实验验证了理论预测的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应过程需要在没有先知（oracle）可用的干扰信息（如梯度尺度或平滑指数）的情况下工作，而鲁棒过程必须处理在数据观测后才能确定的查询坐标和检查时间。现有方法在这些场景下缺乏理论保证，因此需要建立明确的理论框架来量化干扰适应成本和鲁棒性代价。

Method: 作者通过切片归一化极小极大比率形式化干扰适应问题，分别定义预声明高斯查询到任意事后检查的鲁棒性成本。采用Epoch stitching技术构建上界，利用跨坐标的独立高斯块增量和几何时间尺度构造匹配下界。理论分析结合两个基准场景：在线凸优化中的未知梯度尺度和嵌套Holder类上的逐点适应。

Result: 主要结果是高斯认证的有限视界组合定律：对于M个独立坐标，保护每个坐标和时间（最多T时刻）的家族认证器支付最优归一化平方半宽，量级为log(eM)+log log(e^eT)。在模型监控应用中，朴素固定查询方法的覆盖率在M=1时退化至0.30，M>=10时退化为零，而Epoch stitching认证器保持家族覆盖率。两个基准场景分别显示常数成本和(log n/log log n)^(s1/(2s1+1))量级的成本。

Conclusion: 该组合定律为分析师在任意数据依赖时间检查M个切片指标中的任意一个提供了理论保证，证明选择和停止的额外代价确实存在。实验验证表明理论预测经受住了证伪风险，为自适应统计监控实践提供了可靠的理论基础。

Abstract: Adaptive procedures must work without nuisance information an oracle may use, such as a gradient scale or smoothness index, and robust procedures may have to answer queries whose coordinate and inspection time are chosen only after the data are seen. Such comparisons are meaningful only when the oracle advantage and validity contract are stated explicitly. We formalize nuisance adaptation via a slice-normalized minimax ratio retaining the worst-case instance within each nuisance slice, and separately define the robustness cost of expanding from one preannounced Gaussian query to arbitrary post-hoc inspection. Our main result is a finite-horizon composition law for Gaussian certification: from M independent coordinates, a familywise certifier protecting every coordinate and time up to T pays optimal normalized squared half-width of order log(eM) + log log(e^eT), within the sample-mean-centered rectangular class. Epoch stitching gives the upper bound; independent Gaussian block increments across coordinates and geometric time scales give a matching lower bound, already holding on a geometric checkpoint grid, forcing quantiles of the realized maximum width so selection and stopping taxes add. Two benchmark regimes complete the picture: unknown gradient scale in online convex optimization has constant cost, while pointwise adaptation over nested Holder classes costs order (log n / log log n)^(s1/(2s1+1)). Cast as model monitoring, the law lets an analyst inspect any of M slice metrics at any data-dependent time: the naive fixed-query band's selected coverage degrades sharply, to 0.30 at M=1 and to zero for M>=10, while the epoch-stitched certifier holds familywise coverage at an additive iterated-logarithm width cost. Experiments put both sharp predictions at risk of refutation; both survive.

</details>


### [103] [Beyond Routing: Decoupling Expert Dispatch and Aggregation in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08853)
*Zongfei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FDAA方法，通过分离MoE路由器的专家选择与聚合功能，在冻结骨干网络的情况下显著提升语言模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏混合专家模型中的路由器通常使用相同的分数来选择专家和聚合专家输出，研究者质疑这两个角色（分派和聚合）是否应该耦合，探索将二者分离是否能提升模型性能。

Method: 提出固定分派自适应聚合（FDAA）方法，保持专家选择、计算和路由质量固定，仅改变聚合方式。训练一个30万参数的后计算头，直接使用语言建模目标优化，同时冻结骨干网络、路由器和专家。在OLMoE-1B-7B和DeepSeek-V2-Lite上进行实验验证。

Result: 在OLMoE上，FDAA在WikiText-103上提升交叉熵0.1523 +/- 0.0031；结构化oracle显示有0.0160 +/- 0.0039的改进空间；路由器的最高分专家仅有17.2%是实际最佳。在DeepSeek-V2-Lite上，路由器Top1在WikiText和C4上识别最佳专家的准确率仅为12.5%和16.7%。

Conclusion: 实验结果支持跨架构区分专家选择和专家提交的概念，证明将MoE路由器的分派和聚合功能分离可以带来显著的性能提升，为MoE模型优化提供了新方向。

Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routers commonly use the same scores both to select experts and to weight their already-computed outputs. We study whether these two roles, dispatch and aggregation, should be coupled. On pretrained OLMoE-1B-7B, we keep selected Top-8 expert IDs, expert computation, and total selected router mass fixed and change only within-set aggregation. A structured oracle improves full-horizon cross-entropy by 0.0160 +/- 0.0039 across three seeds; the router's top-scored expert is the counterfactual-best vertex only 17.2% of the time, with router-utility Spearman 0.030. We therefore train Fixed-Dispatch Adaptive Aggregation (FDAA), a 301K-parameter post-compute head optimized directly with the language-modeling objective while freezing the backbone, router, and experts. On OLMoE, FDAA improves fresh WikiText-103 test by Delta CE = -0.1523 +/- 0.0031 across three seeds, and mixed-domain training gives robust gains on WikiText-103, C4, and held-out Penn Treebank under frozen confirmatory evaluation. We also replicate the fixed-dispatch audit on DeepSeek-V2-Lite, which uses Top-6 routed experts plus shared experts. Best-vertex headroom remains significant on WikiText and C4, while router Top1 identifies the best selected expert in only 12.5% and 16.7% of audited examples. In a one-seed mixed-domain replication, FDAA improves locked WikiText and PTB, while C4 is statistically neutral. These results support a cross-architecture distinction between expert selection and expert commitment.

</details>


### [104] [Agentic Anomaly Detection with ORCA-Style Dynamic Inductive Bias Adaptation in Multimodal Wearable Time Series Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08859)
*Anushka Roy,Jyotirmoy Singh,Shreea Bose,Chittaranjan Hota*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了ORCA框架，通过动态调整时间感受野来改进WBAN生理时间序列的异常检测，无需预设时间窗口调优即可达到AUROC=0.99的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WBAN产生的多变量生理时间序列具有高度非平稳性，且需要在严格的计算和内存约束下处理。现有方法依赖固定的时间感受野，在异构信号条件下性能不一致且需要针对数据集进行调优，缺乏适应性的时间归纳偏置。

Method: 提出ORCA框架，采用监督控制器基于轻量级信号统计量在推理时动态调整时间感受野。该控制器自主地在离散时间上下文间进行选择，实现状态依赖的归纳偏置自适应，无需引入额外可训练参数或重新训练。

Result: 在自定义WBAN数据集上，ORCA达到与最强固定上下文基线相当的性能（AUROC=0.99），同时消除了预先调优时间范围的需求。在MIMIC-IV异构临床条件下进行的分布外基准测试中，展现出保守的泛化行为且无性能崩溃。

Conclusion: 自适应时间归纳偏置控制是资源受限、非平稳生理时间序列异常检测中一个实用且稳健的设计原则，为该领域提供了新的解决方案思路。

Abstract: Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs) generate multivariate physiological time series that are highly nonstationary and must often be processed under strict computational and memory constraints. A critical yet underexplored challenge in this setting is selecting an appropriate temporal receptive field, which serves as a strong inductive bias for anomaly detection models. Existing approaches typically rely on fixed temporal contexts, which can perform inconsistently across heterogeneous signal regimes and require dataset-specific tuning. We propose ORCA, an agentically controlled anomaly detection framework that dynamically adapts the temporal receptive field at inference time based on lightweight signal statistics. Rather than introducing additional trainable parameters or learned policies, ORCA employs a supervisory controller that autonomously selects among discrete temporal contexts, enabling state-dependent inductive bias adaptation without retraining. Across a custom WBAN dataset, ORCA achieves performance comparable to the strongest fixed-context baselines (AUROC = 0.99) while eliminating the need to tune temporal horizons in advance. We further evaluate ORCA on MIMIC-IV as a challenging out-of-distribution benchmark, observing conservative generalization behavior without performance collapse under heterogeneous clinical conditions. These results highlight adaptive temporal inductive bias control as a practical and robust design principle for anomaly detection in resource-constrained, nonstationary physiological time series.

</details>


### [105] [Approximation Rates for Metaplectic Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08872)
*Ahmed Abdeljawad,Marcello Carioni,Elena Cordero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过引入基于辛变换的metaplectic Barron空间，建立了浅层神经网络的定量逼近理论，并提出了新的神经网络架构，在求解薛定谔方程时展现出优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经网络在逼近某些函数类时存在理论局限性，而Barron空间为浅层神经网络提供了良好的逼近理论框架。本文旨在利用辛几何中的metaplectic变换扩展Barron空间概念，为神经网络提供更强的函数逼近能力，特别针对物理学中的薛定谔方程求解问题。

Method: 首先，利用metaplectic变换（傅里叶变换的辛推广）定义metaplectic Barron空间。其次，建立metaplectic Barron空间与Sobolev空间之间的嵌入关系。然后，构造神经metaplectic字典，并证明metaplectic Barron函数可由该字典中原子的有限线性组合进行Monte-Carlo逼近。最后，设计以metaplectic字典原子为基本单元的深度神经网络架构，应用于时变薛定谔方程的数值求解。

Result: 获得了metaplectic Barron函数的Monte-Carlo逼近误差界；验证了metaplectic Barron空间与Sobolev空间的嵌入关系；在时变薛定谔方程求解任务中，所提出的神经网络架构相比传统物理信息神经网络(PINNs)表现出更优的逼近性能。

Conclusion: 基于metaplectic变换的Barron空间扩展为浅层神经网络提供了新的理论框架，metaplectic字典的引入增强了神经网络的逼近能力，特别是在求解量子力学中的偏微分方程时展现出显著优势。

Abstract: In this paper we develop quantitative approximation results for shallow neural networks constructed using a dictionary based on metaplectic operators. First, we extend the concept of Barron spaces by considering a symplectically motivated extension of the Fourier transform, known as the metaplectic transform. Then, after establishing embedding between metaplectic Barron spaces and Sobolev spaces we consider a neural metaplectic dictionary and we prove Monte-Carlo approximation bounds for metaplectic Barron functions using finite linear combinations of atoms of the dictionary. Finally, we validate the introduction of the neural metaplectic dictionary by devising a deep neural network architecture that uses as building blocks the atoms of the dictionary. We test it to approximate solutions of time-dependent Schrödinger equations, demonstrating better performance compared to classical phyisics informed neural networks architectures.

</details>


### [106] [DistillCache: KL-Guided Adaptive KV-Cache Eviction for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08878)
*Asaad Althoubi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了DistillCache，一种基于强化学习的KV缓存驱逐框架，通过学习策略网络在保持模型性能的同时显著减少长上下文推理的内存占用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer大语言模型在处理长序列时，KV缓存随序列长度线性增长，导致严重的内存瓶颈。现有的启发式驱逐方法（如H2O和SnapKV）依赖静态注意力或位置信号，无法准确捕捉token的未来预测影响力，导致驱逐决策不够优化。

Method: 将KV缓存驱逐建模为序列决策问题，提出了DistillCache强化学习框架。该方法使用丰富的模型内部信号（注意力统计、值范数、熵和位置）训练轻量级策略网络，采用REINFORCE算法，通过逐步KL散度奖励来保持完整缓存的输出分布。

Result: 在Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3上，DistillCache在25%缓存预算下保持了94.2%的完整缓存准确率（LongBench），比强启发式基线（H2O、SnapKV）高出2.7个百分点，比现有RL方法（ForesightKV、RLKV）高出1.4个百分点。在推理基准测试中表现竞争力，在激进压缩设置下超越最佳并发方法。同时实现了2.1倍完整缓存吞吐量。

Conclusion: 学习型、分布感知的策略在内存高效的长上下文LLM推理中表现出色，证明了基于强化学习的方法在KV缓存管理方面的有效性，为解决长序列推理的内存瓶颈提供了新思路。

Abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many tasks, but their Key-Value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length, creating a severe memory bottleneck for long-context inference. Existing heuristic eviction methods (e.g., H$_2$O and SnapKV) rely on static attention or positional signals that often fail to capture a token's future predictive influence. We propose DistillCache, a reinforcement learning framework that formulates KV-cache eviction as a sequential decision problem. DistillCache learns a lightweight policy network using rich internal model signals (attention statistics, value norms, entropy, and position) and trains it with REINFORCE via a per-step KL-divergence reward to preserve the full-cache output distribution. On a 7B-parameter instruction-tuned Transformer (Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3), DistillCache retains 94.2% of full-cache accuracy on LongBench at a 25% cache budget, outperforming both strong heuristic baselines (H$_2$O, SnapKV) by up to 2.7 absolute points and, under our re-implementations, concurrent RL-based methods (ForesightKV, RLKV) by up to 1.4 points on long-context tasks. On reasoning benchmarks, DistillCache is competitive with the best concurrent method and surpasses it under aggressive compression. It also delivers up to 2.1x full-cache throughput while maintaining competitive practical efficiency. These results highlight the effectiveness of learned, distribution-aware policies for memory-efficient long-context LLM inference.

</details>


### [107] [Federated Attention Autoencoders with a Stochastic Aggregation Scheme for Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08906)
*Mihailo Ilić,Miloš Savić,Vladimir Kurbalija,Mirjana Ivanović,Giancarlo Fortino,Dušan Jakovetić*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了两种适用于联邦学习环境中基于注意力的自编码器的新型聚合函数，在异常检测任务上相比传统自编码器，F1分数和AUC ROC分别提升了2.9%和5.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在去中心化数据环境中进行异常检测是一个具有挑战性的任务，特别是在数据无法共享的场景下。尽管基于联邦学习的异常检测已有进展，注意力机制也能提升自编码器的效率，但注意力模型在联邦学习中的应用仍不成熟，主要原因是缺乏针对这类网络的合适聚合函数。

Method: 提出了两种新型聚合函数，专门针对基于注意力的自编码器设计，能够更好地保留这些网络记忆模块中存储的学习信息。在KDDCUP10数据集上对方法进行了评估。

Result: 在KDDCUP10数据集上的实验表明，与传统自编码器相比，所提出的方法在F1分数上提升了2.9%，在AUC ROC上提升了5.1%。

Conclusion: 所提出的聚合函数有效解决了注意力模型在联邦学习中的应用瓶颈，显著提升了异常检测性能，证明了在联邦学习中应用注意力机制的可行性和优越性。

Abstract: Outlier detection in decentralized data environments is a challenging task for many machine learning implementations, particularly in settings where data cannot be shared. Recently, there have been advances in federated outlier detection, some of which are based on the use of autoencoder networks. The introduction of attention mechanisms to autoencoders boosts their efficiency. However, the application of attention-based models in federated learning remains underdeveloped due to the absence of proper aggregation functions for these types of networks. In our work, we propose two novel aggregation functions tailored for attention-based autoencoders, which better preserve the learned information stored within the memory modules of these networks. We evaluated our approach on the KDDCUP10 dataset, and we showed that the proposed methods achieve up to 2.9\% and 5.1\% better results for F1 score and AUC ROC respectively when compared to traditional autoencoders.

</details>


### [108] [A Domain-Structured Ensemble Framework for Perioperative Outcome Prediction Using Electronic Health Record Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08920)
*Shikhar Shukla,Cristina Barboi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种基于电子健康记录的围术期风险预测框架，通过领域结构化集成方法显著提升了术后谵妄预测性能（AUROC 0.899），并具有良好的校准性和可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有围术期风险预测模型存在四大局限性：手术人群范围狭窄、术中数据不完整、校准性能差以及可解释性有限，这些缺陷制约了临床决策支持系统的有效性和可靠性。

Method: 提出领域结构化集成框架，将预测因子组织为患者相关、手术相关和麻醉相关三个领域。每个领域使用梯度提升模型生成独立风险估计，通过逻辑回归元学习器进行整合。基于州级健康信息交换平台的5,386例手术病例（2,693例病例，2,693例对照）进行验证。

Result: 堆叠元学习器性能优越：AUROC达0.899（95% CI: 0.891-0.906），精确召回曲线下面积0.881，Brier评分0.126，显著优于最佳单阶段模型的AUROC 0.849。时间验证中AUROC达0.915。校准性能优异，截距-0.006，斜率1.035。决策曲线分析显示在临床合理阈值范围内具有正向净获益。

Conclusion: 该模块化框架为可解释、校准敏感的围术期临床决策支持提供了可扩展基础，支持替代结局、预测因子领域扩展和动态风险更新，具有广泛的临床应用潜力。

Abstract: Perioperative risk prediction models are often limited by narrow surgical populations, incomplete intraoperative data, poor calibration, and limited interpretability. We present a domain-structured ensemble framework for perioperative outcome prediction using routinely collected electronic health record (EHR) data. Predictors are organized into patient-related, surgery-related, and anesthetics-related domains. Domain-specific gradient boosting models generate independent risk estimates that are integrated through a logistic regression meta-learner. We demonstrate the framework using postoperative delirium (POD) in a case-control sample of 5,386 surgical encounters (2,693 cases, 2,693 controls) from a statewide health information exchange. POD required both delirium-related ICD codes and a positive Confusion Assessment Method screening within seven postoperative days; patients with preexisting dementia were excluded. The stacked meta-learner achieved AUROC 0.899 (95% CI: 0.891-0.906), precision-recall AUC 0.881, and Brier score 0.126, compared with AUROC 0.849 for the best single-stage model. Domain ablation showed improved discrimination and calibration over a surgery-only model (AUROC 0.879, Brier 0.140). Temporal validation on held-out post-2017 data yielded AUROC 0.915. Calibration was excellent, with intercept -0.006 (95% CI: -0.083 to 0.070) and slope 1.035 (95% CI: 0.982 to 1.088). Decision curve analysis, corrected for case-control sampling, showed positive net benefit across clinically plausible thresholds. The modular framework supports alternative outcomes, extension of predictor domains, and dynamic risk updating, providing a scalable foundation for interpretable, calibration-aware perioperative clinical decision support.

</details>


### [109] [Idea Search: Guiding Tree Search with Ideas to Explore Diverse Scientific Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08958)
*Xuefei Julie Wang,Hao Cui,Michael P. Brenner,Subhashini Venugopalan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Idea Search框架，通过动态"Idea Bank"增强LLM的树搜索能力，在scRNA-seq批次整合任务上相比纯树搜索基线平均分从0.678提升至0.697，最佳分数达0.728。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯树搜索方法在自动化科学编程中存在系统性探索不足的问题，容易陷入局部最优或无效循环，特别是在科学方法的庞大搜索空间中表现尤为明显。

Method: Idea Search框架包含三个步骤：(1)将现有方法分解为原子级想法；(2)从想法库中采样以引导代码变异分支；(3)通过执行动态更新库中新发现的想法。

Result: 在单细胞RNA测序批次整合任务上，Idea Search成功突破了强纯树搜索基线的瓶颈，平均分从0.678提升至0.697，最佳分数达到0.728。银行增强对bandit采样有帮助但对随机采样无效，探索性提示能发现最佳解决方案，而过度的采样级探索适得其反。

Conclusion: 通过动态Idea Bank系统性地集成到树搜索中，可以有效解决纯树搜索的局部最优问题，关键在于合理的设计选择：银行增强、探索性提示和适当的采样策略。

Abstract: Tree Search-based test-time scaling of LLMs is a powerful tool for automated scientific coding. However, pure Tree Search sometimes struggles with systematic exploration, becoming trapped in local optima, or unproductive loops, especially in the vast search space of scientific methods. To address this limitation, we propose Idea Search, a framework that systematically integrates a dynamic "Idea Bank" into Tree Search. Idea Search involves three steps: (1) decomposing existing methods into atomic ideas, (2) sampling from this bank of ideas to guide branches of code mutations, and (3) dynamically updating the bank with new ideas discovered through execution. On single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) batch integration, Idea Search reliably breaks the plateau of a strong pure Tree Search baseline, improving the mean score from 0.678 to 0.697 and reaching a best score of 0.728. We then characterize which design choices drive these gains: bank augmentation helps bandit sampling but not random sampling, "Exploratory" prompting that prioritizes new ideas surfaces the rare best-performing solutions, while increasing sampling-level exploration is counterproductive.

</details>


### [110] [Gradient Under Microscope: Benchmarking Resource Utilization of Memory-Efficient Gradient Computation Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08961)
*Sarthak Mahapatra,Zihan Zhou,Khatoon Khedri,Mehdi Hosseinzadeh,Reza Rawassizadeh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究系统评估了在资源受限硬件上进行内存高效训练的策略，发现梯度累积是最可靠的方法，能显著降低训练损失而不增加显存占用，同时揭示了Adam优化器并非在所有架构上都最优，为资源高效训练提供了实用指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI训练的资源强度不断上升，对电力供应和碳预算造成压力，这促使研究者系统地研究在受限硬件上进行内存高效训练的方法。现有研究缺乏对不同优化器和内存策略在不同架构上的系统性比较，需要为实践者提供明确的指导原则。

Method: 研究采用系统性基准测试方法，评估了五种梯度优化器（SGD、Adam、Adagrad、Adadelta和共轭梯度下降）在三种内存策略（标准训练、梯度检查点和梯度累积）下的表现，测试涵盖四种Transformer架构（ViT、ModernBERT、Llama 3.1 1B和NanoVLM），测量指标包括训练损失、GPU利用率、训练时间和内存使用量。

Result: 梯度累积策略最为可靠，在视觉-语言模型上将训练损失降低约一个数量级，在语言模型上降低约四倍，且无需额外GPU内存。Adam并非普遍最优：Adadelta和SGD在编码器和自回归架构上超越Adam。梯度检查点效果高度依赖架构：改善视觉变换器损失但严重损害编码器模型，在内存受限模型上训练时间增加高达60%。GPU利用率主要由架构决定，从内存受限语言模型的8-15%到计算受限视觉模型的96-99%不等。

Conclusion: 研究结果为资源高效模型训练和部署中的优化器和梯度策略选择提供了实用指导，强调了需要根据具体架构特性选择合适的训练策略，而非采用通用默认配置。这对于在资源受限环境下进行AI模型开发具有重要意义。

Abstract: AI training's rising resource intensity is straining electricity supplies and carbon budgets, motivating systematic study of memory-efficient training on constrained hardware. We benchmark five gradient optimizers (SGD, Adam, Adagrad, Adadelta, and Conjugate Gradient Descent) under three memory strategies (standard training, gradient checkpointing, and gradient accumulation) across four transformer architectures (ViT, ModernBERT, Llama 3.1 1B, and NanoVLM), measuring training loss, GPU utilization, training time, and memory usage. Gradient accumulation emerges as the most reliable strategy, cutting training loss by roughly an order of magnitude on the vision-language model and about four-fold on the language model without additional GPU memory. Contrary to common practice, Adam is not universally superior: Adadelta and SGD outperform it on the encoder and autoregressive architectures. Gradient checkpointing's effect is strongly architecture-dependent, improving vision transformer loss while severely degrading the encoder model, and it increases training time by up to 60% on memory-bound models. GPU utilization is governed primarily by architecture, ranging from 8-15% for the memory-bound language model to 96-99% for compute-bound vision models. These findings provide practical guidelines for optimizer and gradient-strategy selection in resource-efficient model training and deployment.

</details>


### [111] [Math-Vision Diagrams: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Mathematical Diagram Generation Capabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08964)
*Harish Kashyap,Kiran Byadarhaly,Sriram Chakaravarthy,Sanyukta Tuti,Aryan Mistry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文介绍了Math-Vision Diagrams，这是首个专门用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在数学图表生成能力上的基准数据集，包含2920个高质量图文对，统一评估text-to-code和text-to-image两种生成范式。实验表明当前LLM在数学图表生成任务上仍面临显著挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM在数学推理和通用图表生成方面已有相关基准（如MathVision、DiagramGenBenchmark），但缺乏专门针对数学图表生成的标准化评估数据集。数学图表生成需要空间推理、数学推理和渲染系统的完美协调，这一能力对于课程准备、自动化题库排序和科学出版等领域具有重要价值，但目前尚未被充分探索。

Method: 基于Math-Vision基准，从高质量竞赛题目中筛选出2920个具有关键视觉上下文的图像。提出新颖的数据构建流程，结合LLM集成模型与领域专家（SME）人工校验。设计了统一的评估框架，可同时评估text-to-code和text-to-image两种生成范式，且不依赖特定编程语言或模型类型，并配套完整的评估指标体系。

Result: 在所提出的基准上对多个领先模型进行测试，结果显示LLM在数学图表生成任务上表现不佳，存在明显的能力短板，验证了该任务的挑战性。

Conclusion: Math-Vision Diagrams填补了数学图表生成评估领域的空白，为未来研究提供了标准化的测试平台。研究揭示了LLM在该任务上的不足，为后续改进指明了方向。所有代码、数据、构建流程和评估脚本均将开源，促进社区进一步研究。

Abstract: The generation of mathematically precise diagrams from tex- tual prompts has emerged as a critical yet underexplored capability of Large Language Models (LLMs). This has been of interest to researchers in the areas of curriculum preparation, automated ranking of problem sets, and scientific publishing. For LLMs to achieve this, it requires per- fect coordination between Spatial Reasoning, Mathematical Reasoning, and Rendering systems. While existing benchmarks such as MathVision, MathVista are built for Math Reasoning or DiagramGenBenchmark, Mer- maidSeqBench on general purpose diagram generation, no prior work provides a standardized set of prompt, image pairs that can be used to evaluate the LLMs specifically on math diagram generation. This includes fields that span both both text-to-code and text-to-image paradigms. We introduce Math-Vision Diagrams, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate LLMs on mathematical diagram generation, and the first to assess text-to-code and text-to-image generation paradigms together in a single unified setting, agnostic of the underlying coding lan- guage or model type. Building on the Math-Vision benchmark, we select a subset of 2920 images out of 3040 from high-quality competition problems with essential visual context. A novel pipeline combining an ensemble of LLMs with Subject Matter Expert (SME) curation is presented, together with a suite of evaluation metrics. Testing several leading models against this benchmark, we demonstrate that LLMs struggle with math diagram generation. All code, data, curation pipeline, and evaluation scripts will be fully open-sourced.

</details>


### [112] [Label-Free Parkinson's Disease Screening from Face and Voice through Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08976)
*Jiaheng Su,Yu Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种无标签的帕金森病筛查方法，融合面部和语音模态，在YouTubePD基准上达到AUROC 0.802。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 帕金森病是第二常见的神经退行性疾病。传统的机器学习筛查方法需要PD标签，但由于隐私问题和专家标注的需求，可用数据有限。为了解决这一限制，作者希望开发一种完全基于冻结预训练编码器的无标签筛查方法。

Method: 构建了一个无标签的面部加语音PD筛查系统。语音模态使用合成构音障碍对比激活添加（CAA）方向，通过对健康语音进行时间拉伸和气息化降质实现；面部模态使用k近邻异常评分相对于对照嵌入簇。提出了对齐原则，即当合成与真实疾病方向之间的余弦相似度超过零时，合成降质CAA检测器有效。采用等权重晚期融合策略。

Result: 在YouTubePD基准上，语音模态的余弦相似度为+0.37（CAA有效，AUROC 0.765），面部模态为-0.48（CAA失败，异常检测成功，AUROC 0.751）。等权重晚期融合达到AUROC 0.802（95% CI [0.70,0.89]），NPV为0.95，支持排除性分诊解释。过拟合审计显示语音检测器迁移良好，而面部侧AUROC可能乐观，需外部验证。

Conclusion: 该无标签方法为帕金森病筛查提供了一种可行的替代方案，能够在无需PD标签的情况下实现有效筛查。对齐原则为合成降质检测器的有效性提供了理论解释。该方法具有良好的排除性分诊能力，但需要进一步的外部验证来确认面部模态的性能。

Abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is the second most common neurodegenerative disorder. Typical machine learning screening methods require PD labels, but the available data is limited by privacy concerns and the need for expert annotation. We propose a label-free face-plus-voice PD screen built entirely on frozen pretrained encoders--a face-expression Vision Transformer and HuBERT--in which no PD label touches any fit; the reference is training controls only. The voice modality uses a synthetic-dysarthria contrastive activation addition (CAA) direction built from time-stretch and breathy degradation of healthy speech; the face modality uses a k-nearest-neighbor anomaly score to the control embedding cluster. We introduce the alignment principle, a post-hoc analysis showing that a synthetic-degradation CAA detector works when the cosine similarity between the synthetic and real disease directions exceeds zero. Measured on the YouTubePD benchmark, this cosine is +0.37 for voice (CAA works, AUROC 0.765) and -0.48 for face (CAA fails; anomaly succeeds, AUROC 0.751). Equal-weight late fusion reaches AUROC 0.802 (95% CI [0.70,0.89]) with NPV 0.95, supporting a rule-out triage interpretation. An overfitting audit shows the voice detector transfers cleanly, while the face-side--and thus fused--AUROC is potentially optimistic pending external validation.

</details>


### [113] [Twin Rollouts: Noise-Coupled Counterfactual Branching in Interactive Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08982)
*Yu Ma,Hongli Shi,Xinran Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了噪声耦合双子轨迹框架，用于交互式视频世界模型的反事实生成，实现了精确的 abduction 并提出了可验证的最小变化度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的交互式视频世界模型主要关注事实性预测，缺乏对反事实生成的系统研究。给定模型自身生成的轨迹，如何回答"如果从某一步开始采取不同的动作会发生什么"这一问题。传统的编辑方法面临近似逆问题，且缺乏可验证的评估指标。

Method: 提出噪声耦合双子轨迹框架，包含事实分支和反事实分支，两者共享生成前缀和未来外生噪声序列，仅在干预点后的动作流上分叉。由于事实分支是自生成的，其外生噪声已知，使得 Pearl 反事实过程中的 abduction 步骤精确完成，避免了编辑方法中的近似逆问题。进一步定义时空局部性度量，惩罚干预因果后代之外的偏离。通过在干预点分叉模拟器状态获得真实反事实重渲染，作为后训练的可验证奖励。

Result: 建立了反事实生成的形式化框架和度量定义，证明了噪声耦合能够将最小变化原则转化为可逐样本验证的属性，无需学习型评判器即可对模拟器真值计算度量。

Conclusion: 本文为交互式视频世界模型中的反事实生成问题提供了理论基础，提出了形式化框架和评估指标，为后续的实验研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: Interactive video world models generate rollouts autoregressively under an action stream, yet they are trained and evaluated almost exclusively on factual prediction. We study counterfactual generation inside the rollout: given a trajectory the model has itself generated, what would have happened had the actions differed from step t* onward? We formalize noise-coupled twin rollouts --- a factual and a counterfactual branch sharing the generated prefix and the future exogenous noise sequence, diverging only in the action stream at an intervention point. Because the factual branch is self-generated, its exogenous noise is known exactly: the abduction step of Pearl's counterfactual procedure is exact by construction, sidestepping the approximate-inversion problem faced by editing-based pipelines. Noise coupling further turns the minimal-change principle into a per-sample verifiable property: we define a spatiotemporal locality metric that penalizes divergence outside the causal descendants of the intervention, computable against simulator ground truth without a learned judge. Forking the simulator state at t* yields ground-truth counterfactual re-renders, which we use as verifiable rewards for post-training. This note establishes the formal framework, metric definitions, and positioning; experiments are forthcoming.

</details>


### [114] [SoftMCC: An MCC-Brier Calibration Bridge for Threshold-Free Model Selection under Class Imbalance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08984)
*Özkan Canay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了SoftMCC，一种针对不平衡二分类的MCC模型选择框架，解决了阈值依赖问题，在稳定性方面表现最佳，但在测试集效用上无显著优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在不平衡二分类任务中，MCC常用于模型选择，但传统的基于阈值的方法导致验证排名依赖于阈值选择，缺乏稳定性。需要一种不依赖阈值、能够保持MCC优良特性的模型选择方法。

Method: 提出SoftMCC后训练验证框架：1)基于概率值混淆矩阵计算；2)结合MCC特定的校准等式；3)采用感知并列的共享池选择协议；4)核心分数为协方差标准化的概率-标签关联度，对于硬预测可精确退化为MCC，并具有Pearson界限。

Result: 在18个设置和12个重复安全分组重复实验中：SoftMCC获得最佳稳定性平均排名(2.31)和最高平均并列校正Kendall's W(0.659)，Friedman检验显著(p=0.007)；Nemenyi分析显示与AUPRC和MCC@0.5显著分离；但选定模型的测试MCC效用无显著优势；标签排列使平均W降至0.092；温度缩放改变SoftMCC排名(平均Spearman 0.851)，而基于排名和阈值优化的指标保持不变。

Conclusion: SoftMCC是一种校准敏感的MCC族选择器，具有有界的稳定性和效用证据，但其性能依赖于模型校准质量，在非完美校准情况下与Brier技能分数存在差异，且该差异不能识别校准误差。

Abstract: Model selection for imbalanced binary classification often uses the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), but thresholding makes validation rankings threshold-dependent. SoftMCC is a post-training MCC validation framework on established probability-valued confusion counts, coupling an MCC-specific calibrated identity with a tie-aware, shared-pool selection protocol. Its core score is a covariance-normalized probability-label association, reduces exactly to MCC for hard predictions, and is Pearson-bounded. Under perfect population calibration it equals the Brier skill score with identical candidate ordering; outside that regime the gap does not identify calibration error. Across 18 settings with 12 duplicate-safe grouped repeats, SoftMCC attains the best stability mean rank (2.31) and highest mean tie-corrected Kendall's W (0.659), with a significant Friedman test (p=0.007); Nemenyi analysis separates it from AUPRC and MCC@0.5, while 14-source-family sensitivity retains only the latter. Selected-model utility shows no advantage. Three of six prespecified comparisons have negative mean test-MCC differences, only F1@best survives Holm correction (p=0.014), and the dataset-level test is not significant (p=0.117). Label permutation lowers mean W to 0.092; temperature scaling shifts SoftMCC rankings (mean Spearman 0.851) whereas rank-based and threshold-optimized metrics remain invariant. SoftMCC is a calibration-sensitive MCC-family selector with bounded stability and utility evidence.

</details>


### [115] [Dynamic Distribution-Aware Uncertainty Tracking in Vision-Language Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09011)
*Ao Zhou,Zhiwei Jiang,Zifeng Cheng,Cong Wang,Shufan Yang,Haoru Chen,Qing Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DDA-UQ框架，通过动态分布感知过程改进视觉语言模型的不确定性量化，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后处理不确定性量化方法局限于拟合源域的失败模式，忽视了测试分布的动态变化特性，导致在安全关键场景中可靠性不足。

Method: 提出动态分布感知不确定性量化框架(DDA-UQ)，训练阶段利用高斯混合模型建模VLMs嵌入空间并提取分布证据，推理阶段动态响应数据分布变化。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法显著优于当前最先进的不确定性量化方法。

Conclusion: DDA-UQ成功将不确定性量化从静态映射转变为动态分布感知过程，有效提升了视觉语言模型在动态测试分布下的不确定性估计能力。

Abstract: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) aims to measure the reliability of model predictions, serving as a critical safeguard for deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in safety-critical scenarios. Post-hoc approaches are widely adopted due to their lightweight nature, mapping the outputs of VLMs to uncertainty measures through learnable modules or inductive summarization. However, Post-hoc approaches remain inherently confined to fitting the failure patterns of the source domain, ignoring the dynamic nature of test distributions. To address this challenge, we propose a Dynamic Distribution-Aware Uncertainty Quantification framework (DDA-UQ) that shifts the paradigm from static mapping to a dynamic distribution-aware process. During training, we leverage a Gaussian Mixture Model to model the VVLMs'embedding space and extract distributional evidence, thereby dynamically deriving uncertainty estimates. During inference, the design dynamically responds to changes in the data distribution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [116] [HOPPER: Learnable Hop Extraction for Linearized Graph Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09031)
*Isuru Herath,Arin Gopakumar,Sharan Sahu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了HOPPER，一种端到端可学习的线性化图序列模型扩展，通过自适应学习hop序列的提取方式来解决长距离图表示学习问题，在多个基准测试中达到最优或竞争性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图神经网络存在信息传播距离与非线性变换次数耦合的问题，导致深层架构优化困难、过度平滑、过度压缩和长距离信息丢失。虽然线性化图序列模型(LGSMs)通过分离信息深度和处理深度缓解了这一问题，但现有LGSMs使用固定的图算子构建序列，限制了其对输入图、节点特征和下游任务的适应能力。

Method: 提出HOPPER框架，这是LGSM的端到端可学习扩展，在序列被现代状态空间模型处理之前，学习如何提取hop序列。该框架支持特征条件化、结构感知、图自适应和hop自适应的传播机制，同时保持排列等变性。标准的基于邻接矩阵和非回溯的LGSM序列可以作为所提出的提取器家族的特例。

Result: HOPPER在ECHO-Synth基准测试中达到最先进或竞争性能；通过改变消息回溯取消的最大邻域大小（即结构记忆窗口），可以在LRIM物理长程依赖基准上优化准确率。

Conclusion: 可学习的序列提取为长距离图表示学习提供了一种灵活有效的方法，证明了学习自适应传播机制的重要性和有效性。

Abstract: Graph neural networks typically propagate information through repeated message-passing layers, coupling the distance over which information travels with the number of nonlinear transformations applied. This coupling can make deep architectures difficult to optimize and can lead to over-smoothing, over-squashing, and the loss of long-range information. Linearized Graph Sequence Models (LGSMs) address this issue by separating information depth from processing depth and treating the successive propagation states of each node as a sequence. However, existing LGSMs construct these sequences using fixed graph operators, limiting their ability to adapt propagation to the input graph, node features, and downstream task. We introduce HOPPER, an end-to-end learnable extension of LGSM that learns how hop sequences should be extracted before they are processed by a modern state-space model. Our framework supports feature-conditioned, structure-aware, graph- and hop-adaptive propagation mechanisms while preserving permutation equivariance. Standard adjacency-based and non-backtracking LGSM sequences arise as special cases of our proposed extractor family. We show that HOPPER is state-of-the-art or competitive across the ECHO-Synth benchmark, and that varying the maximum neighborhood size of message backtracking cancellation (i.e. structural memory window) can optimize accuracy on the LRIM physics-based long-range dependency benchmark. These results demonstrate that learnable sequence extraction provides a flexible and effective approach to long-range graph representation learning.

</details>


### [117] [F2STNet: Fair and Federated Spectral-Temporal Modeling for Graph Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09082)
*Jiayi Zhang,Jinfeng Xu,Hewei Wang,Siyuan Cen,Haidong Huang,Yiyao Zhan,Zheyu Chen,Jinjiang You,Ai Jian,Edith C. H. Ngai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了F²STNet，一种用于图结构数据时空预测的联邦学习框架，结合了截断图傅里叶特征、轻量级对角状态空间编码器和公平感知联邦聚合策略，在多个数据集上取得了优于基线的预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图结构数据的时空预测在交通流量预测和环境监测等领域具有重要意义。然而，由于数据分布的分散性和异构性，传统的序列建模和协作训练方法面临重大挑战，需要设计能够同时处理图结构信息和异构数据的联邦预测框架。

Method: 提出了F²STNet框架，包含以下核心组件：1) 截断图傅里叶特征用于提取图频率结构；2) 轻量级对角状态空间时序编码器，能够以序列长度的线性复杂度建模长时间依赖关系；3) 图卷积层用于空间特征提取；4) 公平感知联邦聚合（FFA）策略，通过客户端验证损失和递增公平性调度来调整FedAvg先验。

Result: 在PeMS04、HZMetro和KnowAir三个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在预测精度方面优于所有评估的基线方法。特别是在PeMS04数据集上的联邦实验中，该方法在最差客户端性能和客户端性能离散度指标方面均有显著改善。

Conclusion: F²STNet框架通过结合谱域特征提取、高效时序建模和公平感知聚合策略，有效解决了分散异构图数据的时空预测问题，为联邦学习环境下的时空预测任务提供了一种可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Spatiotemporal prediction on graph-structured data is central to traffic forecasting and environmental monitoring, yet decentralized and heterogeneous data complicate both sequence modeling and collaborative training. We propose F$^2$STNet, a federated forecasting framework that combines truncated graph-Fourier features, a lightweight diagonal state-space temporal encoder, graph convolution, and Fairness-aware Federated Aggregation (FFA). The spectral branch exposes graph-frequency structure, while the state-space layer models long temporal dependencies with linear complexity in the sequence length. FFA adjusts the FedAvg prior using client validation losses and an increasing fairness schedule. Experiments on PeMS04, HZMetro, and KnowAir show favorable forecasting accuracy relative to the evaluated baselines; federated experiments on PeMS04 additionally improve worst-client and client-dispersion metrics.

</details>


### [118] [RAVEN: Frozen Random Graph Reservoirs with Physics-Informed Interaction Fingerprints for Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09099)
