*Qingyang Zou,Jiaye Huang,Hangbo Xie,Jiayue Yin,Youyi Song,Jinfeng Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RAVEN是一种结合冻结图编码器、物理化学指纹和异构回归器融合的方法，在蛋白质-配体结合亲和力预测任务上展现出优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质-配体结合亲和力定量估计是结构计算化学的核心任务，但现有结构-亲和力数据有限、实验异质性强、构象依赖性高且对数据集划分敏感，导致可靠预测仍然具有挑战性。

Method: 提出RAVEN框架：(1)多头储备池：使用多个独立初始化且完全冻结的原子图编码器生成多样化结构投影；(2)结合确定性物理化学相互作用指纹；(3)异构监督读取器（神经网络和树模型）；(4)基于验证集的非负融合策略整合输出。

Result: 在基于GEMS相似性资源重构的PDBbind 2020R1相似性隔离划分和受保护的CASF-2016子集上进行评估，RAVEN展现出强大的预测性能。

Conclusion: 冻结多视角图表示、显式物理化学统计特征与异构模型融合的组合为蛋白质-配体结合亲和力预测提供了一个稳健且灵活的框架。

Abstract: Quantitative estimation of protein-ligand binding affinity from three-dimensional complex structures is a fundamental task in structure-based computational chemistry and molecular modeling. Reliable prediction remains challenging because available structure-affinity data are limited, experimentally heterogeneous, conformation-dependent, and sensitive to dataset partitioning. RAVEN (Randomized Atomistic Views with Ensemble Neural Reservoirs) utilizes a multihead reservoir of independently initialized and fully frozen atomistic graph encoders to generate diverse structural projections without end-to-end optimization of the graph representation. These projections are integrated with a deterministic physicochemical interaction fingerprint and processed by heterogeneous supervised readers, including neural and tree-based regressors, whose outputs are combined through validation-based nonnegative fusion. The random reservoir expands structural feature coverage across independent encoder realizations, whereas the explicit physicochemical descriptors and heterogeneous readers contribute complementary information and distinct inductive biases. Evaluation on a similarity-isolated PDBbind 2020R1 split reconstructed using GEMS similarity resources, together with the protected CASF-2016 subset, demonstrated strong predictive performance. The results indicate that frozen multi-view graph representations, explicit physicochemical statistics, and heterogeneous model fusion provide a robust and flexible framework for protein-ligand binding-affinity prediction.

</details>


### [119] [Real Data Closes Synthetic-to-Real Gap in Optical Chemical Structure Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09100)
*Yani Guan,Dengpan Dong,Zi Wei,Shuang Luo,Dan Hannah,Yumin Zhang,Kang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究发现真实标注数据是提升化学结构识别（OCSR）性能的关键因素。仅用合成数据训练的模型在真实文档上表现极差，加入少量真实数据后性能显著提升。视觉适配策略的效果因基座模型而异，模型选择需与数据配比协同考虑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学结构识别在实际应用中存在严重的泛化问题：现有方法在合成图像上表现优异（91%准确率），但在真实文档上性能急剧下降（低于16%）。研究者旨在识别提升真实场景性能的关键因素，理解数据、模型架构和适配策略之间的相互作用。

Method: 系统性地微调了21个识别器，控制三个变量：视觉语言模型基座（Qwen、InternVL、GLM）、真实训练数据比例（0%-70%）、视觉塔适配策略（LoRA）。在合成渲染结构和真实专利、期刊、手绘化学结构的混合数据集上进行训练，在五个基准数据集上评估（包括三个真实世界数据集）。

Result: 真实标注数据带来最大性能提升：Qwen在ACS数据集上的准确率从15%提升至46%（50%真实数据）。视觉LoRA的效果因模型而异：对Qwen无效，显著帮助InternVL（+22.8到+34.6个百分点），对GLM略有帮助。最佳配置在清洁渲染上达到96%准确率，在真实数据集上达到49%-84%。基座模型间的性能差距随真实数据增加而缩小（从21个百分点降至6个百分点），且排名会重新洗牌。

Conclusion: 真实标注数据是解决OCSR泛化问题的关键，模型选择必须与数据配比协同决策，不能简单迁移合成数据实验的结论。视觉适配策略的有效性高度依赖于基座模型，需要在目标任务上进行实际评估，这一发现可能适用于其他视觉结构识别任务。

Abstract: Millions of chemical structures appear in patents and papers only as drawings, and using that information at scale requires reading the drawings. OCSR appears nearly solved on synthetic images yet remains difficult on real documents: the starting recognizer, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, exceeds 91% accuracy on synthetic renders but falls below 16% on three real-world benchmarks (ACS, CLEF-IP, USPTO). To identify the main source of improvement, 21 recognizers were fine-tuned on mixtures of synthetically rendered structures and labeled real depictions from patents, journal figures, and hand-drawn collections, varying the vision language model (VLM) base, the fraction of real training data, and the vision-tower adaptation strategy. Labeled real training images make the largest difference. For Qwen2.5-VL, ACS exact match rises from 0.15 with no real data to 0.37 at 9.5% and 0.46 at 50.2%; a controlled experiment across three base models reproduces the trend. A vision-tower LoRA, in contrast, does nothing for Qwen (+0.00, paired p=1.00), substantially helps InternVL3-8B (+22.8 to +34.6 pt), and modestly helps GLM-4.1V-9B (+1.0 to +9.6 pt), so its value depends on the base model. The best configuration reaches 0.96 exact match on clean renders and 0.49, 0.65, 0.84, and 0.76 on ACS, CLEF-IP, UOB, and USPTO, respectively. Gaps between base models are largest without real data (0.21), shrink to 0.06 at 70% real data, and reorder the ranking; base model and real-data mixture must therefore be selected together. Small-scale experiments on handwritten image-to-LaTeX recognition and chart-to-table conversion show that base-model rankings also vary beyond chemistry. More generally, model and adaptation choices for visual structure recognition should be evaluated on the target task.

</details>


### [120] [A Probabilistic Circuit-Induced Pseudo-Metric for Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09117)
*Bhumika K,Vidhya S,Narayanan C Krishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了层次化似然向量(HLV)表示和层次化似然距离(HLD)伪度量，通过利用概率电路(PC)内部节点的层次化概率信息，显著提升了分布外(OOD)检测性能，并实现了分布偏移的定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于概率电路(PC)的分布外(OOD)检测方法仅利用根节点计算的标量似然（或其不确定性），忽略了PC内部节点编码的层次化概率摘要信息。这种信息浪费限制了检测性能。

Method: 1. 引入层次化似然向量(HLV)：其条目为选定PC节点的似然值\n2. 定义层次化似然距离(HLD)：基于HLV期望值的伪度量，用于比较概率分布\n3. 证明HLD是PC自然诱导函数类上的积分概率度量\n4. 开发基于拟合优度假设检验的无监督OOD检测方法\n5. 从训练好的PC中精确计算假设检验所需量，获得近似解析决策阈值

Result: 在表格数据和MNIST数据集上的实验表明：\n1. 该方法优于基于根似然、不确定性、典型性和核方法的基线方法\n2. 能够自然地将分布偏移定位到导致偏移的PC节点\n3. 仅需训练好的PC作为分布内表示，部署时无需保留分布内数据

Conclusion: 利用概率电路内部节点的层次化概率摘要信息可以显著改善分布外检测性能，为PC模型的深度利用提供了新视角，同时实现了分布偏移的可解释定位。

Abstract: Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) are tractable generative models whose internal nodes encode a hierarchy of probabilistic sum- maries over different variable scopes. Existing PC-based out- of-distribution (OOD) detection methods ignore this hierar- chy, reducing the entire circuit to the scalar likelihood (or its uncertainty) computed at the root. We introduce Hierar- chical Likelihood Vector (HLV), a representation whose en- tries are the likelihoods associated with selected PC nodes and define the Hierarchical Likelihood Distance (HLD), a PC-induced pseudo-metric that compares the probability dis- tributions through the expectations of their HLVs. We show that HLD is an integral probability metric over a function class naturally induced by the PC and develop a principled goodness-of-fit hypothesis test for unsupervised OOD detec- tion. Unlike existing approaches, the trained PC alone serves as the representation of the in-distribution: no held-out in- distribution data are required at deployment. We further show that the quantities required by the hypothesis test can be com- puted exactly, directly from the trained circuit, yielding an ap- proximate analytic decision threshold. Experiments on tabular and MNIST datasets demonstrate that exploiting the hierarchi- cal probabilistic summaries encoded through the PC improve OOD detection over root-likelihood, uncertainty-, typicality- and kernel-based baselines, while naturally localizing distri- bution shifts to the PC nodes responsible for the shift.

</details>


### [121] [MARA: Flow-Matching-Guided Multi-Agent Resource Allocation for Computational Resource Efficient Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09130)
*Hanye Zhao,Muning Wen,Yong Yu,Weinan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MARA通过条件流匹配预测损失轨迹，并使用多智能体自回归策略协调离散计算节点，在任务到达时间未知且计算资源有限的场景下，相比强基线LARA将任务完成率提升8.54个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将计算资源视为连续可分的吞吐量，但在实际场景中，任务随时间到达且计算由离散节点提供，导致需求不确定和序贯决策受限。这种设置下的资源分配问题尚未得到充分研究。

Method: 提出MARA框架：1) 使用条件流匹配预测未来损失轨迹；2) 采用协作式多智能体自回归策略协调计算节点；3) 设计基于势函数的进度奖励，提供中间训练反馈同时保持非折扣的任务完成目标。

Result: 在包括分布内任务、强化学习和视觉工作负载的实验中，流匹配相比加权最小二乘法降低了剩余资源预测误差；在调度器的训练负载下，MARA平均完成63.46%的任务，比强基线LARA高出8.54个百分点，在更重的未见工作负载下仍保持优势。

Conclusion: MARA有效解决了离散计算节点和动态任务到达场景下的资源分配问题，通过流匹配预测和多智能体协作显著提升了任务完成率，证明了该方法在实际计算资源受限环境中的实用价值。

Abstract: Allocating limited computation among concurrent learning tasks is difficult when each task must reach a target loss before a deadline but its required training effort is unknown. Existing approaches combine online loss prediction with adaptive resource allocation, yet commonly treat computation as continuously divisible throughput. We instead study a practical setting in which tasks arrive over time and computation is provided by discrete nodes. This setting introduces both uncertain demand and constrained sequential decisions. We propose MARA, which predicts future loss trajectories with conditional flow matching and coordinates compute nodes through a cooperative multi-agent autoregressive policy. A potential-based progress reward supplies intermediate training feedback while preserving the undiscounted task-completion objective. Across in-distribution, reinforcement-learning, and vision workloads, flow matching reduces remaining-resource prediction error relative to weighted least squares. At the scheduler's training load, MARA completes 63.46% of tasks on average, 8.54 percentage points above strong baseline Learning with Adaptive Resource Allocation (LARA), and remains ahead under unseen heavier workloads.

</details>


### [122] [Tabular Numeric Stretch Transformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09162)
*Zihao Ye,Juyong Kim,Johnna Sundberg,Burak Varici,Pradeep Ravikumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了“stretch transformation”框架，将数值特征预处理建模为优化问题以提升目标函数平滑性，包含无监督与监督两种变体，后者在38个数据集上持续优于所有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格数据中的数值特征在分布、尺度和统计性质上高度异质，现有深度学习方法对数值特征如何转换为模型友好的表示的探索相对不足，缺乏系统化、可优化的预处理范式。

Method: 提出stretch transformation框架，将数值特征预处理建模为优化问题以提升目标函数平滑性：无监督stretch通过极大极小优化均匀重分布特征密度；监督stretch通过最小化变换空间中目标函数的Dirichlet能量实现目标感知的数值特征变换。理论上揭示无监督stretch与Piecewise Linear Encoding共享分段线性几何、在分箱数增加时逼近经验CDF变换；监督stretch在精细分箱极限下与目标编码高度相关。

Result: 在TALENT基准的38个数据集上进行的全面实验表明，监督stretch在所有基线方法上取得一致更优的性能，验证了显式优化目标函数平滑性是一种强有力的策略。

Conclusion: 将数值特征预处理表述为平滑性优化问题是表格深度学习中一个有力且未被充分探索的方向；stretch transformation框架为此提供了统一的理论与实践范式，并建立了与现有流行变换方法的联系。

Abstract: Tabular data presents unique challenges for deep learning due to its heterogeneous nature, where numeric features exhibit diverse distributions, scales, and statistical properties. Although recent advances have improved how models learn from tabular data, how numeric data are transformed into model-friendly representations remains comparatively underexplored. We introduce the stretch transformation framework, which formulates numeric feature preprocessing as an optimization problem to make the target function smoother and thus more learnable. Our framework has two variants: (1) unsupervised stretch, which uniformly redistributes feature density via minimax optimization, and (2) supervised stretch, which optimizes target-aware numeric feature transformations from the perspective of target-function smoothness by minimizing the target function's Dirichlet energy in the transformed space. Our theoretical analysis further connects this framework to several popular transformations: unsupervised stretch is closely related to Piecewise Linear Encoding through a shared piecewise-linear geometry and approaches the empirical CDF transformation as the number of bins grows, while supervised stretch becomes closely related to target encoding in the fine-binning limit. Comprehensive experiments on 38 datasets from the TALENT benchmark demonstrate that supervised stretch consistently outperforms all baselines. These results show that explicitly optimizing for target function smoothness is a powerful and underexplored strategy for tabular deep learning.

</details>


### [123] [A Time-Frequency Dual-Domain Multi-Scale Convolutional Neural Network for Bearing Fault Diagnosis under Strong Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09174)
*Yanxi Ding,Tingyue Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出时频双域多尺度CNN，在强噪声下显著提升轴承故障诊断精度，-4 dB SNR下达92.50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对强噪声环境下轴承故障诊断准确率严重下降的问题，传统单域方法在低信噪比条件下性能不足。

Method: 构建时频双域多尺度卷积神经网络：时域分支采用三个并行卷积核捕获多尺度冲击特征，频域分支通过快速傅里叶变换提取抗噪频谱结构信息，最后融合双域特征进行故障分类，模型仅含110,122参数。

Result: 在CWRU数据集上，干净条件下准确率达99.75%；-4 dB SNR下准确率92.50%，较单域基线提升7.25个百分点，且噪声越强增益越明显。消融实验验证了时域多尺度分支和频域分支的独立贡献；对比WDCNN、DRSN-CW、MCNN和1D-LeNet，所提方法在强噪声下性能最优。

Conclusion: 时频双域特征融合有效提升轴承故障诊断在强噪声环境下的鲁棒性，为实际工业应用提供了紧凑高效的解决方案。

Abstract: To address the degradation of bearing fault diagnosis accuracy under strong noise, this paper proposes a time-frequency dual-domain multi-scale convolutional neural network. The time-domain branch employs three parallel convolutional kernels to capture multi-scale impulse features, while the frequency-domain branch applies the Fast Fourier Transform to extract noise-robust spectral structure information. Features from both branches are fused for fault classification, yielding a compact model of 110,122 parameters. Experiments on the CWRU bearing dataset across seven signal-to-noise ratio levels demonstrate that the proposed method achieves 99.75% accuracy under clean conditions and maintains 92.50% at -4 dB SNR, representing a 7.25 percentage-point improvement over the single-domain baseline with monotonically increasing gains under stronger noise. Ablation experiments validate the independent performance contributions of the time-domain multi-scale branch and the frequency-domain branch. Comparative experiments against WDCNN, DRSN-CW, MCNN, and 1D-LeNet confirm the superiority of the proposed method under strong noise conditions.

</details>


### [124] [Beyond Solvability: Task Learnability as a Static Prior for LLM RL Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09217)
*Ting Zhou,Zhenqing Ling,Daoyuan Chen,Qianli Shen,Yilun Huang,Ying Shen,Yaliang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TrajVal方法，通过短探针运行预测任务可学习性，优化强化学习中大语言模型的任务采样策略，提升数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习后训练采用均匀任务采样，忽略了不同任务对优化的响应差异；现有任务评估方法仅依赖快照信号（如当前通过率），无法区分具有相似当前可解性但对后续训练响应不同的任务。

Method: 提出任务可学习性概念（在固定RL后训练机制下对持续训练的期望正向响应），并设计TrajVal轻量级探针估计器：通过短探针运行和两次端点评估来近似任务可学习性，可作为静态先验或与在线调度器结合的乘法先验。

Result: 任务可学习性在独立采样的训练上下文中具有可复现性，并能预测下游效用；在数学和逻辑推理基准测试中，TrajVal相比均匀采样提升了数据效率，与在线调度方法结合时提供互补性增益。

Conclusion: 任务可学习性是一种有价值的信号，TrajVal提供了一种实用的方法来估计和利用该信号，能够有效改进强化学习后训练中的任务采样策略，在多种模型规模上验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a central post-training paradigm for eliciting reasoning capabilities in large language models, yet uniform task sampling allocates compute without regard to differences in how tasks respond to optimization. Existing task-valuation methods mostly rely on snapshot-based signals such as current pass rate or reward, which estimate how solvable a task is under the current policy. However, tasks with similar current solvability can still differ substantially in how positively they respond to further training. We study this residual axis as task learnability: a regime-conditional measure of expected positive response to continued training under a fixed RL post-training regime. By analyzing per-task reward trajectories, we find that learnability is reproducible across independently sampled training contexts and predictive of downstream utility. To make this signal practical before training begins, we propose TrajVal, a lightweight probe-based estimator that approximates per-task learnability from a short probe run and two endpoint evaluations. TrajVal can be used either as a standalone static prior for task sampling or as a multiplicative prior for existing online schedulers. Experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks across multiple model scales show that TrajVal improves data efficiency over uniform sampling and provides complementary gains when combined with online scheduling methods.

</details>


### [125] [Online Learning of Scale Parameters in Score-Driven Filters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09218)
*Fabrizio Lillo,Giulia Livieri,Gianluca Palmari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了分数驱动滤波器中增益参数的在线学习问题，将增益选择建模为条件预测决策问题，提出了基于镜像下降的有界增益更新方法，在股指波动率实证中表现优于恒定增益并避免了极端波动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分数驱动滤波器通过缩放的对数似然分数乘以增益来控制更新幅度，但增益参数的选择缺乏理论指导。作者将增益视为决策变量，研究其在线学习机制，旨在为增益选择提供理论框架和实用方法。

Method: 将增益选择建模为以KL散度为目标函数的条件预测决策问题；对于标量未缩放增益，推导了连续分数负原始乘积作为损失的随机梯度；引入单调可微增益连接函数在有界增益域上诱导镜像下降几何；提出了投影和折扣镜像更新方法，并建立了相对于时变比较器的动态遗憾界。

Result: 理论方面：在凸性、紧性和正则性条件下建立了动态遗憾界。实证方面：在股指波动率面板数据上，有界镜像增益通常匹配或优于恒定增益，避免了无界指数连接的极端峰值，在多重危机市场中改进最为显著。

Conclusion: 增益的在线学习可以有效提升分数驱动滤波器的性能；镜像下降框架为增益更新提供了理论基础；有界增益设计既能保持灵活性又可避免极端波动，特别适合波动率建模等金融应用场景。

Abstract: Score-driven filters multiply a scaled log-likelihood score by a gain that controls the update magnitude. We treat this gain as a decision variable and study its online learning. Conditional on the current state, observation, score, and scaling rule, each admissible gain induces a reachable next state and a one-step-ahead predictive density: scalar gains govern distance along a line, while diagonal gains govern coordinatewise transmission. Gain selection is therefore a conditional predictive decision problem with a Kullback-Leibler objective. For a scalar unscaled gain, the negative raw product of consecutive scores is the stochastic gradient of this loss; positive aGAS scaling only rescales the effective step. Monotone differentiable gain links induce mirror-descent geometries on bounded gain domains, while persistence yields a Bregman pull towards a reference gain. Under convexity, compactness, and regularity conditions, we establish dynamic-regret bounds for projected and discounted mirror updates relative to time-varying, current-information comparators. Simulations illustrate the roles of scaling, link geometry, persistence, and coordinatewise transmission rates. An out-of-sample panel of equity-index volatilities shows that the bounded mirror gain generally matches or outperforms a constant gain while avoiding the extreme spikes of a nominally unbounded exponential link, with the strongest improvements observed in multi-crisis markets.

</details>


### [126] [Privileged Solutions or Context-Induced Teacher Behavior? Dissecting On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09228)
*Yuki Ichihara,Naoto Iwase,Mohammad Atif Quamar,Junpei Komiyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OP²SD方法，证明了OPSD的收益并非主要来自参考解的特权信息，而是来自教师上下文诱导的行为，为理解自蒸馏机制提供了新视角。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD通常被解释为特权信息的传递，但这种解释混淆了两个效应：参考解既揭示了答案，也改变了教师提供监督的上下文。研究旨在解耦这两个因素，探究目标特定特权的真实作用。

Method: 提出OP²SD方法，用不同问题的解替换配对参考解，同时保留学生rollout、教师和蒸馏目标，从而分离参考解特权信息与教师上下文的影响。

Result: 在三个模型和三个数学基准上，OP²SD优于基础模型，与OPSD表现相当，表明OPSD的提升不必依赖参考解访问权限。

Conclusion: OPSD的效果主要来源于教师上下文诱导行为而非参考解的特权信息，这为理解自蒸馏机制和设计新方法提供了重要启示。

Abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) is commonly interpreted as the transfer of privileged information: a teacher observes the verified solution to the target problem and supervises the student's trajectory. However, this interpretation conflates two effects. The reference solution not only reveals the answer to the current instance but also changes the context under which the teacher provides token-level supervision. We investigate the role of target-specific privilege with $\mathrm{OP}^{2}\mathrm{SD}$ (On-Policy Self-Distillation from Other Problems), which replaces the paired reference with a problem and solution from a different example, while preserving the student rollout, teacher, and distillation objective. Across three models and three mathematics benchmarks, $\mathrm{OP}^{2}\mathrm{SD}$ improves over the base model, remains competitive with OPSD. The success of $\mathrm{OP}^{2}\mathrm{SD}$ implies that OPSD gains do not necessarily come from access to the reference solution, and that the teacher's context-induced behavior is an important factor.

</details>


### [127] [DreOPD: Degraded-Reference Extrapolative On-Policy Distillation for Flow-matching Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09233)
*Mingfeng Lin,Chengfei Cai,Lin Xu,Yuxiang Wei,Liang Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了DreOPD方法，将隐式奖励外推转化为闭式速度回归，实现了流匹配模型的高效后训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配模型在下游场景适应中依赖后训练，可能引发任务特定优化目标间的冲突。强化学习虽能直接优化任务奖励，但轨迹级优化会产生高方差梯度和跨任务干扰。现有的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽能提供稳定监督，但仍是基于模仿学习。

Method: 提出退参考外推式在线策略蒸馏（DreOPD）方法，将隐式奖励外推转化为闭式速度回归，实现了具有OPD稳定性的外推式后训练；引入轻度退化的参考来增强教师-参考对比，从而获得更清晰的外推方向。

Result: 在单教师和多教师设置实验中，DreOPD在平均性能上优于OPD和多任务强化学习基线，且在大多数指标上超越专业化教师模型。

Conclusion: DreOPD成功连接了强化学习与在线策略蒸馏两种范式，为流匹配模型的下游任务适应提供了更稳定高效的解决方案，在性能上取得了显著提升。

Abstract: Flow-matching models are now a mainstream method to image generation, but its adaptation to diverse downstream scenarios typically relies on post-training, which may cause conflicts among task-specific optimization objectives. Reinforcement learning enables direct optimization of task-specific rewards beyond the original models, yet trajectory-level optimization may incur high-variance gradients and cross-task interference. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense and stable supervision on student rollouts, but conventional teacher matching remains imitation-based. We propose DreOPD, a Degraded-reference extrapolative OPD method for flow-matching models that bridges these two paradigms. Our DreOPD converts implicit reward extrapolation into closed-form velocity regression, enabling extrapolative post-training with the stability of OPD. It further uses a mildly degraded reference to strengthen the teacher-reference contrast, yielding a clearer extrapolation direction. Experiments on single- and multi-teacher settings show that DreOPD outperforms OPD and multi-task RL baselines in average performance, while surpassing specialized teachers on most metrics.

</details>


### [128] [Label Granularity Skew in Federated Learning with Hierarchical Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09236)
*Jaeheon Kim,Hokeun Kim,Bong Jun Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对联邦分层分类中存在的标签粒度偏斜问题，提出FedBDFT方法，通过分支解耦微调策略显著提升模型在异构标签粒度下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦学习研究主要关注数据分布异构性，但在实际应用中，客户端还存在领域知识和标注能力差异。本文首次提出标签粒度偏斜（label granularity skew）这一新型统计异构性，即在共享类层次结构下，不同客户端提供不同详细程度的分类标签，这给联邦分层分类带来新的挑战。

Method: 首先，使用概率关系邻居分类器生成客户端特定的局部标签层次结构，并通过基于轮廓分数的粗粒化方法构建WordNet引导的层次结构。通过分析发现，强耦合层次模型对不完整监督敏感，而条件softmax分类器更具鲁棒性。基于此洞察，提出分支解耦微调（BDFT）及其联邦版本FedBDFT，通过分支级别的分类器微调和联邦优化聚合来处理标签粒度异构性。

Result: 在CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet和ImageNet数据集上的实验表明，FedBDFT在严重标签粒度偏斜下显著提升性能，在偏斜度0.6和0.9时分别获得27.9%和56.4%的平均增益。零样本实验进一步显示，FedBDFT能更好地保留未见细粒度类别的层次表示。

Conclusion: 本研究首次识别并解决联邦分层分类中的标签粒度偏斜问题，提出的FedBDFT方法有效增强了异构标签粒度下的模型鲁棒性，为零样本细粒度类别识别和实际联邦学习应用提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Federated learning enables privacy-preserving collaboration across distributed devices without centralizing local data. However, clients may differ not only in data distributions but also in domain knowledge and annotation capabilities. In this paper, we introduce label granularity skew, a new form of statistical heterogeneity in federated hierarchical classification, in which clients provide taxonomy-consistent labels at different levels of detail within a shared class hierarchy. To model this heterogeneity, we generate client-specific local label hierarchies using a probabilistic relational neighbor classifier and construct a WordNet-guided hierarchy via silhouette score-based coarsening. Our analysis shows that strongly coupled hierarchical models are sensitive to incomplete supervision, while the conditional softmax classifier is more robust. Based on this insight, we propose Branch-wise Decoupled Fine-Tuning (BDFT) and its federated version, FedBDFT, which fine-tune branch-wise classifiers and aggregate them through federated optimization. Experiments on CIFAR-100, TinyImageNet, and ImageNet show that FedBDFT substantially improves robustness under severe label granularity skew, with average gains of 27.9% and 56.4% at skewness levels of 0.6 and 0.9, respectively. Zero-shot results further indicate that FedBDFT better preserves hierarchical representations for unseen fine-grained classes. These findings demonstrate its effectiveness for federated hierarchical classification with heterogeneous label granularities.

</details>


### [129] [Multimodal Federated Learning under Dual-Axis Modality Missingness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09240)
*Adiba Orzikulova,Jaehyun Kwak,Jaemin Shin,Yunqi Guo,Xiaomin Ouyang,Guoliang Xing,Steven Euijong Whang,Sung-Ju Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Flux框架通过模态感知置信度调节和梯度解耦私有适应，有效解决多模态联邦学习中的双重模态缺失问题，在四个数据集上平均macro-F1提升1.6分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在隐私敏感的健康感知和医疗场景中，多模态联邦学习面临双重轴模态缺失问题：客户端具有不同的模态集，且单个样本可能仅包含本地可用模态的子集。现有方法通常将这两个轴分开处理，缺乏统一的解决方案。

Method: 提出Flux框架，包含两个互补组件：(1) 模态感知置信度调节：通过掩码感知的单模态监督学习每个模态的样本特定置信度，将观测模态的置信度估计融合为样本自适应温度，根据证据质量和完整性调整预测锐度；(2) 梯度解耦私有适应：将温度仅应用于客户端私有预测路径，而使用标准的无温度目标训练共享联邦模型，实现样本特定、客户端本地的置信度适应，同时避免置信度依赖梯度干扰共享表示学习。

Result: 在四个多模态数据集上，Flux在每个数据集上均取得最高平均macro-F1，相比最强数据集特定基线提升0.8~2.2分，平均提升1.6分。此外，该方法展现出良好的校准性能、温度对模态缺失和输入损坏的敏感性，以及私有温度调节下更稳定的共享优化。

Conclusion: Flux框架有效解决了多模态联邦学习中的双重模态缺失挑战，通过创新的置信度调节和梯度解耦机制，在保持共享表示学习稳定性的同时实现了样本级的自适应适应，为实际的隐私敏感医疗场景提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Multimodal federated learning (FL) supports collaborative modeling in privacy-sensitive health-sensing and medical settings, but realistic deployments often exhibit dual-axis modality missingness: clients have different modality sets, and individual samples may contain only subsets of the modalities available locally. Existing methods typically address these two axes separately. We propose Flux, a multimodal federated learning framework built around two complementary components. First, modality-aware confidence tempering learns sample-specific confidence for each modality through mask-aware unimodal supervision and fuses the confidence estimates from observed modalities into a sample-adaptive temperature that adjusts predictive sharpness according to evidence quality and completeness. Second, gradient-decoupled private adaptation applies this temperature only to a client-private prediction pathway, while training the shared federated model with a standard, untempered objective. This enables sample-specific, client-local confidence adaptation without allowing confidence-dependent gradients to perturb shared representation learning. Across four multimodal datasets, Flux achieves the highest average macro-F1 on every dataset, outperforming the strongest dataset-specific baseline by 0.8~2.2 points and by 1.6 points on average. Additional analyses demonstrate favorable calibration, temperature sensitivity to both modality missingness and input corruption, and more stable shared optimization under private-only tempering. Our code is available at https://github.com/AdibaOrz/Flux.

</details>


### [130] [Full-Feature versus Limited-Input Machine Learning for Residential Energy Estimation: A Comparative Analysis of RECS and ResStock Under Realistic Input Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09255)
*Aditya Ramnarayan,Fatih Evren,Patti Gunderson,Samuel Rosenberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过对比全特征模型和受限输入模型，量化了住宅能耗预测准确性与输入数据可获得性之间的权衡，发现在数据受限情况下算法复杂性无法完全弥补物理和行为信息的缺失，但针对同质性群体的定向建模可显著提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在详细的建筑围护结构特征、设备效率、渗透率、传感器或账单数据可用之前，往往需要对住宅能耗进行估算。现有研究缺乏对预测准确性与输入数据可获得性之间权衡的量化分析，特别是在实际部署条件下如何平衡模型复杂度和数据收集负担。

Method: 使用两个具有美国全国代表性的住宅能耗数据集（基于调查的RECS和基于仿真的ResStock），构建全特征模型建立性能基准，随后将特征限制为十个低负担变量（可从住户、行政记录或天气数据获取，无需现场能耗审计）。比较CatBoost、XGBoost、LightGBM、随机森林和神经网络五种算法的预测性能，并对ResStock中同质性群体（2000-2010年建造的天然气供暖独栋住宅，气候区6A）进行定向建模分析。

Result: 全特征分析中CatBoost表现最佳（ResStock: R²=0.90，RECS: R²=0.73）。当特征限制为十个住户可获取输入时，模型性能收敛至RECS R²=0.61和ResStock R²=0.62，表明算法复杂性无法完全弥补缺失的物理和行为信息。针对同质性群体的简化输入模型将准确率提升至R²=0.85，验证了定向建模对同质性群体的价值。

Conclusion: 树集成模型可作为全国尺度住宅能耗数据集的高保真模拟器，但需谨慎考虑特征可获得性、数据集来源（实证vs合成）及适用场景。研究为能耗预测的实际应用提供了准确性与数据收集负担之间的量化参考，为面向特定同质性群体的定向建模策略提供了实证支持。

Abstract: Residential energy estimates are often needed before detailed envelope characteristics, equipment efficiencies, infiltration, sensor, or billing data are available. This study quantifies the trade-off between predictive accuracy and input accessibility using two nationally representative U.S. residential-energy datasets: the survey-based Residential Energy Consumption Survey (RECS) and the simulation-based ResStock dataset. Full-feature models were first used to establish dataset-specific performance benchmarks. For total-energy estimation, the models were subsequently restricted to ten low-burden variables obtainable from occupants, administrative records, or location-based weather data without an on-site energy audit. Among CatBoost, XGBoost, LightGBM, Random Forest, and Neural Networks, CatBoost consistently achieved the highest predictive performance for the full-feature analysis, reaching R2 = 0.90 for ResStock and R2 = 0.73 for RECS. When the feature set was restricted to ten homeowner-accessible inputs to simulate realistic deployment conditions, model performance converged to R2 = 0.61 for RECS and R2 = 0.62 for ResStock, showing that algorithmic complexity cannot fully compensate for missing physical and behavioral information. However, for a more homogeneous ResStock cohort consisting of single-family detached, natural-gas-heated homes in Climate Zone 6A constructed between 2000 and 2010, a reduced-input model improved accuracy to R2 = 0.85, demonstrating the value of targeted modeling for homogeneous populations. The results indicate that tree-based ensemble models can serve as high-fidelity emulators of national-scale residential energy datasets. However, careful consideration of feature availability, dataset origin (empirical vs. synthetic), and applicable use cases are also important.

</details>


### [131] [SoftmaxGRPO: Learning to Reason using Softmax Advantage Group Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09271)
*Jefferson Hernandez,Jaywon Koo,Zilin Xiao,Chen Wei,Vicente Ordonez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了SoftmaxGRPO方法，通过温度缩放的softmax优势替代z分数归一化的组优势，解决了GRPO在二元奖励下对简单提示权重发散的问题，在多个任务上显著优于原始GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于组的强化学习目标（如GRPO）在不同难度的提示上分配学习信号不佳：在二元奖励下，组归一化会对简单提示产生发散的权重，导致学习信号分配不合理。

Method: 提出Softmax Advantage Group Estimation (SoftmaxGRPO)，用温度缩放的softmax优势替代z分数归一化的组优势，使权重在任何提示难度下都保持有界。对二元奖励推导了精确的有限组群体目标，识别MaxRL为其低温极限；对有界标量奖励证明了大规模组更新优化log矩生成函数目标。

Result: 实验显示SoftmaxGRPO将梯度预算从近解决的提示重新分配，在相同奖励下一致优于GRPO。在DeepMath可验证奖励任务上达到51.8%，在Poetry任务上仅用轻量级文本相似度奖励将1.5B指令微调模型从35.0%提升至68.0%。

Conclusion: SoftmaxGRPO作为GRPO的直接替代方案，有效解决了组归一化的权重发散问题，在数学推理和创意写作等多个领域均展现出显著性能提升，为基于组的强化学习提供了更稳健的目标函数。

Abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning objectives such as GRPO can allocate learning signal poorly across prompt difficulty: under binary rewards, group normalization induces a divergent weighting on easy prompts. We introduce Softmax Advantage Group Estimation (SoftmaxGRPO), a drop-in alternative that replaces z-score-normalized group advantages with temperature-scaled softmax advantages, keeping weights bounded regardless of prompt difficulty. For binary rewards, we derive the exact finite-group population objective and identify MaxRL as its low-temperature limit. For bounded scalar rewards, we show that the large-group update exactly optimizes a log-moment-generating-function objective, while a universal finite-group scalar objective cannot exist without additional assumptions on the reward distribution. Empirically, SoftmaxGRPO reallocates measured gradient budget away from near-solved prompts and consistently improves over GRPO under identical rewards. It reaches 51.8% on DeepMath with verifiable rewards and improves a 1.5B instruction-tuned model from 35.0% to 68.0% on Poetry using only lightweight text-similarity rewards.

</details>


### [132] [VeinCast: Physics-Guided Dynamic Field Graphs with Graph-Conditioned Fusion for Global Medium-Range Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09286)
*Zhisheng Chen,Jinhan Li,Yuxuan Li,Yuan Gao,Hao Wu,Zheng Lu,Jinlong Du,Kun Wang,Bo An*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了VeinCast，一种物理引导的动态场图和图条件融合框架，用于全球中期天气预报，在69个气象场的14天预报任务中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的数据驱动天气预报模型主要通过隐式学习大气场间的交互关系，而方程级物理约束可能引入近似偏差和模型形式偏差。需要一种能够显式建模结构化且状态依赖的异构大气场交互的方法。

Method: 提出了VeinCast框架，包含两个核心模块：（1）物理引导动态场图：将预定义的大气关系与状态依赖的Top-K残差边相结合，并利用生成的图上下文调整地球窗口注意力机制；（2）图条件潜在融合：利用图上下文和源节点中心性引导场到潜在空间的聚合，同时通过有界反馈保留场特定信息。

Result: 在1.5° ERA5基准测试上，VeinCast在69个气象场的14天预报中展现出与FuXi、Pangu-Weather、GraphCast、FengWu和ARROW等代表性全球天气预报模型相当的性能。消融实验证实两个模块提供互补性增益。

Conclusion: 关系级物理指导对数据驱动天气预报具有有效性，VeinCast成功地将物理约束与数据驱动方法相结合，为全球中期天气预报提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Global medium-range weather forecasting requires modeling structured yet state-dependent interactions among heterogeneous atmospheric fields. Existing data-driven models largely learn these interactions implicitly, whereas equation-level physical constraints may inherit approximation and model-form biases. We present VeinCast, a physics-guided dynamic field graph and graph-conditioned fusion framework that jointly forecasts 69 surface and upper-air fields. Within each local window, its Physics-Guided Dynamic Field Graph combines predefined atmospheric relations with state-dependent Top-K residual edges and adapts Earth-window attention using the resulting graph context. Graph-Conditioned Latent Fusion further employs graph context and source-node centrality to guide field-to-latent aggregation, while bounded feedback preserves field-specific information. On the $1.5^\circ$ ERA5 benchmark, VeinCast demonstrates competitive forecasting performance across all 69 meteorological fields at lead times of up to 14 days, compared with representative global weather forecasting models including FuXi, Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, FengWu, and ARROW. Ablations confirm that the two modules provide complementary gains, demonstrating the effectiveness of relational-level physical guidance for data-driven weather forecasting.

</details>


### [133] [Beyond the Capability Boundary: Zeroth-Order Optimization for Self-Evolving LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09292)
*Bingzhen Liu,Xiaomeng Fan,Yuwei Wu,Zhi Gao,Mingyang Gao,Chuanhao Li,Yunde Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种零阶自进化框架，通过扰动LLM的LoRA参数来估计梯度并更新模型，使智能体能够突破其固有能力边界进行学习，在困难样本上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自进化方法通过采样轨迹并从中学习来提升LLM智能体能力，但受限于智能体固有的能力边界——在困难样本上无法采样到正确轨迹，因而无法进一步提升。为突破这一能力边界，需要一种不依赖正确轨迹标注的学习方法。

Method: 提出零阶自进化框架：1）扰动LLM的LoRA参数；2）运行智能体并计算扰动参数和原始参数下的损失；3）利用损失差异估计梯度并更新LoRA参数；4）使用更新后的LLM采样轨迹进行监督微调。引入并行扰动推理机制和自适应查找机制降低零阶优化的时间消耗，并设计答案困惑度损失以提供平滑稳定的零阶损失值。

Result: 在多个深度研究基准测试上的实验表明，该方法能够获得显著更多的成功轨迹，并且持续优于强基线方法，尤其在困难样本上表现突出。

Conclusion: 零阶自进化框架能够有效突破LLM智能体的固有能力边界，通过参数扰动和梯度估计实现无轨迹标注的学习，为智能体在困难任务上的能力提升提供了新的技术路径。代码和发布资源已开源。

Abstract: Self-evolving methods improve the capabilities of LLM agents by sampling trajectories from the underlying LLMs and learning from these trajectories. However, these methods struggle to learn beyond the inherent capability boundary of the agents, since the agents cannot sample correct trajectories on difficult examples for further improvements. In this paper, we propose a zeroth-order self-evolution framework that enables agents to learn beyond their capability boundary by perturbing LLM parameters to adapt to difficult examples without any trajectory annotations. Specifically, we perturb LoRA parameters of LLMs, run the agent, compute the losses under the perturbed and original parameters, and use the loss difference to estimate gradients and further update the LoRA parameters. We sample trajectories using the updated LLMs for supervised fine-tuning to break through the capability boundary of the agents, forming a closed self-evolution loop. We introduce a parallel perturbation inference mechanism and an adaptive lookup mechanism to reduce time consumption in zeroth-order optimization, with an answer perplexity loss that provides smooth and stable zeroth-order loss values. Experiments on multiple deep research benchmarks show that our method obtains substantially more successful trajectories and consistently outperforms strong baselines, especially on difficult examples. The code and released artifacts are available at https://github.com/hidk1911/ZOForLLMAgents.

</details>


### [134] [Targeted Label-Flipping and Oversampling Attacks on Federated Conditional GANs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09314)
*Panav Shah,Avishek Ghosh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了联邦GAN中的标签翻转攻击，通过理论和实验证明攻击有效性强但难以检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦GAN训练中存在多种对抗攻击，其中标签翻转攻击通过恶意客户端篡改标签信息来操纵全局生成器，使其在目标标签条件下生成源类别的样本。研究这种攻击的有效性对于理解联邦学习系统的脆弱性至关重要。

Method: 通过理论分析和实验评估研究标签翻转攻击的有效性，并提出过采样变体，使恶意客户端在本地训练中增加中毒样本权重以放大对全局模型的影响。使用KL散度量化干净分布与中毒分布之间的分布偏移。

Result: 在FEMNIST、MNIST和CIFAR10数据集上的实验表明，攻击的语义损害随有效中毒强度线性增长，而对真实目标分布的偏离仅呈二次增长，使攻击既有效又难以通过标签无关指标检测。

Conclusion: 标签翻转攻击在联邦GAN中具有显著威胁性，攻击效果与检测难度之间存在不对称性，揭示了联邦学习系统在对抗攻击面前的脆弱性。

Abstract: In a federated learning setup for GANs, several adversarial attacks are possible. One such attack is label flipping, in which malicious clients deliberately alter label information during local training in order to manipulate the global generator. The objective of this attack is to skew the learned generation distribution so that samples conditioned on a target label are instead mapped to a source class. In this work, we investigate the effectiveness of label flipping attacks in federated GANs through both theoretical analysis and empirical evaluation. We further consider an oversampling based variant, in which malicious clients upweight poisoned samples during local training to amplify their influence on the aggregated global model. We quantify the resulting distributional shift by computing the Kullback Leibler divergence between the clean and poisoned class conditional distributions, and show both analytically and on FEMNIST, MNIST, and CIFAR10 that the semantic damage of the attack grows linearly in the effective poisoning strength while deviation from the true target distribution grows only quadratically, making the attack effective yet difficult to detect from label agnostic metrics.

</details>


### [135] [MaxModShift: Model Privacy via Designed Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09328)
*Nomaan A. Kherani,Urbashi Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了MaxModShift方案，通过信号设计使窃听者的Fisher信息矩阵奇异，从而保护联邦学习中的模型隐私，相比现有方法性能更优且功耗更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在联邦学习环境中，防止窃听者通过监听通信来学习模型是一个重要的隐私保护问题。现有方法如噪声注入需要较高的带宽和功耗，因此需要设计更高效的模型保护方案。

Method: 将窃听者的模型学习建模为估计问题，通过信号设计使窃听者估计问题的Fisher信息矩阵趋于奇异。提出两种模型偏移方案，设计模型偏移以最大化Eve和中央服务器学习的模型差异，同时满足传输功率约束。

Result: MaxModShift方案在性能上优于先前的ModShift设计，且需要更低的传输功率。与噪声注入方案相比，MaxModShift在需要更低带宽秘密信道和更低平均功耗的情况下表现更好。

Conclusion: MaxModShift方案通过优化的信号设计有效保护了联邦学习中的模型隐私，在性能、带宽需求和功耗方面均优于现有方法，为联邦学习的安全通信提供了更高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Model learning by an eavesdropper is treated as an estimation problem in a federated environment. The Fisher Information Matrix for the eavesdropper's estimation problem is driven to singularity through a signaling design; this ensures that the eavesdropper cannot learn the model. Herein, the innovation of prior designs is that model shifts are designed to maximize the difference in the model learned by Eve and the central server while satisfying a transmission power constraint for the agents. Two shift schemes are provided. MaxModShift outperforms a prior ModShift design while requiring lesser transmission power. Compared to a noise injection scheme, MaxModShift performs better while requiring a lower bandwidth secret channel and a reduced average power consumption.

</details>


### [136] [Hallucinations and Constraints : Regulating surgical workflow recognition beyond accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09332)
*John S. H. Baxter,Pierre Jannin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将医学图像处理中的拓扑错误视为幻觉，并通过概率图模型显式约束线性时序逻辑谓词，有效提升了手术阶段识别的准确性并消除了大部分拓扑错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 幻觉是人工智能融入医学的主要担忧，但在医学图像处理领域探索较少。与自然语言理解不同，医学图像和信号预测的正确性判断不够直观，需要可量化的幻觉定义以实现有效监管。

Method: 提出将拓扑错误视为可测量的幻觉形式；针对生物医学信号分割等任务，将特定属性表述为线性时序逻辑谓词；利用概率图模型对这些谓词进行显式约束，确保预测满足拓扑正确性。

Result: 在机器人辅助子宫切除术的自动手术阶段识别任务中，准确率提升约10%，同时消除了绝大多数拓扑错误，验证了显式约束谓词的有效性。

Conclusion: 数学正确性保证可以作为机器学习在医学图像计算和计算机辅助干预中的补充监管手段，与经验性监管方法相结合，为AI在医学中的应用提供更可靠的安全保障。

Abstract: Hallucinations are a major concern for the integration of artificial intelligence into medicine, although less explored in the realm of medical image processing. Unlike problems in natural text understanding and reasoning therewith, determining whether or not predictions derived from biomedical images and signals is less intuitively clear. This article suggests that topological errors could constitute hallucinations in a way that can be more readily measured and thus regulated. Certain of these properties for certain types of problems, such as biomedical signal segmentation, can be rephrased as linear temporal logic predicates, a number of which can be explicitly enforced using probabilistic graphical models. Our simulations show the potential of these explicitly constrained predicates for the case of automatic surgical phase recognition in robot-assisted hysterectomy, improving accuracy by approximately 10% while removing the vast majority of topological errors, suggesting that mathematical guarantees of correctness can supplement other empirical forms of regulating machine learning in medical image computing and computer-assisted interventions.

</details>


### [137] [In-Context Density Estimation for Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09348)
*Patryk Marszałek,Jacek Tabor,Marek Śmieja*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了ICED，一个基于Transformer的上下文密度估计器，能够用单一冻结模型同时处理密度估计、分布外检测、无监督异常检测和生成增强四个任务，无需针对每个数据集进行训练或调优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的表格数据密度估计方法（用于异常检测、分布外检测、数据增强等）通常需要为每个数据集单独训练模型并进行超参数调优，这带来了高昂的计算成本和工程负担。虽然这些任务本质上都归结为估计概率质量分布的问题，但现有方法将它们视为独立的问题分别处理，缺乏统一的解决方案。

Method: ICED采用基于Transformer的架构，在合成先验数据上进行预训练。该方法设计了专门的密度估计目标函数，在有信息量的区域拟合对数密度，在其他区域保持其排序关系。推理时，ICED将整个数据集作为上下文输入，通过单次前向传播输出任意查询点的非归一化对数密度，无需针对特定数据集进行拟合、采样或超参数选择。

Result: 单个冻结的ICED模型在密度估计、分布外检测、无监督异常检测和生成增强四个任务上，均能达到与最强任务特定方法相媲美的性能。ICED是唯一一个无需重训练、无需调优、无需标签即可在四个任务间切换的方法。

Conclusion: ICED成功实现了密度估计任务的统一框架，消除了每个数据集的训练和调优成本。该方法证明了通过上下文学习构建通用密度估计器的可行性，为表格数据的无监督学习任务提供了一种高效且灵活的解决方案。

Abstract: Density estimation underlies many unsupervised tasks on tabular data such as anomaly detection, out-of-distribution detection, and data augmentation. Although all these problems reduce to questions about where probability mass lies, they are typically solved individually by fitting a separate model to each dataset, with its own hyperparameters and tuning budget. We introduce ICED, an in-context, energy-based density estimator that removes this per-dataset cost. ICED is a transformer-based model pretrained once on a synthetic prior built specifically for density estimation under an objective that fits log-density where it is informative and preserves its ordering elsewhere. In the inference, it reads a dataset as context and returns an unnormalized log-density for any query point in a single forward pass, with no fitting, sampling, or hyperparameter selection. A single frozen ICED model then drives four tasks usually handled by four specialized pipelines: density estimation, out-of-distribution detection, unsupervised anomaly detection, and generative augmentation. Across all four, it is competitive with the strongest task-specific method, while being the only approach that needs no retraining, no tuning, and no labels to move between them. The code is available at https://github.com/gmum/iced.

</details>


### [138] [Test-Time Augmentation for LLMs: When Input Diversity Beats Output Diversity at Matched Compute](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09351)
*Nikita Kozodoi,Zainab Afolabi,Jack Butler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出测试时增强（TTA）方法，通过输入端扰动提升大语言模型推理效率。实验表明语义重述在成本效益上帕累托优于自一致性，准确率/美元比提升约1.8倍，在五个任务上超越自一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时扩展提升LLM准确率但成倍增加推理成本，部署中关键指标是单位计算获得的准确率。现有自一致性方法仅在输出端采样多次推理路径，作者探索输入端多样性是否能更高效地将计算转化为准确率。

Method: 提出测试时增强（TTA），扩展自一致性方法，不仅采样输出，还对输入进行扰动（语义重述、词汇扰动、视觉变换），跨变换版本的输入聚合预测。在六个数据集上进行匹配计算量的系统比较，涵盖通用知识、多语言、数学推理、多模态QA和情感分类。

Result: 语义重述在五个任务上超越自一致性，成本效益帕累托优，准确率/美元比约1.8倍提升。TTA对中等规模模型最具成本效益，当更强模型不可用或过于昂贵时表现最佳。输入变换比单纯改变推理路径更高效。

Conclusion: 对当前中等规模LLM，改变输入比仅改变推理路径更能高效地将推理计算转化为准确率。TTA为中等规模模型提供了一种实用的部署策略选择。

Abstract: Test-time scaling improves LLM accuracy but multiplies inference cost, making the accuracy gained per unit of compute the metric that matters in deployment. Self-consistency is one of the established approaches, which spends this budget entirely on the output side by sampling repeated reasoning paths. We study Test-Time Augmentation (TTA), which extends self-consistency by also perturbing the input, aggregating predictions across transformed versions of the input, and ask whether input-side diversity converts compute into accuracy more efficiently than output-side diversity. We perform a systematic, matched-compute comparison: we evaluate three simple input-side strategies (semantic rephrasing, lexical perturbations, and visual transformations) across six datasets covering general and multilingual knowledge, mathematical reasoning, multi-modal question answering, and sentiment classification, against chain-of-thought prompting and self-consistency. Semantic rephrasing delivers consistent and statistically significant accuracy gains while Pareto-dominating self-consistency on cost-effectiveness, delivering roughly 1.8X more accuracy per dollar and outperforming it on five of six tasks. We further analyze the number of augmentations, multi-modal strategies, and base model scaling, finding that TTA is most cost-effective for mid-tier models where a stronger model is unavailable or too expensive. Our findings indicate that for current mid-tier LLMs, varying the input converts inference compute into accuracy more efficiently than varying the reasoning path alone. The TTA implementation is available at https://github.com/aws-samples/sample-genai-reflection-for-bedrock.

</details>


### [139] [Beyond Binary: Continuous State Optimization with Graph-Structured Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09366)
*Corinna Cortes,Yishay Mansour,Mehryar Mohri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将多目标优化问题从二元状态空间扩展到连续状态空间，提出了Lazy Graph-LinUCB算法来解决探索与系统稳定性之间的矛盾，并通过三种机制（异步更新、自适应图学习、联合估计器）充分利用图结构，在保持累积损失相近的同时将移动成本降低了三倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模学习系统需要在公平性、准确性和延迟等多个可能相互竞争的目标之间进行平衡。现有工作将此形式化为二元状态空间上的优化问题，但现实世界中的控制参数（如公平性阈值、多样性混合率、资源预算）通常是连续的，需要扩展到连续状态空间的框架。

Method: 将问题建模为在移动成本约束下最小化线性目标之和，使用依赖图（因子图）捕获目标的局部结构。提出Lazy Graph-LinUCB算法，通过惰性更新最小化切换成本，同时保持近似最优的遗憾。进一步引入三种机制：异步更新调度（消除稀疏图中的同步开销）、自适应算法（从数据学习图结构）、联合估计器（利用相关目标间的数据共享紧化遗憾边界）。

Result: 实验表明，结构利用机制在异构系统中将移动成本降低超过三倍，同时保持相似的累积损失。算法在保持性能的同时显著提升了系统稳定性。

Conclusion: 本文成功将多目标优化扩展到连续状态空间，提出的算法和机制有效解决了探索与稳定性的平衡问题，为大规模学习系统的多目标控制提供了实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Large-scale learning systems often face the challenge of balancing multiple,
  potentially competing objectives, such as fairness, accuracy, and
  latency. While recent work has formalized this as an optimization problem over
  binary states, many real-world control parameters, such as fairness
  thresholds, diversity mixing rates, or resource budgets, are continuous. In
  this work, we extend the framework to \emph{continuous state spaces}. We model
  the problem as minimizing a sum of linear objectives subject to \emph{movement
  costs} that penalize system instability. We capture the local structure of
  the objectives using a \emph{dependency graph} (or factor graph), where each
  objective is determined by a subset of the state attributes. To address the
  tension between exploration and stability, we propose \emph{Lazy
  Graph-LinUCB}, an algorithm that performs lazy updates to minimize switching
  costs while maintaining near-optimal regret. Beyond stability, we introduce
  three advanced mechanisms to exploit the underlying graph structure: (1) an
  \emph{asynchronous} update schedule that eliminates synchronization overhead
  in sparse graphs; (2) an \emph{adaptive} algorithm that learns the graph
  structure from data; and (3) a \emph{joint estimator} that leverages data
  sharing among correlated objectives to significantly tighten regret
  bounds. Empirically, we demonstrate that these structural exploitations reduce
  movement costs by more than a factor of three in heterogeneous systems while
  maintaining similar cumulative losses.

</details>


### [140] [Imaginative Generative AI: Crossing the Entropy Wall into Worlds Beyond Imitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09385)
*Hossein Goli,Farzan Farnia,Amin Gohari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了想象式生成AI（IGA）框架，通过控制谱多样性将生成任务从单纯模仿数据分布扩展到修复多样性损失和超越数据多样性的想象生成，并提供了无需重训练的推理时引导方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成AI模型主要设计目标是模仿数据分布，这一目标既无法纠正生成器损失的多样性，也未定义生成应如何超越数据本身的多样性。当前方法缺乏对生成多样性的显式控制和设计机制。

Method: 引入IGA框架，将多样性纳入目标分布设计：在接近参考分布的分布中，选择谱多样性达到预设水平的分布。使用von Neumann熵度量生成分布的核协方差算子谱多样性，定义"熵墙"作为数据分布的谱熵界限。提出熵约束投影理论，证明在KL锚定下最优解满足自洽指数倾斜关系，由此推导出IGA Guidance——一种适用于基于分数和扩散模型（包括DDPM和DDIM）的无需重训练推理时方法。

Result: 在合成数据和视觉基准测试上的实验表明：IGA能在熵墙以下实现多样性修复，恢复生成器损失的变异；在熵墙以上实现受控的谱外推，产生比数据分布更高谱多样性的分布。方法成功实现了从模仿到想象的单一正则化路径。

Conclusion: IGA框架成功将多样性显式纳入生成目标，提供了从模仿到想象的统一理论基础和实用方法。通过熵墙概念区分了多样性修复与想象生成两种机制，为生成AI的多样性控制提供了新范式。

Abstract: Generative AI models are primarily designed to imitate the data distribution, an objective that neither corrects diversity lost by a learned generator nor defines how generation should extend beyond the diversity of the data itself. We introduce Imaginative Generative AI (IGA), a framework that makes diversity part of the target-distribution design problem: among distributions close to a reference, IGA selects one whose spectral diversity reaches a prescribed level. Diversity is measured by the von Neumann entropy of the generated distribution's kernel covariance operator in a fixed representation space, providing a reference-free representation-guided measure of how broadly probability mass occupies embedding directions. The spectral entropy of the population data distribution defines an Entropy Wall. Below the wall, IGA performs diversity repair, recovering variation that a learned generator has lost while remaining within the diversity level of the data. Beyond the wall, the data distribution itself becomes infeasible, and IGA deliberately departs from it to produce distributions with greater representation-relative spectral diversity, an operational notion of imaginative generation. These regimes form a single regularization path from imitation to imagination and define an i.i.d. target distribution at each prescribed diversity level. We develop the theory of this entropy-constrained projection and show that, under a KL anchor to a pretrained generator, the optimum satisfies a self-consistent exponential-tilt relation. This characterization leads to IGA Guidance, a retraining-free inference-time method for score-based and diffusion models, including DDPM and DDIM samplers. Experiments on synthetic and vision benchmarks demonstrate diversity repair below the Entropy Wall and controlled spectral extrapolation beyond it.

</details>


### [141] [From Objectives to What Models Learn: A Landau Theory of Invariant Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09396)
*Pinli Wang,Yue He,Peng Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于Landau型有效自由能的理论框架，用于理解和预测不变学习目标的正则化路径行为，将低阶目标签名映射为正则化表型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不变学习寻求跨环境保持预测性的表示，但其目标函数在正则化路径上的行为往往不透明，存在目标行为差距。现有方法缺乏对正则化如何影响模型学习内容的系统性理解，需要建立目标函数结构与正则化行为之间的显式联系。

Method: 将表示学习建模为多模式磁化过程，从具体的不变学习目标推导Landau型有效自由能。低阶系数形成目标签名并诱导不同的正则化表型。分析二次、四次及高阶修正对相边界、模式消除、振幅调节和稳定性的影响。在双线性模型中推导闭式相边界和稳态负载，定义选择性保留窗口。进一步扩展到矩阵形式以处理耦合集体模式。

Result: 在规范双线性模型中获得了闭式相边界和稳态负载表达式，识别了捷径模式和稳定模式的临界强度及其选择性保留窗口。控制实验验证了预测的相边界、负载和正则化表型。在一层和两层ReLU网络中，尽管存在深度依赖的尺度偏移，相同签名仍能预测定性正则化路径行为。矩阵扩展给出了谱相边界准则。

Conclusion: 该框架成功地将低阶目标签名转化为正则化表型的预测，进而预测模型在正则化变化时学习的内容。理论不仅揭示了不变学习中正则化路径的结构特性，还为理解深度网络中的正则化行为提供了统一的分析工具。

Abstract: Invariant learning seeks representations that remain predictive across environments, yet the behavior of its objectives along the regularization path is often opaque. We address this objective-behavior gap by viewing representation learning as multimode magnetization and deriving, from concrete invariant-learning objectives, a Landau-type effective free energy whose low-order coefficients form objective signatures and induce distinct regularization phenotypes. Effective quadratic corrections move the phase boundary and enable finite-strength mode elimination; quartic corrections regulate post-onset amplitude and typically leave residual loading at finite strength; higher-order structure governs non-monotone tails, instability, and collapse at large regularization. In a canonical bilinear model, the theory yields closed-form phase boundaries and steady-state loadings, as well as distinct critical strengths for shortcut and stable modes that define a selective-retention window. Controlled experiments confirm the predicted phase boundaries, loadings, and regularization phenotypes. In one- and two-hidden-layer ReLU networks, the same signatures remain predictive of qualitative regularization-path behavior despite depth-dependent shifts in scale. A matrix extension generalizes the framework to coupled collective modes and yields a spectral phase-boundary criterion. Together, the framework turns low-order objective signatures into predictions of regularization phenotypes and, ultimately, of what models learn as regularization varies.

</details>


### [142] [A Mechanistic Diagnostic of Rank Collapse in Post-Norm Decoder Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09417)
*Xingjian Wang,Qingyu Han,Xiaodong Luo,Yin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文深入分析了Post-Norm Transformer中的秩崩塌问题，发现因果注意力在初始化时近似为前缀平均操作，增加了token相似性；一旦进入高相似性区域，RMSNorm的反向因子会变为收缩性的，导致梯度几何衰减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深层仅解码器Transformer中，Post-Norm架构因对warmup和学习率高度敏感而常被Pre-Norm替代。尽管已有研究识别出秩崩塌和梯度消失症状，但仍不清楚因果注意力如何产生高相似性表示以及为何训练动态无法修复此问题。

Method: 提出两阶段分析框架：1）使用token相似性作为标量状态变量，在初始化阶段分析因果注意力的前缀平均效应；2）在高相似性阶段分析RMSNorm反向因子的收缩性质和梯度衰减机制。同时刻画了崩塌网络的性质。

Result: 在48层解码器Transformer上的实验验证了预测的初始化时相似性增长和崩塌时梯度收缩现象。崩塌的运行保持在预测的频率损失附近。实验揭示了前向相似性放大和后向修复无能之间的根本区别。

Conclusion: 成功区分了Post-Norm崩塌中的前向相似性放大与后向修复无能机制，同时刻画了崩塌网络的行为特性。这为理解Post-Norm训练困难提供了理论基础，解释了其相比Pre-Norm变体的劣势。

Abstract: Deep decoder-only Transformers often replace the original Post-Norm architecture with Pre-Norm variants because Post-Norm training is highly sensitive to warmup and learning rate under conventional initialization schemes. Although prior work has identified rank collapse and gradient vanishing as related symptoms, it remains poorly understood how causal attention creates high-similarity representations and why training dynamics fail to repair them. We give a two-stage analysis of Post-Norm rank collapse using token similarity as a scalar state variable. First, at initialization, causal attention acts approximately as a prefix-averaging operator that increases token similarity across depth, while the SwiGLU branch contributes only a smaller damping effect. Second, once training enters a high-similarity regime, growth of pre-normalization residual norms makes the RMSNorm backward factor contractive; under mild conditions, gradients to earlier layers decay geometrically. As a complementary result, we characterize the properties of a collapsed network: its best predictor is frequency distribution with relatively high loss floor, and gradients in collapsed layers vanish at frequency distribution. Experiments on 48-layer decoder-only Transformers trained on C4 dataset match the predicted initialization-time similarity growth and collapse-time gradient contraction, and show that collapsed runs stay near the predicted frequency loss. Together, these results distinguish the forward similarity amplification and backward repair incapacity in Post-Norm collapse, while also characterizing the behavior of collapsed networks.

</details>


### [143] [LITEWAY: LIghtweight HAR via Temporal Efficient highWAY](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09421)
*Dominique Nshimyimana,Vitor Fortes Rey,Mengxi Liu,Bo Zhou,Paul Lukowicz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LITEWAY框架，一种模态无关的全卷积HAR方法，在保持性能的同时显著降低模型大小(最高9.52倍)和能耗(最高3.14倍)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轻量级HAR方法依赖循环架构(GRU/LSTM)，限制了并行性并增加了推理延迟，难以满足资源受限设备的计算和能耗约束。

Method: 提出LITEWAY全卷积框架，用结构化卷积分解替代循环时序建模，结合轻量级卷积块、步幅时序处理和卷积注意力池化来高效捕获时序依赖关系。

Result: 在16个HAR数据集上评估，相比TinyHAR和TinierHAR，模型大小减少4.06x-9.52x(Light版)和3.87x-9.07x(Full版)；部署实验显示能耗降低2.29x-3.14x(Light版)和1.46x-2.01x(Full版)，同时保持有竞争力的宏F1分数。

Conclusion: LITEWAY证明了全卷积时序建模在可穿戴HAR任务中的有效性，为资源受限设备提供了一种高效、模态无关的解决方案。

Abstract: Wearable human activity recognition (HAR) remains challenging due to the computational and energy constraints of deep learning models on resource-limited devices. Existing lightweight approaches often rely on recurrent architectures (e.g., GRU and LSTM), limiting parallelism and increasing inference latency. We propose LITEWAY, a modality-agnostic, fully convolutional framework for multichannel sensor time series that replaces recurrent temporal modeling with structured convolutional decomposition. LITEWAY combines lightweight convolutional blocks, strided temporal processing, and convolution-attention pooling to efficiently capture temporal dependencies while reducing computational complexity. We evaluate LITEWAY on 16 HAR datasets against TinyHAR, TinierHAR, and MLP-HAR. LITEWAY achieves competitive macro F1 while reducing model size by 4.06x-9.52x (Light) and 3.87x-9.07x (Full) compared with TinyHAR and TinierHAR. Deployment experiments further show energy reductions of 2.29x-3.14x (Light) and 1.46x-2.01x (Full) compared with TinierHAR and MLP-HAR, highlighting efficient fully convolutional temporal modeling for wearable HAR. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/dominique-nshimyimana/liteway.

</details>


### [144] [How Simple Can It Get? From Interpretable Equations to Readable Rules for Financial Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09433)
*Adia Lumadjeng,Ilker Birbil,Erman Acar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种从可解释模型出发进行逐步简化的方法，以生成更易读的决策形式，并量化各简化层级的信息损失，为金融等监管领域提供实用的可解释性方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在金融等受监管领域，模型必须具备可解释性才能部署，但许多所谓的可解释分类器生成的公式包含数十个特征，监管者根本无法阅读。现有方法往往是在复杂模型上附加事后解释，而非直接提供可理解的决策规则。

Method: 以一个基于输入特征的单方程可解释分类器为起点，逐步简化为更易读的形式：修剪单项式、方向性if-then规则、以及金融领域常用的整数评分卡和计数。由于该方程本身就是预测模型而非事后解释，可以直接量化每种简化方式下的损失。研究还推导了修剪引起变化的界，并预测仅保留特征效果方向的规则对原始排序的保真度。

Result: 在四个金融数据集上的实验表明，修剪几乎不损失性能；保真度的下降可能快于预测性能的下降，使得更简单的规则能在不忠实复现原始模型的情况下仍保持有效。人类评估显示简化提升了感知可读性，不同表示形式的偏好因专业背景而异。研究还证明了某些损失可以从原始模型中预先预测。

Conclusion: 从可解释模型出发进行简化是一条可行路径，可以在保持预测有效性的同时显著提升可读性。不同简化形式适用于不同背景的用户，且部分信息损失可提前预测，为监管领域提供了理论与实践支持。

Abstract: In regulated domains such as finance, a model that cannot be explained cannot be deployed, yet many interpretable classifiers defeat their own purpose by producing formulas with dozens of features that no regulator could read. We take the reverse direction. Starting from an interpretable classifier expressed as a single equation over the input features, we progressively simplify it into more readable forms, including a pruned monomial, a directional if--then rule, and the integer scorecards and tallies that finance already deploys. Because the equation is itself the predictive model rather than a post-hoc explanation we can directly quantify what is lost under each simplification. Across four financial datasets, we find that pruning is nearly free and that fidelity can erode faster than predictive performance, allowing simpler rules to remain effective classifiers without faithfully reproducing the original model. A human assessment shows that simplification improves perceived readability, while preferences for different representations vary by professional background. Beyond measuring these losses empirically, we show that some can be anticipated from the original model: we derive a bound on the change caused by pruning and predict how faithfully a rule retaining only the direction of each feature's effect preserves the original ranking.

</details>


### [145] [WDL-OPD: Weak-Driven On-Policy Distillation via Mixture-Constrained Co-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09447)
*Zehao Chen,Gongxun Li,Tianxiang Ai,Yifei Li,Zixuan Huang,Wang Zhou,Tao Huang,Fuzhen Zhuang,Xianglong Liu,Jianxin Li,Deqing Wang,Yikun Ban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了WDL-OPD，一种混合约束的协同训练方法，通过双策略（锚点策略+辅助策略）解决在线策略蒸馏中的不稳定性问题，在Qwen3实验中显著提升了数学推理和代码生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽然通过在学生自身轨迹上对齐来减少离线蒸馏的训练-测试状态不匹配问题，但其反馈循环存在不稳定性：每次参数更新都会同时改变策略和下一次更新所依赖的状态分布，导致训练过程不稳定。

Method: 提出WDL-OPD（Weighted Distillation Learning for On-Policy Distillation）：1) 采用双策略协同训练架构，锚点策略生成所有rollout轨迹，辅助策略评估相同访问状态；2) 使用两个策略token分布的几何混合，通过逆向KL散度匹配冻结的教师模型；3) 两个策略都接收梯度更新。冻结辅助策略时退化为类似OPD²和W2S-OPD的锚点-对比代理目标，联合训练则创造静态delta无法表达的分支级自由度。

Result: 在Qwen3的1.7B和4B规模实验中：1) MATH500准确率从0.630提升至0.685（4B），从0.521提升至0.585（1.7B）；2) 代码生成任务中，七个单策略OPD配置出现熵增长或轨迹退化，而协同训练达到独立重新评估的开发分数0.637和0.375；3) 在四个规模-领域设置中均产生最强的学生检查点。

Conclusion: WDL-OPD通过混合约束协同训练有效稳定了在线策略蒸馏过程。尽管部分对比实验在课程或初始化上存在差异，结果支持了稳定性假设。研究提供了完整的训练算法、失败案例证据和受控对比矩阵，为后续验证该假设奠定了基础。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) aligns a student with a teacher on trajectories sampled from the student itself, reducing the train-test state mismatch of offline distillation. The same feedback loop can nevertheless be unstable: each update changes both the policy and the states on which the next update is computed. We introduce WDL-OPD, a mixture-constrained co-training method with two trainable policies. An anchor policy generates every rollout, an auxiliary policy evaluates the same visited states, and a geometric mixture of their token distributions is matched to a frozen teacher by reverse KL. Both policies receive gradient. We show that freezing the auxiliary recovers an anchor-plus-contrast proxy target closely related to OPD$^2$ and W2S-OPD, whereas joint training creates branch-level degrees of freedom that a static delta cannot express. In recorded Qwen3 experiments at 1.7B and 4B scale, WDL-OPD produces the strongest student checkpoint in each of four scale-domain settings. It raises MATH500 accuracy from 0.630 to 0.685 at 4B and from 0.521 to 0.585 at 1.7B. In code generation, seven single-policy OPD configurations exhibit entropy growth or trajectory degradation, while co-training reaches independently re-evaluated development scores of 0.637 and 0.375. Because several comparisons differ in curriculum or initialization, these results support a stabilization hypothesis rather than a universal causal claim. We provide the exact training algorithm, failure evidence, and the controlled comparison matrix needed to test that hypothesis.

</details>


### [146] [From Approachability Residuals to Anytime-Valid Evidence: The Online Convex Geometry of Testing by Betting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09450)
*Jinze Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了基于赌注的序贯检验与Blackwell可接近性之间的精确联系，通过支持函数残差和在线凸优化（OCO）框架实现了有限时间内的定量转换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序贯检验和Blackwell可接近性是统计检验和博弈论中的两个重要概念，但它们之间的联系尚不明确。本文旨在建立这两者之间的精确联系，填补这一理论空白。

Method: 提出了一种基于支持函数残差的归约方法。对于紧凸目标集S和向量观测r_t，OCO学习器选择可预测的法向量w_t，产生q_t = ⟨w_t,r_t⟩ - h_S(w_t)。证明了精确的路径恒等式，并将该恒等式与单边赌注结合，实现了有限时间内的转换。同时构建了一个受控随机实验框架，其中在w_t之后选择的动作满足Blackwell的支撑半空间条件。

Result: 1) 证明了精确的路径恒等式：dist(r̄_T,S) = (1/T)Σq_t + Reg_T/T；2) 当OCO和对数财富遗憾分别不超过a_T和ℓ_T时，若目标间隙超过a_T/T + 2B√((log(1/α)+ℓ_T)/T)，则强制在时间T内拒绝；3) 所得财富在自适应零假设下是e-process；4) 在备择假设下，以至少δ²/(4B²)的速率获得指数财富。该方法可应用于有界两样本均值、核MMD和主动异构数据源等实例。

Conclusion: 本文建立的序贯检验与Blackwell可接近性之间的联系在代数上是精确的、在有限时间内是定量的、在实验受控时是可操作的。确定性Blackwell博弈和被动检验分别是该协议的无噪声和单动作特例。这一理论框架为统计检验提供了新的视角和工具。

Abstract: Betting-based sequential tests and Blackwell approachability are linked by a rate-explicit reduction through support-function residuals. For a compact convex target $S$ and vector observations $r_t$, an OCO learner selects a predictable normal $w_t$ and produces $q_t=\langle w_t,r_t\rangle-h_S(w_t)$. We prove the exact pathwise identity $$
  \dist(\bar r_T,S)
  =\frac1T\sum_{t=1}^Tq_t+\frac{\Reg_T}{T}. $$ When $|q_t|\leq B$, composing this identity with one-sided betting yields a finite-time transfer: if the OCO and log-wealth regrets are at most $a_T$ and $\ell_T$, respectively, then a target gap exceeding \[
  \frac{a_T}{T}
  +2B\sqrt{\frac{\log(1/α)+\ell_T}{T}} \] forces rejection by time $T$, while non-rejection certifies the converse radius. We then formulate a controlled stochastic experiment in which an action selected after $w_t$ satisfies Blackwell's supporting-halfspace condition for every null mean payoff. The resulting wealth is an e-process under adaptive nulls; sublinear OCO regret gives stochastic approachability, whereas persistent mean separation under an alternative gives exponential wealth at rate at least $δ^2/(4B^2)$. Deterministic Blackwell games and passive tests are, respectively, the noise-free and singleton-action cases of this protocol. Bounded two-sample means, kernel MMD, and active heterogeneous data sources instantiate the reduction. The resulting connection is exact algebraically, quantitative at finite time, and operational when experiments are controlled.

</details>


### [147] [Learning to Modulate, Not to Cycle: Soft Actor---Critic Recovers Inverter-Style Heat-Pump Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09453)
*Faizan Ahmed,Aniket Dixit,James Brusey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在强化学习控制中考虑压缩机磨损的影响，发现SAC算法能学习到连续调节策略实现零启停，而PPO算法退化为开关控制导致更多循环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的建筑强化学习控制器通常只优化能源成本和热舒适度，忽略了启停循环对住宅热泵压缩机磨损的主要影响。压缩机磨损是热泵寿命的关键因素，需要在控制策略中予以考虑。

Method: 在控制奖励函数中添加平准化压缩机磨损项，使用Soft Actor-Critic (SAC)和Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO)两种强化学习算法，在BOPTEST bestest液压热泵案例的相同马尔可夫决策过程上进行训练和对比研究。

Result: SAC学习到连续调节策略，保持压缩机持续运行，实现每日零启停，符合变频热泵运行原理；PPO则退化为开关控制，循环次数超过基准线。在BOPTEST仿真器上，SAC策略以11.5%的成本增加为代价，将热不适降低高达90.7%，同时消除了所有基准循环。

Conclusion: 通过在奖励函数中纳入压缩机磨损项，不同的强化学习算法会学习到截然不同的控制策略。SAC能够学习到理想的连续调节策略，在显著改善热舒适度的同时消除压缩机循环磨损，为变频热泵的智能控制提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: On--off cycling is the main cause of compressor wear in residential heat pumps, yet reinforcement learning (RL) controllers for buildings typically optimise only energy cost and thermal comfort, ignoring how much the learned policy cycles. We add a levelised compressor-wear term to the control reward and study how the resulting behaviour depends on the RL algorithm. Training Soft Actor---Critic (SAC) and Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) on an identical Markov decision process for the BOPTEST bestest hydronic heat pump case, we find that SAC learns a continuous modulation policy that keeps the compressor permanently engaged---the operating principle of an inverter-driven heat pump---achieving zero start-ups per day, whereas PPO collapses to bang-bang control that cycles more than the baseline. On the BOPTEST emulator the SAC policy cuts thermal discomfort by up to 90.7% for an 11.5% cost increase, while eliminating all baseline cycling.

</details>


### [148] [Flow-based conditional cardiac anatomy generation for virtual cohorts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09460)
*Konstantinos Kevopoulos,Beatrice Moscoloni,Benjamin Alheit,Cameron Beeche,Julio A. Chirinos,Alexander Heinlein,Mathias Peirlinck*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了CAN-FLOW框架，基于归一化流的两步法条件解剖学生成方法，用于生成具有真实变异性且受元数据条件控制的双心室解剖结构，以支持虚拟队列构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心脏数字孪生研究正从个体特异性解剖复制品转向代表临床相关人口亚组的虚拟队列。然而，由于队列规模、亚组稀疏性和数据共享限制，获取具有代表性的影像衍生解剖数据集仍然受限。现有心脏解剖生成器主要依赖条件变分自编码器(cVAEs)，其通过共享的规范化潜在先验耦合表示学习和元数据条件，这可能限制了生成质量。

Method: 提出CAN-FLOW框架，一个基于归一化流的两步法条件解剖学生成框架：第一步学习仅基于几何的形射心脏形状动量潜在表示；第二步使用条件归一化流建模其依赖于性别、年龄和体重指数的分布。该框架将表示学习与元数据条件建模解耦。研究在2,208名健康UK Biobank受试者数据上进行训练，并与不同正则化强度的cVAEs进行对比。

Result: CAN-FLOW成功生成了合理的随机双心室解剖结构，在以下方面优于cVAEs：更好地复现临床表型分布、元数据依赖趋势、亚组变异性、点云覆盖范围和高维形状变异性。生成的解剖结构保持了真实的、依赖于元数据的解剖变异性。

Conclusion: CAN-FLOW作为一个可共享的框架，能够生成具有真实随机变异性且受元数据条件控制的双心室解剖结构，为虚拟队列构建和计算机临床试验工作流程提供了有效工具，填补了代表性影像衍生解剖数据集获取受限的空白。

Abstract: Cardiac digital twin research is moving from subject-specific anatomical replicas toward virtual cohorts that represent clinically relevant population subgroups. Yet access to representative imaging-derived anatomy datasets remains limited by cohort size, subgroup sparsity, and data-sharing constraints. Conditional generative models could help address this gap, but virtual cohorts are useful only if they preserve realistic, metadata-dependent anatomical variability. Existing cardiac anatomy generators largely rely on conditional variational autoencoders (cVAEs), which couple representation learning and metadata conditioning through a shared regularized latent prior. We introduce CAN-FLOW, a two-step Conditional ANatomy generation framework based on normalizing FLOWs that first learns geometry-only latent representations of diffeomorphic cardiac shape momenta and then models their sex-, age-, and body-mass-index-dependent distribution with a conditional normalizing flow. We trained CAN-FLOW on 2,208 healthy UK Biobank subjects and compared it with cVAEs across regularization strengths. CAN-FLOW generated plausible stochastic biventricular anatomies that better reproduced clinical phenotype distributions, metadata-dependent trends, subgroup variability, point-cloud coverage, and high-dimensional shape variability. Together, these results establish CAN-FLOW as a shareable framework for generating realistic, stochastically varying, metadata-conditioned biventricular anatomies for virtual cohort construction and in silico clinical trial workflows.

</details>


### [149] [MixFormer: Linear Transformer with Mixture of Memory Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09468)
*Yu Guo,Lei Duan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MixFormer，一种集成内存专家混合机制的新型线性Transformer，通过时间感知线性注意力机制解决了现有SSMs在超长序列建模中的信息丢失问题，在长序列文本和图像生成任务上取得显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有状态空间模型(SSMs)在长上下文建模中存在输入适应性有限和内存容量受限的问题，导致在建模超长序列时出现信息丢失，无法有效捕捉长距离依赖关系。

Method: 提出MixFormer模型，集成了内存专家混合机制，通过多个协作的内存专家维护差异化的内存状态；引入时间感知线性注意力(TALA)机制，利用可学习的指数衰减函数和位置偏差来动态更新内存，实现对重要历史信息的选择性强化。

Result: 在长序列文本和图像生成任务的实验中，MixFormer相比现有方法取得了显著的性能提升，同时提供了更可持续的计算骨干，适用于下一代Web基础设施。

Conclusion: MixFormer通过创新的内存专家混合机制和时间感知线性注意力机制，有效解决了现有SSMs的局限性，在保持计算效率的同时显著提升了长序列建模能力，为长上下文建模提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: State Space Models (SSMs), as a mainstream research direction of linear Transformers, aim to achieve higher efficiency than standard Transformers in long-context modeling. However, existing SSMs suffer from limited input adaptivity and constrained memory capacity, leading to information loss when modeling ultra-long sequences. To address these limitations, we propose MixFormer, a novel linear Transformer that integrates a Mixture-of-Memory-Experts (MoE) mechanism. Specifically, the model maintains differentiated memory states through multiple collaborating memory experts and employs a novel Time-Aware Linear Attention (TALA) mechanism, which leverages learnable exponential decay functions and positional biases to dynamically update memory. This design enables the model to selectively reinforce important historical information while effectively mitigating memory dilution, substantially improving long-range dependency modeling. Experiments on long-sequence text and image generation tasks demonstrate that MixFormer not only achieves significant performance gains but also provides a more sustainable computational backbone for the next generation of web infrastructure.

</details>


### [150] [Hierarchical rank-evolving representation for physics-informed neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09483)
*Ruoyang Su,Xi-Le Zhao,Kun Li,Liang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了层次化秩演化表示（HRE）方法及相应的HRE-PINNs，通过自动确定秩参数解决了现有张量物理信息神经网络需要手动调整秩的限制，在高维静态、非线性时变和复杂流体动力学问题上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的张量物理信息神经网络（T-PINNs）面临根本性挑战：主要依赖预先指定的低秩张量分解且需要手动调整秩参数，这限制了捕捉多变量解函数底层结构的能力并阻碍了实际部署。

Method: 提出层次化秩演化（HRE）表示方法：将目标多变量函数分解为小规模内部张量及沿各模态的一组单变量函数，通过定制的张量网络分解捕捉内部张量的底层结构。关键超参数（秩）可在分解过程中自适应揭示，无需手动调整。

Result: 在高维静态问题（Helmholtz方程和Poisson方程）、非线性时变问题（Klein-Gordon方程）以及复杂流体动力学问题（流动混合方程和Navier-Stokes方程）上的大量数值实验表明，HRE-PINNs在精度方面持续优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: HRE表示方法成功实现了秩参数的自适应确定，避免了手动调参，使方法更具实用性；HRE-PINNs在多种复杂物理问题上展现出优越性能，为张量物理信息神经网络的实际应用提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Recently, tensor-based physics-informed neural networks (T-PINNs) have received increasing attention. However, existing T-PINNs still face a fundamental challenge: they mainly rely on pre-specified low-rank tensor decompositions with manually tuned ranks, which limits their ability to capture the underlying structures of multivariate solution functions and hinders their practical deployment. To address this challenge, we propose a hierarchical rank-evolving (abbreviated as HRE) representation for multivariate functions, which endows us to faithfully capture the underlying structure of the targeted multivariate function accompanying with automatic rank determination. Concretely, in the hierarchical design of HRE representation, the target multivariate function is decomposed as a small-scale inner tensor with a set of univariate functions along each mode, where a customized tensor network decomposition can be readily deployed to capture the underlying structure of the small-scale inner tensor. In HRE representation, the crucial hyperparameters, ranks, can be adaptively revealed during the decomposition, freeing us from manual rank tuning and making HRE practically applicable to real-world problems. Besides, we build the HRE-PINNs correspondingly. Extensive numerical experiments, including high-dimensional static problems (Helmholtz equation and Poisson equation), nonlinear time-dependent problems (Klein-Gordon equation), and complex fluid-dynamics problems (flow mixing equation and Navier-Stokes equation), demonstrate that HRE-PINNs consistently outperform existing state-of-the-art approaches in terms of accuracy.

</details>


### [151] [When Do Task Vectors Interfere? Mapping the Validity Boundaries of Weight-Space Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09490)
*Chencheng Zhu,Xiaoyang Li,Taotao Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了任务算术中参数组合与功能变化的关系，发现代码+安全任务的组合比代码+数学更具有非加性，这种功能性排序在不同规模、架构和微调方法中普遍存在，但受输入格式影响且不能作为通用的模型合并性能预测指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务算术将微调位移视为权重空间中可组合的方向，但参数加法何时能反映模型功能的可预测变化仍不明确。现有研究缺乏对参数几何与功能几何之间关系的深入理解，需要建立系统的框架来衡量功能非加性。

Method: 提出将参数几何与功能几何分离的框架，通过第一令牌预测分布交互比率（条件化于输入分布）来测量二维任务向量表面上的成对功能非加性。采用范数匹配控制、三种训练种子和仅响应微调进行实验，在Qwen2.5-1.5B上测试代码+安全与代码+数学对照组合。

Result: 在代码和指令提示上，代码+安全组合比匹配的代码+数学控制更具非加性，但在数学提示上无此差异。在预设的六任务扩展中，八个未见任务对的高低比较均具有预测符号。该排序在全参数微调（0.5B）、LoRA扩展测试（最高7B）和Llama-3.1-8B跨架构审计中持续存在。外部验证发现原始提示保持连续对比，而指令风格包装会使其坍塌。

Conclusion: 权重空间组合支持跨适应方法、规模和一个额外模型系列的粗粒度、输入和格式条件化的功能陈述，但不是通用的合并性能预测器。功能非加性现象受到输入分布和提示格式的显著影响，揭示了任务算术在实际应用中的局限性。

Abstract: Task arithmetic treats fine-tuning displacements as composable directions in weight space, yet it remains unclear when parameter addition reflects predictable changes in model function. We separate parameter geometry from functional geometry and measure pairwise functional non-additivity over a two-dimensional task-vector surface, using a first-token predictive-distribution interaction ratio conditioned on an input distribution and evaluated with norm-matched controls, three training seeds, and response-only fine-tuning. On Qwen2.5-1.5B, code+safety is more non-additive than the matched code+math control on code and instruction prompts, but not on math prompts. In a prospectively specified six-task expansion, all eight high-versus-low comparisons of unseen task pairs have the predicted sign. The primary ordering further persists under full-parameter fine-tuning at 0.5B, Qwen2.5 LoRA scale tests up to 7B, and a Llama-3.1-8B cross-architecture audit. External validation exposes a sharper boundary: raw public code, instruction, and safety prompts preserve the continuous contrast, whereas an instruction-style wrapper collapses it on the identical public-code prompts, and EvalPlus pass@1 interactions do not robustly reproduce it. Weight-space composition therefore supports coarse, input- and format-conditioned functional statements across adaptation methods, scales, and one additional model family, not a universal merging-performance predictor.

</details>


### [152] [Tracking the Best Strategy in an Extensive-Form Game](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09501)
*Stephen Pasteris,Rahul Savani,Theodore Turocy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了扩展形式博弈的bandit问题，提出了一种高效算法，实现了与后悔序列中策略切换次数相关的切换后悔界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在扩展形式博弈的bandit问题中，研究者希望衡量学习者的表现相对于任何策略切换序列的表现差异，即切换后悔（switching regret），这能更好地评估动态环境下的学习性能。

Method: 提出了一种带有参数ρ>0的算法，用于最小化切换后悔，并在每次试验中保持高效的时间复杂度。

Result: 算法达到了切换后悔界为$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}((1/ρ+ρK)\sqrt{H A T})$，其中K为比较序列中的切换次数，H为信息集最大数量，A为学习者可采取的行动数；每轮时间复杂度仅为$\mathcal{O}(H B)$，B为信息集处的最大行动数。

Conclusion: 该算法在扩展形式bandit问题中实现了有竞争力的切换后悔界，并且具有极高的计算效率，适合需要快速决策的应用场景。

Abstract: We consider the extensive-form bandit problem where on each trial the learner plays an extensive-form game against an oblivious adversary. We focus on the notion of switching regret, which measures the expected performance of the learner against that of any switching sequence of mixed strategies in retrospect. Our algorithm takes a parameter $ρ>0$ and achieves a switching regret of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}((1/ρ+ρK)\sqrt{H A T})$ where $K$ is the number of switches in the comparator sequence, $H$ is the maximum number of the learner's information sets that can be traversed during a play of the game and $A$ is the number of actions that the learner can possibly take. Our algorithm is extremely efficient, taking a per trial time of only $\mathcal{O}(H B)$ where $B$ is the maximum number of actions available to the learner at any of its information sets.

</details>


### [153] [Generalized Convexity and Smoothness via Conjugate Duality: Optimization Theory for Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09523)
*Binchuan Qi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了DNN训练的统一优化框架，通过Legendre函数推广经典凸性和光滑性概念，提出广义GD/SGD算法并证明其收敛性，定量分析了网络架构、批大小和模型容量对训练收敛的影响，理论与实验高度吻合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典优化理论依赖可微性、凸性或光滑性假设，而这些假设在DNN目标函数中常被违反，因此无法完全解释SGD及其变体在DNN训练中的成功。需要建立一个不依赖这些假设的统一优化框架来理解和分析DNN训练过程。

Method: 1. 通过Legendre函数和凸共轭推广经典凸性和光滑性，引入$\mathcal{H}(ψ)$-凸性和$\mathcal{H}(Ψ)$-光滑性概念，建立统一凸/非凸和光滑/非光滑目标函数的形式化框架；2. 基于凸共轭提出广义GD和广义SGD算法；3. 将DNN训练重构为复合优化问题；4. 引入梯度相关因子和模型容量风险来刻画网络架构和训练配置的影响。

Result: 1. 理论证明广义GD的最优学习率恰好为1；2. 为广义GD和广义SGD推导了严格的基于梯度能量的收敛率；3. 揭示DNN训练收敛依赖于联合降低梯度能量和控制网络Jacobian的诱导范数；4. 定量分析了架构设计、批大小和模型容量对训练收敛的影响机制；5. 跨多种网络架构、数据集、优化器和损失函数的实验验证了理论界限，显示理论预测与实际训练动态精确一致。

Conclusion: 本研究成功建立了DNN训练的统一优化理论框架，突破了经典优化理论的假设限制，为理解深度学习优化提供了新的理论基础和分析工具，并通过大量实验验证了理论预测的准确性，为网络架构设计和训练配置选择提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Deep neural network (DNN) training with stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants achieves strong empirical performance, yet classical optimization theory does not fully explain this success. This limitation arises because conventional analyses rely on assumptions such as differentiability, convexity, or smoothness, which are often violated by DNN objectives. In this paper, we establish a unified optimization framework for DNN training by generalizing classical convexity and smoothness through Legendre functions and convex conjugation. Specifically, we introduce $\mathcal{H}(ψ)$-convexity and $\mathcal{H}(Ψ)$-smoothness, which unify convex and non-convex as well as smooth and non-smooth objectives within a single formalism and reveal a natural duality between generalized smoothness and convexity. Building on these generalized properties, we introduce generalized gradient descent (GD) and generalized SGD through convex conjugation. We theoretically prove that generalized GD admits an optimal learning rate of exactly $1$, and derive rigorous gradient-energy-based convergence rates for both proposed optimizers.
