We further reformulate DNN training as a composite optimization problem, demonstrating that its convergence relies on jointly reducing the gradient energy and controlling the induced norm of the network Jacobian. To characterize the practical influences of network architectures and training configurations, we introduce the gradient correlation factor and model capacity risk, and quantitatively analyze how architectural designs, batch size, and model capacity shape training convergence. Extensive experiments across diverse network architectures, datasets, optimizers, and loss functions validate our theoretical bounds and demonstrate precise alignment between our theoretical predictions and empirical training dynamics.

</details>


### [154] [Dual-Adversarial Safety Alignment: Cultivating Intrinsic Threat Comprehension in LRMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09542)
*Hongli Shen,Shaopeng Fu,Qinbo Zhang,Jian Li,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了AdvSafe，一个双重对抗框架，通过合成对抗性越狱提示和提取教师模型对这些攻击的认知反制解释，生成包含丰富可泛化不安全知识的推理数据集。仅用1K合成样本训练，AdvSafe对齐的大推理模型在越狱鲁棒性上显著优于现有基线，且几乎没有效用损失，并能泛化到分布外提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型虽在复杂任务上表现优异，但仍易受有害提示诱导产生不安全输出。现有对齐方法多依赖提示模式匹配而非深入理解内在攻击机制，导致其难以泛化应对多样化的越狱攻击，在对抗鲁棒性和推理效用之间存在权衡。

Method: 提出AdvSafe双重对抗框架：首先在对抗合成阶段，自主智能体动态生成欺骗性越狱提示以攻破强教师模型；其次在对抗提取阶段，被攻破的教师模型进行认知反击，揭示攻击成功原因及识别缓解方法。该过程生成紧凑推理数据集，学生模型通过学习此数据集隐式获得安全对齐。

Result: 实验表明，仅使用1K合成样本，AdvSafe对齐的LRMs在越狱鲁棒性上显著优于现有基线，且效用几乎无损失。此外，AdvSafe提升了模型对分布外提示的鲁棒性，证明了学习不安全知识能实现更优的鲁棒性-效用权衡并泛化超越已见攻击模式。

Conclusion: 通过显式解构对抗机制并内化不安全知识，AdvSafe使模型能够超越模式依赖的防御，建立强大的认知防御能力，从而在保持推理效用的同时显著提升对抗鲁棒性，为大型推理模型的安全对齐提供了新思路。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve remarkable success on complex tasks but remain vulnerable to harmful prompts that induce unsafe outputs. Recent methods align LRMs using direct refusals or safety rationales, yet often focus on prompt patterns rather than intrinsic attack mechanisms. As a result, these pattern-centric alignments struggle to generalize across diverse jailbreaks, compromising adversarial robustness and reasoning utility. We propose AdvSafe, a dual-adversarial framework that enables LRMs to internalize unsafety knowledge by explicitly deconstructing adversarial mechanisms. This moves beyond pattern-dependent traces, fostering robust cognitive defense without compromising reasoning utility. Our pipeline operates via a two-phase adversarial game. First, in adversarial synthesis, an autonomous agent dynamically crafts deceptive jailbreak prompts, adapting its strategies to breach a strong teacher model. Second, in adversarial extraction, the breached teacher executes a cognitive counter-attack. For every successful jailbreak, the teacher unmasks the camouflage, explaining why the attack succeeds and how such prompts can be identified and mitigated. This dual-adversarial process yields a compact reasoning dataset capturing rich, generalizable unsafety knowledge. Student models trained on this dataset implicitly acquire safety alignment through intrinsic threat comprehension. Experiments show that with only 1K synthesized samples, AdvSafe-aligned LRMs achieve significantly stronger jailbreak robustness than existing baselines, with almost no utility degradation. Furthermore, AdvSafe improves robustness against out-of-distribution prompts, demonstrating that learning unsafety knowledge enables a superior robustness-utility trade-off and generalizes beyond seen attack patterns.

</details>


### [155] [Training-Free Universal Approximation by Prompting Random Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09558)
*Alexander Hsu,Rongjie Lai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从逼近理论角度证明了：即使不进行预训练，单层随机初始化的Transformer通过适当的软提示也能逼近任意Hölder函数，揭示了提示机制的表达能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了区分提示、架构和预训练在Transformer模型中的作用，以及确定任务特定行为是必须存储在模型权重中，还是可以在推理时通过提示诱导产生。这有助于理解提示机制的表达能力边界。

Method: 基于softmax注意力与核方法的联系，构造显式软提示（每个目标函数一个提示，独立于查询），通过求解线性系统将注意力logits匹配到高斯核指数，使冻结的Transformer模拟经典的Nadaraya-Watson核估计器。仅需权重满足温和的秩条件（高斯初始化下几乎必然成立）。

Result: 证明了提示网络继承了核回归的理论保证，获得依赖于内在维度的通用逼近定理，且具有极小极大最优率。进一步量化了提示成本，揭示了构造的软提示token范数、提示长度和隐藏维度之间的权衡关系。数值实验验证了构造和预测的收敛率。

Conclusion: 从逼近理论角度证明了预训练是可选的：单层softmax注意力网络配合随机未训练权重，在适当软提示引导下可逼近紧致流形上的任意Hölder函数。这为理解提示机制的表达能力提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: How expressive is prompting a transformer? Answering this question is important for separating the roles of prompting, architecture, and pretraining in transformer models, and for determining whether task-specific behavior must be stored in model weights or can instead be induced at inference time through the prompt. We show, in an approximation-theoretic sense, that pretraining is optional: a single-layer softmax attention network with random, untrained weights can approximate any Hölder function on a compact manifold when steered by an appropriate soft prompt. Guided by the connection between softmax attention and kernel methods, we construct explicit soft prompts (a prompt per target function, independent of the query) as solutions to linear systems matching attention logits to Gaussian kernel exponents, under which the frozen transformer emulates the classical Nadaraya-Watson kernel estimator. The construction requires only a mild rank condition on the weights, which we show holds almost surely under Gaussian initialization. The prompted network inherits the theoretical guarantees of kernel regression, leading to universal approximation theorems with minimax-optimal rates that depend on the intrinsic dimension. We further quantify the cost of prompting, exposing a tradeoff between the norm of the constructed soft prompt tokens, prompt length, and hidden dimension. Numerical experiments corroborate the constructions and predicted rates.

</details>


### [156] [Hyperbolic Multimodal Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09572)
*Jiahong Liu,Ming Shen,Xiaohao Liu,Rex Ying,Menglin Yang,Tat-Seng Chua,Irwin King*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从几何视角建立了双曲空间持续学习的理论基础，提出保持跨模态等距不变性以防止遗忘，并设计了相应的持续学习框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双曲空间因其能自然捕捉跨模态的层次语义结构，在多模态学习中表现出色。然而，双曲空间表示在持续学习场景下的行为及其带来的独特挑战尚未被充分探索，缺乏相关的理论指导。

Method: 建立了双曲空间表示保持的理论基础，证明防止遗忘需要在共享双曲等距变换下保持跨模态不变性。分析了遗忘涉及语义关系漂移和层次结构扭曲，提出在保持跨模态关系结构和层次几何的同时适应新任务的持续学习框架。

Result: 在持续多模态基准测试上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性，证明了保持几何结构对于持续学习的重要性。

Conclusion: 双曲空间持续学习中的遗忘可以通过保持跨模态等距不变性来缓解，同时需要关注语义关系和层次结构的双重保持，为双曲空间多模态持续学习提供了理论指导和实践方法。

Abstract: Hyperbolic geometry has recently emerged as a powerful representation space for multimodal learning, as it naturally captures hierarchical semantic structure across modalities. Despite this progress, how such representations behave under continual learning poses fundamentally different challenges that remain underexplored. This work provides a geometric perspective on this problem and establishes a theoretical foundation for representation preservation in hyperbolic space, showing that preventing forgetting requires cross-modal invariance under a shared hyperbolic isometry. We further show that forgetting in hyperbolic continual learning involves both semantic relation drift and hierarchy-related distortion, motivating preservation of both cross-modal relational structure and hierarchical geometry. Guided by these insights, a principled continual learning framework is derived that preserves essential geometric structure while allowing effective adaptation to new tasks. Experiments on continual multimodal benchmarks corroborate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [157] [LEED: Local Embedding Evolution Distance for over-smoothing estimation and virtual node selection in GNN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09596)
*Killian Cressant,Pedro B. Velloso*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了LEED这一局部度量指标，通过跟踪节点嵌入在各层的演变来量化过平滑现象，并利用该指标指导虚拟节点选择以缓解过压缩问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的GNN过平滑度量指标（如Dirichlet能量）只能提供全局特征描述，缺乏分析节点级行为和指导架构改进的分辨率能力，无法捕捉异质性的过平滑模式。

Method: 提出LEED（Local Embedding Evolution Distance）局部度量指标，通过跟踪单个节点嵌入在各层间的演变来量化过平滑；利用LEED产生的节点重要性分数作为单一准则来指导局部虚拟节点的选择与构建，以缓解过压缩问题。

Result: LEED能够揭示全局能量度量无法察觉的异质性过平滑模式，提供更丰富的诊断信息；基于LEED的虚拟节点选择策略比依赖多种启发式中心性度量的现有方法更有效，在多个数据集上提升了GNN性能。

Conclusion: LEED作为节点级度量指标，既保留了全局评估能力又提供了更细粒度的诊断信息，有效指导了虚拟节点集成策略的设计，为理解和缓解GNN的过平滑与过压缩问题提供了新工具。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) suffer from two fundamental limitations: over-smoothing, where node representations become indistinguishable with depth, and over-squashing, where long-range information is compressed through limited message-passing channels. Existing metrics such as Dirichlet energy provide global characterizations of over-smoothing but lack the resolution to analyze node-level behavior and guide architectural improvements. In this paper, we propose LEED (Local Embedding Evolution Distance), a novel local metric that quantifies over-smoothing by tracking the evolution of individual node embeddings across layers. By operating at the node level, LEED enables fine-grained analysis of representation dynamics during training, revealing heterogeneous over-smoothing patterns that are invisible to global energy-based measures. This locality induces informative node importance scores, interpreted as embedding-driven centrality measures. We leverage LEED to design a more efficient strategy for virtual node selection. Unlike existing approaches that depend on multiple heuristic centrality measures, our method uses LEED as a unique criterion to guide the construction of Local Virtual Nodes to mitigate over-squashing. Experiments show that LEED provides more informative diagnostics than Dirichlet energy while preserving global evaluation, and enables more effective virtual node integration, improving GNN performance across datasets.

</details>


### [158] [Bayesian Symbolic Regression with Entropic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09617)
*Oussama Boussif,Mohammed Mahfoud,Younesse Kaddar,Moksh Jain,Sida Li,Damiano Fornasiere,Xiaoyin Chen,Yoshua Bengio,Esmeralda S. Whitammer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了ERRLESS方法，使用最大熵强化学习对符号回归问题的后验分布进行采样，实现了不确定性量化、竞争力表现和高可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统符号回归只搜索单一最优表达式，忽略了表达式的不确定性（epistemic uncertainty），因此需要贝叶斯视角的后验分布采样方法来进行不确定性量化并约束搜索空间。

Method: 提出ERRLESS（Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning for Expression Structure Sampling），使用最大熵强化学习学习一个神经策略，通过逐步构建抽象语法树来生成表达式，收敛后该策略可从后验分布中采样表达式。

Result: ERRLESS在Feynman基准测试上取得了具有竞争力的结果，生成的表达式简短且可解释；其后验预测均值相比SMC基线方法达到了更高的R²系数。

Conclusion: ERRLESS成功实现了可扩展的贝叶斯符号回归，在保持竞争性能的同时提供了不确定性量化能力和高可解释性，验证了贝叶斯视角在符号回归中的优势。

Abstract: Symbolic regression is the problem of finding an algebraic expression describing a stochastic dependence of a target variable on a set of inputs. Unlike forms of regression that fit parameters assuming a fixed model structure, symbolic regression is a search problem over the space of expressions, represented, for example, as abstract syntax trees using a library of operators. Symbolic regression is typically used in settings with limited, noisy data in the natural sciences. However, searching for a single best-fitting expression fails to capture the epistemic uncertainty about the expression, which motivates a Bayesian perspective that enables uncertainty quantification and specification of natural priors to constrain the search space. In this work, we propose ERRLESS (Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning for Expression Structure Sampling), a scalable approach for sampling from the posterior distribution over expressions given data using maximum-entropy reinforcement learning. ERRLESS learns a neural policy that constructs expressions sequentially by building up their abstract syntax trees. At convergence, the policy samples expressions from the posterior. At test time, expressions can be sampled by rollouts of this policy. We demonstrate that ERRLESS achieves competitive results on the Feynman benchmark while producing short and interpretable expressions. Additionally, we demonstrate that the mean of the posterior predictive approximated by ERRLESS achieves a high coefficient of determination ($R^2$) compared to an SMC baseline, highlighting the benefits of the Bayesian perspective in symbolic regression.

</details>


### [159] [Satellite Trajectory Optimization via Proximal Policy Optimization for Space Debris Avoidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09628)
*Logan Luna,Juan Ortiz Couder,Raul Alejandro Vargas-Acosta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的自主避碰策略，在GEO轨道实现了97.5%的避碰成功率，显著优于传统方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着巨型星座的部署，LEO和GEO轨道日益拥堵，碰撞警报和风险日益增加。现有的人工或基于规则的避碰方法难以适应这些动态环境的变化。

Method: 采用近端策略优化(PPO)算法训练强化学习智能体，开发了开源高保真天体动力学模拟器进行训练和评估。模拟器包含牛顿二体动力学、日/月三体摄动、燃料依赖推力和可配置碎片场。训练过程采用课程学习和奖励塑形技术。

Result: 在1000个确定性GEO场景测试中，智能体达到97.5%的避碰成功率，显著优于基于规则的基线方法(20.7%)和脉冲delta-v规划器基线(27.5%)。

Conclusion: 该方法为自主碰撞避碰提供了有效解决方案，框架已公开发布，可用于训练和评估避碰策略。

Abstract: Collision avoidance systems are commonly used to avoid fragmentation events occurring in Low-Earth Orbit (LEO) and Geosynchronous Equatorial Orbit (GEO). However, these events have been growing in frequency as orbital congestion worsens with the launch of megaconstellations. Consequently, conjunction alerts and collision risks are becoming increasingly common. Current practices, which are commonly manual or rule-based, have difficulty scaling to these worsening dynamic environments. To address this intensifying situation, we propose a reinforcement-learning policy for autonomous collision avoidance, trained via Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) along with an open-source, high-fidelity astrodynamics simulator for training and evaluation. In 1,000 deterministic GEO episodes, our agent achieves a 97.5% collision avoidance success rate, outperforming traditional controllers such as a rule-based baseline (20.7% success) and an impulsive delta-v planner baseline (27.5% success). To achieve these results, we designed a simulator to train and evaluate our agent, using real-world and simulated debris. We simulate Newtonian two-body dynamics using Sun/Moon third-body perturbations, fuel-dependent thrust, and configurable debris fields. The agent is trained with curriculum learning and shaped rewards oriented toward encouraging survival, adequate projected miss distance, and delta-v conservation. Finally, our evaluation consisted of a fully deterministic pipeline, including shared seeds, per-episode logs, and telemetry exports. Our work is a publicly available framework at https://purl.org/sat-trajectory-avoidance

</details>


### [160] [Deep Learning Imputation of Missing Radius of Maximum Winds (Rmax) Values in Tropical Cyclone Best-Track Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09683)
*Swastik Agrawal,Nishkal Hundia,Ziyue Liu,Michelle Bensi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究评估了多种数据驱动方法用于填补热带气旋最大风速半径(Rmax)的缺失记录，发现时序深度学习模型和物理信息输入能显著提升填补性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率性海岸灾害评估需要准确表征热带气旋参数，然而数据集中经常缺失最大风速半径(Rmax)这一关键变量，影响了联合概率方法分析的准确性，因此需要开发有效的Rmax填补方法。

Method: 采用一维卷积神经网络(1DCNN)、长短期记忆网络(LSTM)和传统机器学习模型进行Rmax填补；引入物理信息输入增强（特别是34节风速半径R34）、时序建模和迁移学习；使用合成RAFT和STORM数据集进行预训练，观测IBTrACS数据进行微调。

Result: 包含R34显著提升所有模型性能；时序模型在样本量减少约一个数量级的情况下仍获得更高平均相关性，更好保持了风暴间Rmax相对变异性；在R34不可用时，时序信息的优势更明显；迁移学习未改善性能，可能因为合成数据集的Rmax分布比IBTrACS更低且变化更小。

Conclusion: 时序深度学习在重建不完整热带气旋记录方面具有潜力；物理信息输入、观测数据可用性和分布一致性在海岸灾害评估中具有重要意义；为未来热带气旋数据填补和海岸灾害评估提供了方法论指导。

Abstract: Probabilistic coastal hazard assessments require accurate characterization of tropical cyclone (TC) parameters, yet datasets often contain missing records for the radius of maximum winds (Rmax), a key variable in Joint Probability Method analyses. This study evaluates data-driven approaches for Rmax imputation, including one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks (1DCNNs), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and conventional machine learning models. We examine physics-informed input augmentation, temporal modeling, and transfer learning using synthetic RAFT and STORM datasets for pre-training and observational IBTrACS data for fine-tuning. Including the radius of 34-knot winds (R34) substantially improves performance across all model types. Temporal models achieve higher average correlations than non-temporal models despite using approximately an order of magnitude fewer samples, indicating better preservation of relative Rmax variability across storms. This advantage is more pronounced when R34 is unavailable, suggesting temporal information can partially compensate for missing storm-size predictors. Transfer learning does not improve performance, likely because synthetic datasets have lower and less variable Rmax distributions than IBTrACS. These findings demonstrate the potential of temporal deep learning for reconstructing incomplete TC records and highlight the importance of physics-informed inputs, observational data availability, and distributional consistency in coastal hazard assessment.

</details>


### [161] [FedOrbit: Adaptive Personalized Federated Learning for Non-IID LEO Satellite Constellations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09687)
*Satwat Bashir,Tasos Dagiuklas,Muddesar Iqbal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了FedOrbit方法，用于解决低地球轨道卫星星座联邦学习中的非独立同分布数据和地面站不规则可见性问题，在五个设置中实现了最高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低地球轨道卫星星座联邦学习受到非独立同分布数据和轨道几何导致的不规则地面站可见性影响。当轨道级类别分布不相交时，全局聚合性能较差；而当分布重叠时，强个性化可能过于复杂。需要一种能够适应这些挑战的方法。

Method: 提出了FedOrbit方法，结合了以下技术：(1)通过星间链路进行连续轨道级训练；(2)类别感知的层次化聚合；(3)带有返回率抑制的质量加权特征聚合；(4)基于轨道间类别相似性的自适应特征分解。

Result: 在三个遥感基准测试和两个非独立同分布分区上，FedOrbit在六个设置中的五个取得了最高准确率，在第六个设置中也仅比最佳结果低0.9个百分点。相比最强基线，在狄利克雷分区下提升了16.1个百分点，在病理分区下提升了8.6个百分点，并在五个设置中实现了最小的轨道间准确率差异。

Conclusion: FedOrbit有效解决了低地球轨道卫星星座联邦学习中的挑战，显著提升了模型性能和轨道间一致性，为卫星联邦学习提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations is affected by non-IID data and irregular ground-station visibility, both driven by orbital geometry. Global aggregation performs poorly when orbit-level class distributions are disjoint, while strong personalisation can be excessive when these distributions overlap. We present FedOrbit, which combines continuous orbit-level training over inter-satellite links, class-aware hierarchical aggregation, quality-weighted feature aggregation with return-rate dampening, and adaptive feature decomposition based on inter-orbit class similarity. Across three remote-sensing benchmarks and two non-IID partitions, FedOrbit achieves the highest accuracy in five of six settings and is within $0.9$ percentage points of the best result in the sixth. The gains over the strongest baseline reach $16.1$ percentage points under Dirichlet partitioning and $8.6$ under pathological partitioning, with the smallest per-orbit accuracy spread in five of six settings.

</details>


### [162] [Confusion-Geometry Rebalancing for Long-Tailed Adversarial Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09688)
*Mengnan Zhao,Geyong Min,Lihe Zhang,Tianhang Zheng,Jie Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CGRm方法解决长尾分布对抗训练的双重不平衡问题，通过混淆几何重平衡提升尾部类别的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长尾分布下的对抗训练面临双重不平衡问题：类别不平衡使训练目标偏向头部类别，对抗内最大化进一步放大这种偏差。现有方法孤立处理每个类别，未能识别导致长尾崩溃的边界。

Method: 提出混淆几何重平衡方法（CGRm），利用定向鲁棒误差作为训练信号。通过周期性鲁棒评估导出源类别损失权重、类别级鲁棒系数和定向混淆几何图，结合反馈加权鲁棒优化与图引导的边界校正。

Result: 在长尾基准测试上，CGRm相比现有方法实现了持续的鲁棒性能提升，消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。

Conclusion: CGRm作为一个插件式框架，有效提升了脆弱类别的鲁棒性并锐化了导致长尾性能退化的关键边界，为长尾对抗训练提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Adversarial training under long tailed distributions suffers from a dual imbalance: the class imbalance skews the training objective toward head classes, and the adversarial inner maximization may further amplify this bias. Existing methods mitigate this issue by correcting class priors or adapting class wise robust supervision, yet they treat each class in isolation and fail to identify which boundaries drive long tailed collapse. We propose a Confusion Geometry Rebalancing method (CGRm) for long tail adversarial training, a plug in framework that leverages directed robust errors as training signals. CGRm leverages periodic robust evaluations to derive source class loss weights, class wise robust coefficients, and a directed confusion geometry graph. The method then couples feedback weighted robust optimization with graph guided margin correction, thereby boosting the robustness of vulnerable classes and sharpening the critical boundaries that drive long tailed performance degradation. Experiments on long tailed benchmarks show that CGRm achieves consistent robust performance gains over existing methods, with ablations validating the contribution of each component. We provide the code in the supplement.

</details>


### [163] [Recurrent Neural Networks Beyond Time: Learning from Multiple Ordered Projections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09690)
*Vagan Terziyan,Artur Terziian,Oleksandra Vitko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了有序结构依赖假设（OSDH），认为同一观测数据的不同排序方式能够揭示互补的结构依赖关系。基于此，设计了独立结构专家原则（ISEP）和结构进化RNN（SE-RNN），通过独立训练多个投影特定的序列模型并融合其表示来提升学习性能。实验表明该方法在结构复杂的合成数据集上优于传统RNN，且框架可扩展至其他序列模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环神经网络（RNN）广泛应用于序列学习，但其应用主要局限于时序数据。实际上，循环计算本质上作用于有序序列而非时间本身。作者由此出发，认为单一序列组织可能无法充分揭示数据中的结构性依赖关系，多种合理的序列排序方式可能揭示互补的结构信息。

Method: 提出有序结构依赖假设（OSDH）和独立结构专家原则（ISEP），将投影特定的序列模型独立训练后通过融合模型整合其学习到的表示。具体实现为结构进化RNN（SE-RNN），使用传统RNN作为投影特定的结构专家，保持底层循环计算不变。框架设计不依赖特定序列处理模型，可适配其他架构。

Result: 在三个具有不同结构复杂度的合成数据集上进行概念验证实验，结果表明：当存在隐藏的结构依赖时，所提架构能够持续从多个有序投影中获益，明显优于单一序列组织的传统RNN；在较简单数据集上保持竞争力。该方法的有效性和通用性得到验证。

Conclusion: OSDH不依赖于底层序列处理模型，所提框架可自然扩展至循环网络之外的其他架构。研究结果揭示了一种利用互补有序表示来解决多样化结构学习问题的通用计算视角，为序列学习提供了新的理论基础和实践范式。

Abstract: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are widely used for sequence learning, yet their application is commonly associated with temporal data, although recurrent computation fundamentally operates on ordered sequences rather than on time itself. Building on this observation, we introduce the Ordered Structural Dependency Hypothesis (OSDH), which proposes that multiple admissible orderings of the same observations may reveal complementary structural dependencies inaccessible through a single sequential organization. To operationalize this hypothesis, we propose the Independent Structural Expert Principle (ISEP), whereby projection-specific sequence models are trained independently before their learned representations are integrated through a dedicated fusion model. As a concrete realization, we present Structural Evolution RNNs (SE-RNNs), which employ conventional RNNs as projection-specific structural experts while preserving the underlying recurrent computation unchanged. Proof-of-concept experiments on three synthetic datasets with substantially different levels of structural complexity demonstrate that the proposed architecture consistently benefits from multiple ordered projections when hidden structural dependencies are present, while remaining competitive on simpler datasets. Since OSDH is independent of the underlying sequence-processing model, the proposed framework naturally extends beyond recurrent networks and may be instantiated using alternative architectures. The results suggest a general computational perspective for exploiting complementary ordered representations across diverse structured learning problems.

</details>


### [164] [Evaluating Generative Time-Series Models on Data with Point Masses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09692)
*Jian Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 生成式时间序列模型的基准测试在处理单值概率质量集中的数据时存在严重缺陷，评估窗口的原子结构与数据集不匹配，自回归障碍模型优于条件流，不同统计量下模型排序不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式时间序列模型基准测试中，许多数据集在单个值上放置大量概率质量（如不下雨、无订单请求等）。研究者发现这种数据特性下的评估可能存在问题，需要仔细研究这种数据特征对模型评估和比较的影响。

Method: 1) 分析标准滚动原点协议在零值集中的数据上的评估窗口原子结构不匹配问题\n2) 设计控制实验，构造CRPS不变但时间耦合被破坏的情况，测量时间耦合的贡献\n3) 在匹配协议下对七个模型进行五种随机种子的基准测试\n4) 比较五种不同发生统计量下的模型排序

Result: 1) 评估窗口原子结构与数据集严重不匹配（某基准数据集42%零值vs评估窗口13%；另一数据集47% vs 5%）\n2) 自回归障碍模型在六个数据集中的五个上击败条件流模型，优势高达153倍\n3) 条件流模型的发生统计量在训练种子间变化高达62%，而所有基线都是确定性的\n4) 五种不同发生统计量下的模型排序不相同，两种不同构造的统计量彼此一致性最低

Conclusion: 当前时间序列生成模型的基准测试协议存在根本性缺陷，特别是在处理零值集中的数据时。评估窗口与数据分布不匹配会改变模型比较结论，不同统计量产生不一致的模型排序。自回归障碍模型在处理这类数据时显著优于条件流模型，后者存在训练不稳定性问题。

Abstract: Many of the series that generative time-series models are benchmarked on place a large probability mass on a single value --- it does not rain, no ride is requested, no part is ordered. We report what happens when such data is evaluated carefully. First, the standard rolling-origin protocol can score a model on a window whose atom structure bears no resemblance to the dataset: on one benchmark the dataset is $42\%$ zeros and the evaluation windows are $13\%$, on another $47\%$ against $5\%$. This is not a cosmetic problem --- it reversed one of our own conclusions, turning the strongest occurrence model in our study into what looked like a cautionary tale. Second, we give a control in which CRPS is invariant \emph{by construction} while the temporal coupling is destroyed, which measures exactly how much that coupling contributes to a chosen statistic. Third, benchmarking seven models on a matched protocol over five seeds, an autoregressive hurdle beats a conditional flow on five of six datasets, by up to a factor of $153$, while the flow's own occurrence statistics vary by up to $62\%$ across training seeds and every baseline is deterministic. Finally, the model ordering is not the same under five different occurrence statistics, and the two that do not share a construction agree with each other least.

</details>


### [165] [PET/CT Radiogenomic Mutation Prediction in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Using Multi-Label Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09721)
*Mona Furukawa,Sai Hyne,Daniel R. McGowan,Bartłomiej W. Papież*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究开发了基于PET/CT的深度学习方法预测非小细胞肺癌的关键基因突变，发现成对多标签学习可提升特定基因对的预测性能，但其效果依赖于基因突变组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺癌靶向治疗依赖组织活检进行基因突变谱分析，但该方法具有侵入性且存在多种局限性，迫切需要开发一种无创的放射基因组学方法来预测EGFR、TP53和KRAS等关键基因突变。

Method: 利用PET/CT影像数据构建基于深度学习的放射基因组学模型，系统比较成对多标签学习与传统单基因分类方法在基因突变预测任务中的表现。

Result: 在英国放射基因组队列上的实验表明：KRAS/TP53联合预测将KRAS的AUC从0.58提升至0.64，TP53从0.69提升至0.71；EGFR/KRAS配对仅EGFR获益；EGFR/TP53配对无改善。

Conclusion: 多标签学习的有效性取决于所建模的基因突变组合，提示PET/CT放射基因组预测应采用突变特异性的建模策略而非通用方案。

Abstract: Lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer- related mortality worldwide. Although targeted therapies have improved outcomes for patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), they rely on mutation profiling through tissue biopsy, an invasive procedure with several limitations. This study investigates PET/CT-based radio- genomic prediction of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), tumour protein 53 (TP53), and Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene (KRAS) mutations using deep learning. We further evaluate whether pairwise multi-label learning improves mutation prediction compared with conventional single-gene classification. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first studies to systematically investigate multi-label learning for PET/CT radiogenomic mutation prediction in NSCLC. Experiments were conducted on a novel UK-based radiogenomics cohort. Joint pre- diction of KRAS and TP53 improved AUC from 0.58 to 0.64 for KRAS and from 0.69 to 0.71 for TP53. For the EGFR/KRAS pair, only EGFR benefited from joint learning, while no improvement was observed for the EGFR/TP53 pair. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of multi-label learning depends on the specific combination of gene mutations being modelled, suggesting that mutation-specific modelling strategies may be preferable for PET/CT radiogenomic prediction.

</details>


### [166] [SR-OPSD: Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09745)
*Zhuo Sun,Entong Li,Yanlong Zhao,Xiaoyuan Cheng,Wenxuan Yuan,Kaiyu Li,Che Liu,Huihang Liu,Harrison Bo Hua Zhu,Li Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了SR-OPSD方法，通过变分表征和Rényi散度解决了传统OPSD中优化不稳定的问题，在多个任务上达到了最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的On-policy self-distillation (OPSD)方法中，自教师策略与学生策略共同演化，导致优化目标不稳定，可能引发优化震荡或分布过度集中问题。这种动态目标的直接匹配会带来训练不稳定性。

Method: 提出Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation (SR-OPSD)：1) 在固定学生生成的上下文中，通过token级变分表征将有效蒸馏目标识别为自教师策略和参考策略之间的几何插值；2) 使用Rényi散度族来泛化投影几何。该框架将目标位置（插值系数控制）与投影方式（Rényi阶数控制）解耦。

Result: 在科学评估、数学推理和代码生成三个任务领域，使用多个大型语言模型进行广泛实验，SR-OPSD在各种设置下均达到或超越了最先进性能。

Conclusion: SR-OPSD通过分离目标定位和投影几何的设计，有效解决了传统OPSD的优化不稳定性问题，为策略自我蒸馏提供了一种更稳定的训练框架，具有广泛的适用性和优越的性能表现。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) converts feedback into dense token-level supervision on trajectories generated by the policy to be optimized, providing a useful complement to reinforcement learning with sparse outcome rewards. However, the self-teacher policy used in OPSD is typically a stop-gradient or exponential-moving-average copy of the policy conditioned on additional context information, and thus co-evolves with both the student policy and its on-policy context distribution. Directly matching such a moving target with a fixed projection objective can lead to unstable optimization or excessive distributional concentration. This nature of OPSD motivates the proposed \emph{Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation (SR-OPSD)}. At fixed student-generated contexts, a token-level variational characterization identifies the effective distillation target as a geometric interpolation between the self-teacher policy and a reference policy. Meanwhile, we use the Rényi divergence family to generalize the projection geometry. This formulation separates \emph{where} the adaptive target is placed from \emph{how} the student is projected toward it: the interpolation coefficient controls underlying target, while the Rényi order controls the projection geometry and its sensitivity to token-level density ratios. Extensive experiments across scientific evaluation, mathematical reasoning, and coding generation tasks with multiple large language models show that SR-OPSD achieves the state-of-the-art or competitive performance across various settings.

</details>


### [167] [MoNo: Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator for Solving PDEs on General Geometries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09764)
*Zijiang Yang,Xiaomeng Wu,Dongmei Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了MoNo，一种基于最优传输的多尺度神经算子，通过解决token分配不均衡问题，提升了PDE求解的性能和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的神经算子在求解偏微分方程时，可学习的投影机制无法保证观测点到潜在token的稳定均衡分配，导致部分token过度分配而其他未被充分利用。这种分配不均衡限制了层次化架构的设计，因为不平衡会在潜在空间中持续继承和放大，最终在深层空间导致严重的token崩溃。

Method: 提出MoNo（多尺度最优传输神经算子），核心是CoTAP（跨尺度最优传输分配和投影）方法。CoTAP将相邻空间之间的跨空间分配表述为熵正则化的最优传输问题，从而构建平衡的双向投影和稳定的潜在空间。该方法确保了跨多个潜在空间的稳定信息传递，实现了通用于一般几何形状的多尺度架构。

Result: 大量实验表明，MoNo在预测性能和计算效率方面均优于现有的最先进神经算子方法。该方法成功解决了token分配不均衡问题，支持更高效的长程物理交互学习。

Conclusion: MoNo通过最优传输方法成功解决了现有神经算子中的token分配不稳定性问题，实现了稳定的多尺度架构设计，为偏微分方程求解提供了更高效准确的方法，在一般几何形状上展现出优越性能。

Abstract: Transformer-based neural operators have achieved substantial progress in solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) by projecting spatial observations into compact latent tokens and learning physical interactions in latent spaces. However, we reveal that existing learnable projection mechanisms cannot ensure stable and balanced assignments from observation points to latent tokens, causing some latent tokens to be over-assigned while others remain underutilized. This limitation further restricts the design of hierarchical architectures, as assignment imbalance is continuously inherited and amplified across latent spaces, eventually causing severe token collapse in deeper spaces. To address these issues, we propose MoNo (Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator), a progressive multiscale neural operator that efficiently solves PDEs on general geometries through stable latent-space construction. At its core is CoTAP (Cross-scale Optimal Transport Assignment and Projection), a novel latent-space construction method that formulates cross-space assignment between adjacent spaces as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby constructing balanced bidirectional projections and stable latent spaces. CoTAP also ensures stable information transfer across multiple latent spaces, further enabling multiscale architectures on general geometries, which in turn support more efficient learning of long-range physical interactions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoNo outperforms existing state-of-the-art neural operators in both prediction performance and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/ZijiangY1116/MoNo.

</details>


### [168] [ReliableNet: A Chance-Constrained Approach to Trustworthy Classification in Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09768)
*Ange-Clément Akazan,Ineza Remy Mugenga,Abebe Geletu,Jean Medard Ngnotchouye,Issa Karambal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出ReliableNet，通过在训练中约束“联合置信错误（JCW）”概率来控制“既自信又错误”的预测失败，在多项数据集和分布偏移下实现了在用户指定风险预算内的认证JCW，同时保持准确性等竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当模型对错误预测同时表现出高置信度时，会绕过拒绝机制与人工审查，造成关键可靠性失败。现有ERM控制平均损失，而校准、不确定性估计、保形风险控制和选择性预测等方法不直接约束“置信且错误”的联合事件。因此亟需一种在训练阶段显式约束该联合失败概率的方法。

Method: 将“联合置信错误（JCW）”概率约束为机会约束ERM问题，要求该概率低于用户指定风险预算α。提出保守平滑内逼近，保证总体可行性意味着原始JCW约束成立，从而在训练中可优化并满足约束。

Result: 在四个表格和两个图像数据集上，ReliableNet是唯一在所有数据集和随机种子下均获得JCW预算内认证的方法，显著优于ERM、后处理校准、保形风险控制和选择性预测基线。在人口统计、歧义、虚假相关、新类和协变量等分布偏移下，它实现最低经验JCW，同时在准确性、覆盖度、校准和选择性预测方面保持竞争力，并在大多数数据集上展现出更优的风险-覆盖排序。

Conclusion: ReliableNet为可信分类提供了有原则的解决方案，能够在保证JCW风险可控的前提下兼顾多维度性能，对需要高可靠性的应用场景具有重要价值。

Abstract: A prediction that is both confident and wrong is a critical reliability failure because it can bypass abstention and human review precisely when the model is mistaken. Empirical risk minimization (ERM) controls average loss but not this failure directly, while calibration, uncertainty estimation, conformal risk control, and selective prediction methods target related reliability properties rather than bounding the joint failure event during training. We propose ReliableNet, which constrains the Joint Confident-Wrong (JCW) probability, the probability that a prediction is simultaneously confident and incorrect, below a user-specified risk budget $α\in(0,1)$. We formulate this as a chance-constrained ERM problem, use a conservative smooth inner approximation whose population feasibility implies the original JCW constraint. Across four tabular and two image datasets, ReliableNet is the only method certified within the JCW budget for every dataset and seed in distribution, when compared against baselines spanning ERM, post-hoc calibration, conformal risk control, and selective prediction. Under demographic, ambiguity, spurious-correlation, novel-class, and covariate shifts, it achieves the lowest empirical JCW among the compared methods while remaining very competitive in accuracy, coverage, calibration, and selective prediction. Risk-coverage results further indicate that ReliableNet achieves better selective ranking than the benchmark methods on most datasets. Overall, ReliableNet provides a principled approach to trustworthy classification.

</details>


### [169] [Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09805)
*Vatsal Venkatkrishna,Nico Daheim,Iryna Gurevych*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出参数空间探索方法3PO，通过从后验分布采样不同策略来生成rollouts，在数学推理和代码生成任务上相比标准GRPO方法在相近计算成本下持续提升下游性能，并减少了训练中的零优势组和错误rollouts。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM强化学习中的探索方法主要在动作空间进行控制（如温度缩放），但这些方法无法重排token，只能影响输出分布的方差，限制了探索能力并可能导致训练发散或停滞。参数空间探索可以提供更丰富的探索机制。

Method: 提出Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization (3PO)方法家族，通过从后验分布采样不同策略参数来生成rollouts，每个采样的策略可以探索不同的rollouts。通过控制采样策略的多样性程度作为探索的补充控制手段，并使用不同的采样策略和rollout分组方式进行奖励估计。

Result: 在OLMo-3-1025-7B和Qwen2.5-Math-7B模型上的数学推理和代码生成任务实验表明，3PO方法在相近的FLOPs成本下相比标准GRPO持续提升平均下游性能。使用多参数采样相比GRPO和动作空间基线方法能持续产生更少的零优势组和畸形/错误的rollouts。

Conclusion: 参数空间探索能够有效改善LLM强化学习，为LLM强化学习提供了除动作空间探索之外的新的探索范式，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Exploration has been a focus of reinforcement learning research for a long time. Recently, there has been growing evidence that it is also an important ingredient in LLM reinforcement learning recipes that can significantly impact downstream performance. Many existing methods control exploration in the action-space, for example, using temperature scaling. However, these methods cannot reorder tokens but only influence the variance in the output distribution. This limits exploration and can lead to divergence or stalled training. Here, we investigate parameter-space exploration, where rollouts are generated by sampling different policies from a posterior that may each explore different rollouts. Sampling less or more diverse policies is then a complementary control lever over exploration. We introduce a family of methods called Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization (3PO) which use different sampling strategies and different rollout grouping for reward estimation. Experiments on OLMo-3-1025-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks show that these approaches consistently improve average downstream performance over standard GRPO at a near-identical FLOPs cost. Moreover, using multiple parameter samples consistently produces fewer zero-advantage groups and malformed or incorrect rollouts during training than GRPO and action-space baselines. Overall, our work presents evidence that parameter-space exploration can improve reinforcement learning for LLMs.

</details>


### [170] [Macaron-V1: Towards Open Continual Learning with Self-Improvement and Mixture-of-LoRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09819)
*Mind Lab,:,Vin Bo,Asher Cai,Jingwei Cao,Song Cao,Vic Cao,Amelia Chen,Andrew Chen,Kaijie Chen,Cleon Cheng,Steven Chiang,Kaixuan Fan,Hera Feng,Huan Feng,Arthur Fu,Jun Gao,Pyke Han,Nolan Ho,Ori Hong,Hailee Hou,Piers Hua,Charles Huang,Miles Jiang,Nora Jiang,Yuyi Jiang,Qiuyu Jin,Fancy Kong,Kuss Koo,Jaron Lee,Andrew Lei,Alexy Li,Dawn Li,Lucian Li,Ray Li,Ricardo Li,Smith Li,Theo Li,Allen Lin,Elliot Lin,Fan Lin,Chen Ling,Kairus Liu,Kieran Liu,Logan Liu,Neo Liu,Xiang Liu,Yuxin Lu,Maeve Luo,Pony Ma,Verity Niu,Cole Qiao,Guian Qiu,Vince Qu,Sentry,Niko Song,Vincent Wang,Bo Wu,Rio Yang,Evelyn Ye,Fiona Ye,Ina Ye,Regis Ye,Josh Ying,Atlas Zeng,Danney Zeng,Salmon Zhan,Anya Zhang,Di Zhang,Mia Zhang,Sueky Zhang,Wei Zhao,Ada Zhou,Adrian Zhou,Yuhua Zhou,Juno Zhu,Murphy Zhuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Macaron-V1是一个开放智能体模型家族，通过MoL架构和模型-框架协同设计实现体验式智能学习，支持部署后的持续学习和自我改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建能够从真实环境经验中学习并在部署后持续改进的智能体系统，实现适应性和协作性两个核心目标，使模型能够通过递归自我改进不断提升能力。

Method: 采用Mixture-of-LoRA (MoL)架构冻结基础模型并组合专家LoRA适配器；结合Model-Harness协同设计和递归自改进循环；包含UI4A组件原生GenUI框架、有状态动作基板、版本化HCP契约和MindForge智能体强化学习框架；配套MinT后训练平台和LongStraw长上下文RL方法。

Result: 旗舰模型Macaron-V1-Venti (744B GLM-5.2基础模型+4个LoRA)和Macaron-V1-Tall (50B Qwen3.6基础模型)在Personal Intelligence、GenUI和通用能力基准测试中验证了系统有效性，能够与前沿基线模型竞争。

Conclusion: 当前系统设计得到验证，证明了持续学习和集体智能的潜力，但从持续学习和集体智能中获得累积增益仍是开放性问题，为未来研究指明了方向。

Abstract: Macaron-V1 is an open agent-model family for experiential intelligence: learning from experience in real environments and continuing to learn after deployment. It is organized around two system goals. Adaptation is pursued through recursive improvement of versioned model-harness pairs, where experience from one configuration is evaluated under an external contract and used to construct its successor. Collaboration is pursued via the Mixture-of-LoRA (MoL) architecture that freezes a base model, composes specialist LoRA adapters, and selects one LoRA per user turn. The flagship Macaron-V1-Venti combines a 744B GLM-5.2 base with four LoRAs for chat, agent, coding, and GenUI; the Qwen3.6-based Macaron-V1-Tall (50B) uses the same design for local deployment. This report presents Macaron-V1 as a co-designed system spanning architecture, algorithms, and infrastructure. The MoL architecture supports continual learning through extensible LoRA specialists. The algorithm combines Model-Harness Co-design and recursive self-improvement loop, including the UI4A component-native GenUI harness, a stateful action substrate, versioned HCP contract, and the agentic RL framework MindForge. The supporting infrastructure includes the post-training platform MinT, the long-context RL method LongStraw, and stability techniques for sparse MoE and DSA base models. We evaluate Macaron-V1 on Personal Intelligence, GenUI, and general capability benchmarks against frontier baselines. Our results validate the current system, while compounding gains from continual learning and collective intelligence remain open questions.

</details>


### [171] [Distill Skills into Weights, Not Prompts: Abstract Skills as Privileged Signals for On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09826)
*Yubo Jiang,Fengying Xie,Zhiguo Jiang,Haopeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SKALD框架，通过抽象技能卡片引导的知识蒸馏解决强化学习中群体相对奖励信号缺失问题，在数学基准测试上显著提升模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习中使用可验证奖励时，当rollout组完全正确或完全错误时（占63.0-68.0%的情况），无法提供群体相对信号，导致监督信号稀疏。

Method: 提出SKALD（技能锚定潜在蒸馏）框架：1）使用双视角架构——仅问题学生模型和基于抽象技能卡片条件的教师模型；2）学生模型在自己的前缀上训练，转移技能诱导的优势；3）采用退火指数倾斜目标函数处理分布不匹配；4）引入经验门控机制，仅在验证rollouts估计正教师优势时激活蒸馏。

Result: 在五个数学基准测试上，SKALD相比GRPO在0.6B、1.7B、4B模型上avg@8分别提升+2.46、+4.85、+12.01。在1.7B模型上，零方差蒸馏可恢复84.7%的完整增益，SKALD比FLOP匹配的GRPO高出+4.06，比上下文技能暴露高出+3.77。

Conclusion: 抽象技能能够在群体相对奖励失去信息量的情况下提供密集监督信号，有效解决了强化学习中的信号缺失问题，显著提升了模型性能。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards yields no group-relative signal when rollout groups are uniformly correct or uniformly wrong, which account for 63.0-68.0% of groups in our experiments. We propose SKALD (Skill-Anchored Latent Distillation), an on-policy self-distillation framework that uses two context views of the same Qwen3-Base model: a question-only student and a teacher conditioned on an abstract, explicit-answer-filtered skill card. The student is trained on its own prefixes, transferring the skill-induced advantage into shared parameters without privileged input at test time. To stabilize context-induced distribution mismatch, SKALD employs an annealed exponentially tilted objective that downweights teacher-preferred tokens with very low student likelihood; as the tilt vanishes, it converges to teacher cross-entropy and recovers the forward-KL student gradient. An empirical gate activates distillation only when verified rollouts estimate a positive teacher advantage. Across five held-out mathematics benchmarks, SKALD improves overall avg@8 over GRPO by +2.46, +4.85, and +12.01 at 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, respectively. At 1.7B, zero-variance-only distillation recovers 84.7% of the full gain, while SKALD remains +4.06 above FLOP-matched GRPO and exceeds contextual skill exposure by +3.77. These results show that abstract skills provide dense supervision where group-relative rewards become uninformative.

</details>


### [172] [Deep Multimodal Wearable Sensor Fusion for Detection of Body-Focused Repetitive Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09830)
*Samaneh Rezaeimanesh,Mohsen Behradfar,Mohammad Fili,Guiping Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究开发了多模态深度学习框架，利用腕戴式传感器数据检测和分类身体聚焦重复行为，在二分类检测中F1分数达0.985，为可穿戴设备辅助心理健康诊断奠定了基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 身体聚焦重复行为（如拔毛、抠皮肤）常与强迫症和焦虑症相关，但由于这些动作细微且与正常手势重叠，早期客观检测仍然困难。现有方法难以准确区分病理性行为与普通动作，亟需开发客观、准确的自动检测方法。

Method: 使用Child Mind Institute通过Helios腕戴设备收集的多模态传感器数据，包括惯性测量单元、热电堆传感器和飞行时间传感器。开发了结合卷积神经网络与门控循环单元的多模态深度学习框架，配合模态特定自编码器和后期融合分类器，充分挖掘时空动态特征。

Result: 二分类检测任务中F1分数达0.985，ROC曲线下面积为0.997；九分类任务中宏平均F1分数为0.700，曲线下面积为0.963，均优于单模态基线。事后可解释性分析显示飞行时间和惯性模态主导判别能力，误分类主要由手势解剖区域驱动。

Conclusion: 多模态传感器融合能够实现准确、客观、连续的行为监测，为实时可穿戴设备辅助心理健康诊断和个性化干预在生物医学研究和临床护理中的应用奠定了基础。

Abstract: Body-focused repetitive behaviors, such as hair pulling and skin picking, are compulsive motor actions commonly associated with obsessive-compulsive and anxiety disorders. Their early, objective detection remains difficult because the movements are subtle and overlap with ordinary, non-pathological gestures. We developed and evaluated a multimodal deep learning framework to detect and classify these behaviors from wrist-worn sensor data. The data, collected by the Child Mind Institute using the Helios wrist-worn device, combine inertial measurement units, thermopile sensors, and time-of-flight sensors, capturing kinematic, thermal, and proximity information. The framework combined a convolutional neural network with a gated recurrent unit, alongside modality-specific autoencoders and a late-fusion classifier, to exploit temporal and spatial dynamics. It achieved an F1 score of 0.985 and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.997 for binary detection, distinguishing these behaviors from other activities, and a macro-averaged F1 score of 0.700 with an area under the curve of 0.963 across a nine-class scheme that distinguished each individual behavior from a single grouped Non-Target class, improving over single-modality baselines. Post-hoc interpretability based on Shapley additive explanations showed that the time-of-flight and inertial modalities dominated discriminative power by capturing spatial proximity and dynamic movement, while hierarchical clustering indicated that misclassifications were driven primarily by the anatomical region of the gesture. These findings demonstrate that multimodal sensor fusion enables accurate, objective, and continuous behavioral monitoring. This work establishes a foundation for real-time, wearable-assisted mental health diagnostics and personalized interventions in biomedical research and clinical care.

</details>


### [173] [Real-Time Climate Risk Assessment for Supply Chain Resilience: A Data-Driven Nowcasting Framework for Colombian Agriculture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09846)
*Hernan J. Silva-Sosa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个利用数据驱动的临近预报技术进行实时气候风险评估的方法论框架，旨在提升哥伦比亚农业背景下的供应链韧性。该框架通过整合短期气候预测与供应链风险建模，建立早期预警系统架构，并将临近预报转化为可操作的风险指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 哥伦比亚的气候变率特征表现为降雨不规则、温度波动和极端事件频发，这些因素直接影响农业生产和物流，尤其是对时间敏感的作物。现有方法往往缺乏将气候信息与供应链决策有效整合的机制，因此需要开发一个能够提供早期预警并支持前瞻性决策的方法论框架。

Method: 提出的方法论框架将基于历史气象观测的短期气候预测与供应链风险建模相集成，建立了概念性早期预警系统架构。该方法通过明确的风险映射、基于阈值的分类和面向利益相关者的风险信号来解决气候临近预报与供应链决策的整合问题。在受控计算环境中开发了原型实现，使用源自官方统计和再分析产品的历史气象和农业时间序列数据进行验证，而不依赖卫星图像或计算机视觉组件。

Result: 通过合成数据和历史数据实验的结果表明，短期降水临近预报可以转化为农业供应链的可操作风险指标。原型实现证明了该方法论框架的可行性，能够支持与库存、采购和运输相关的预期决策。

Conclusion: 本研究证明了将数据驱动的气候临近预报技术应用于农业供应链风险管理的可行性。所提出的方法论框架能够有效整合气候信息与供应链决策，为农业供应链韧性提升提供了概念性早期预警系统架构，支持利益相关者进行前瞻性的风险管理决策。

Abstract: This paper presents a methodological framework for real-time climate risk assessment using data-driven nowcasting techniques to enhance supply chain resilience in Colombian agricultural contexts. Climate variability in Colombia, characterized by irregular rainfall, temperature fluctuations, and recurrent extreme events, has a direct impact on agricultural production and logistics, particularly for time sensitive crops. The proposed approach integrates short term climate forecasting based on historical meteorological observations with supply chain risk modeling to establish a conceptual early warning system architecture. A prototype implementation developed in a controlled computational environment demonstrates the feasibility of the framework using historical meteorological and agricultural time series derived from official statistics and reanalysis products, without reliance on satellite imagery or computer vision components. The methodology addresses the integration of climate nowcasting with supply chain decision making through explicit risk mapping, threshold-based categorization, and stakeholder-oriented risk signals. Results from synthetic and historical data experiments indicate that short term precipitation nowcasts can be translated into actionable risk indicators for agricultural supply chains, supporting anticipatory decisions related to inventory, sourcing, and transport.

</details>


### [174] [Fairness in Link Prediction Beyond Demographic Parity: A Reproducibility Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09899)
*Valentijn Oldenburg,Floris de Kam,Stef de Wildt,Jarno Nilson Balk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过复现实验验证了传统公平性指标ΔDP无法检测链接预测中的曝光偏差，而基于排名的NDKL指标能有效识别此类偏差；同时验证了MORAL后处理方法能在保持效用的同时显著改善公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平排名链接预测中广泛使用的人口统计学差异（ΔDP）指标被指出因忽略链接在排名中的位置而无法检测曝光偏差，需要验证该缺陷并评估更有效的公平性指标和方法的鲁棒性。

Method: 1）复现Mattos et al. (2025)关于ΔDP缺陷的论断；2）应用基于排名位置的NDKL指标检测曝光偏差；3）复现MORAL后处理方法的公平性改进效果；4）使用合成同质性设置、类别敏感属性、AWRF等多种公平性和效用指标进行鲁棒性评估。

Result: 实验证明ΔDP在子群体配对链接系统性排名较低时仍显示总体公平，而NDKL能检测到这类差异；MORAL方法在多样化设置和数据集上均能有效降低曝光偏差，且效用损失最小。

Conclusion: 基于曝光的公平性指标能揭示ΔDP隐藏的偏差，MORAL方法在保持竞争力的效用同时显著改善了公平性，为链接预测的公平性评估提供了更可靠的工具。

Abstract: In fair ranked link prediction, demographic parity ($Δ_\mathrm{DP}$) is a common fairness metric. Yet, Mattos et al. (2025) argue that it fails to detect exposure bias because it ignores where links appear in the ranking. In this study, we reproduce this claim by showing that $Δ_\mathrm{DP}$ can indicate aggregate parity even when some subgroup-pair links are systematically ranked lower than others. The proposed rank-aware Normalized Discounted KL-divergence (NDKL), however, does detect such disparities. We also reproduce the effectiveness of MORAL, a post-processing method that improves exposure-based fairness while maintaining competitive utility. Beyond reproduction, we assess robustness using synthetic homophily settings, categorical sensitive attributes, and additional fairness and utility metrics, including subgroup-pair-adapted Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness (AWRF). Overall, our results show that exposure-based metrics uncover biases hidden by $Δ_\mathrm{DP}$ and that MORAL reduces these biases with minimal utility loss across diverse settings and datasets. We release a corrected, reproducible implementation at https://github.com/Floris93100/reproducing-MORAL.

</details>


<div id='cs.NI'></div>

# cs.NI [[Back]](#toc)

### [175] [FedSceneX: Time-to-Target Orchestration for Same-Scene Multimodal Federated Edge Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07730)
*Dhe Yeong Tchalla,Beining Wu,Jun Huang,Shuyang Gu,Qiang Duan*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: FedSceneX通过优化联邦学习轮次组成，将每轮活跃时间降至3.31小时，在20小时预算内实现最高准确率并保持四种模态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦学习以通信轮次作为评估标准存在误导性，因为不同方法和模态（摄像头、视频、LiDAR、雷达）的训练和通信成本差异巨大（每轮3.3到9.8小时），导致基于轮次的比较不公平。

Method: 提出FedSceneX编排器，采用每小时价值定价（VHP）方法：通过参数变换将分数目标转换，对上行链路约束进行对偶化，获得封闭形式的客户端价格；基于价格选择客户端、通过反向注水分配精度，并将更新分配给边缘服务器。

Result: 在nuScenes基准测试中，FedSceneX将每轮活跃时间降至3.31小时（基线为4.85-9.78小时），在20小时预算内达到最高准确率并保持四种模态；优势在10-45小时持续，之后传统方法反超。

Conclusion: 通过联合优化轮次组成和资源分配，FedSceneX有效解决了多模态联邦学习中的工作量不均问题，实现了学习效率的显著提升。

Abstract: Federated learning at the sensing edge is typically evaluated by communication rounds, yet a round does not represent a fixed amount of work. Even on identical hardware, the methods we compare require 3.3 to 9.8 hours per round, which makes round-based comparisons misleading. The problem is more obvious for same-scene multimodal clients, since camera, video, LiDAR, and radar workloads differ substantially in training and communication cost, while existing methods treat the modality composition of each round as fixed. To address it, we introduce FedSceneX, an orchestrator that jointly determines round composition to maximize learning value per active hour. The optimization method, Value-per-Hour Pricing (VHP), converts the fractional objective through a parametric transformation and dualizes the uplink constraint, yielding a closed-form client price whose weights capture resource shadow costs. Based on these prices, FedSceneX selects clients subject to a modality coverage constraint, allocates precision through reverse water filling, and assigns updates to edge servers. On the full nuScenes benchmark with fifteen clients and twelve baselines, FedSceneX reduces the active time per round to 3.31 hours, compared with 4.85 to 9.78 hours for the baselines. Across all random seeds, it achieves the highest accuracy within a twenty-hour budget while preserving all four modalities. Its advantage persists from ten to forty-five hours, after which conventional methods overtake it.

</details>


### [176] [Coordinated Spectrum Coexistence Across Heterogeneous Commercial and Federal Services](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07789)
*Minh Dat Nguyen,Paolo Testolina,Pedram Johari,Michele Polese,Tommaso Melodia*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一框架，实现蜂窝通信、射频感知、无线电导航和雷达定位在联邦sub-6 GHz频谱上的动态共享，在满足感知和定位QoS约束下显著提升频谱效率和蜂窝吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来无线网络需要在拥堵的联邦sub-6 GHz频谱上支持蜂窝通信、射频感知、无线电导航和雷达定位等多种服务的共存，受到蜂窝流量需求增长、6G感知与定位服务激增以及监管压力（在不驱逐现有用户的前提下重新利用联邦频段）的驱动。

Method: 开发统一框架使四种服务在集中协调下动态共享公共物理资源块(PRB)池，构建加权蜂窝总速率最大化问题，受限于占空比、正交性、感知信噪比(SNR)和基于Cramer-Rao的定位约束；采用交替优化方法求解混合整数非线性规划(MINLP)，包括PRB分配、调度和逐次凸逼近功率分配，并提出低复杂度QoS感知贪婪启发式算法。

Result: 基于BostonTwin城市数字孪生的特定场景射线追踪仿真表明，在严格满足感知和定位QoS约束的同时，频谱效率和蜂窝吞吐量获得显著提升。

Conclusion: 协调的多服务共享是下一代军用和民用网络中蜂窝-联邦-雷达共存的可行的架构方案。

Abstract: Future wireless networks are expected to support the coexistence of cellular communications, radio frequency (RF) sensing, radionavigation, and radiolocation radar-among others-over congested federal sub-6 GHz spectrum under heterogeneous Quality of Service (QoS) requirements, driven by escalating cellular traffic demand, the proliferation of 6G sensing and positioning services, and regulatory pressure to repurpose federal bands without displacing incumbents. We develop a unified framework in which all four services dynamically share a common Physical Resource Block (PRB) pool under centralized coordination, formulating weighted cellular sum-rate maximization subject to duty-cycle, orthogonality, sensing signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and Cramer-Rao-based positioning constraints. The resulting Mixed-Integer Nonlinear Program (MINLP) is solved by alternating optimization across PRB assignment, scheduling, and successive convex approximation for power allocation, complemented by a low-complexity QoS-aware greedy heuristic. Site-specific ray-tracing simulations on the BostonTwin urban digital twin show substantial gains in spectrum efficiency and cellular throughput while strictly meeting sensing and positioning QoS, establishing coordinated multi-service sharing as a viable architecture for cellular-federal-radar coexistence in next-generation military and civilian networks.

</details>


### [177] [Orchestrated Vulnerability Management for Heterogeneous Networks: Adaptive Two-Stage Vulnerability Assessment, Context-Aware Risk Prioritization, and Automated Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08162)
*Ricardo Lopes,Jose Moura,Rui Neto Marinheiro*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种SOAR编排的漏洞管理框架，通过自适应评估、上下文感知风险排序和自动化缓解，显著提高了异构网络中的漏洞管理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构网络由于设备多样性、脆弱的运行条件和异构的固件及服务配置，面临重大安全挑战。传统漏洞管理依赖静态扫描和基于严重性的优先级排序，忽视了漏洞利用的可能性和资产上下文，导致缓解延迟和运营开销增加。

Method: 提出一种SOAR编排的漏洞管理框架，集成了被动资产发现、自适应两阶段漏洞评估、上下文感知风险评估和基于SDN的自动化缓解。检测引擎根据设备能力采用定制化评估策略；风险评估结合CVSS严重性、EPSS利用概率和上下文属性；缓解措施通过OpenFlow和IDS策略自动执行，范围从监控、选择性服务隔离到完全主机隔离。

Result: 自适应两阶段评估将扫描时间减少高达91%，并在初始阶段识别71%的基线漏洞。上下文感知风险模型将需要立即缓解的漏洞减少约75%，且未遗漏任何已验证利用的漏洞。与常规评估相比，框架将32台物理主机的评估时间减少高达45%，并在毫秒级内执行缓解措施。

Conclusion: 该框架通过自适应评估、上下文感知优先级排序和自动化缓解，实现了高效且可扩展的漏洞管理，显著提升了异构网络环境下的安全性和运营效率。

Abstract: Heterogeneous networks pose significant security challenges due to device diversity, fragile operating conditions, and heterogeneous firmware and service configurations. Traditional vulnerability management often relies on static scanning and severity-based prioritization, overlooking exploitation likelihood and asset context. This can delay mitigation and increase operational overhead. This paper proposes a SOAR-orchestrated vulnerability management framework integrating passive asset discovery, adaptive two-stage vulnerability assessment, context-aware risk assessment, and automated SDN-based mitigation. The detection engine progressively characterizes device attack surfaces using assessment strategies tailored to device capabilities, minimizing disruption to resource-constrained IoT assets. Risk assessment combines CVSS severity, EPSS exploitation probability, and contextual attributes to prioritize vulnerabilities by operational risk. Based on risk bands, mitigation is automatically enforced through coordinated OpenFlow and IDS policies, ranging from monitoring and selective service isolation to complete host quarantine. Experimental results demonstrate the framework's effectiveness. Adaptive two-stage assessment reduces scan time by up to 91% while identifying 71% of baseline vulnerabilities during the initial stage before selectively triggering further analysis. The context-aware risk model reduces vulnerabilities requiring immediate mitigation by approximately 75% without missing any vulnerability with verified exploitation. Compared with conventional assessment, the framework reduces assessment time for 32 physical hosts by up to 45% and enforces mitigation within milliseconds, enabling efficient and scalable vulnerability management through adaptive assessment, context-aware prioritization, and automated mitigation.

</details>


### [178] [WirelessOpsAgent: A Benchmark and Agent Design for Action Assurance in Wireless Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08277)
*Zijian Lu,Yiping Zuo,Hao Xu,Weicong Chen,Xin He,Jiajia Guo,Shi Jin*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了WirelessOptBench基准和WirelessOpsAgent智能体，用于解决无线网络操作中大语言模型规划器的执行时安全问题，显著降低了不安全操作率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准主要评估基于固定观测的任务求解能力，但未检验执行时支持数据的时效性和一致性；在无线网络场景中，即使是提案时正确的任务答案，若遥测数据过期或不一致，执行时仍可能不安全。

Method: 提出WirelessOptBench基准，将无线任务转化为带有受控遥测故障和动作约束的执行状态决策片段；开发WirelessOpsAgent，在执行前将候选动作锚定当前证据，并修复可恢复的支持失败。

Result: 在三个骨干模型的600个片段评估中，WirelessOpsAgent的精确动作准确率最高达0.983；在Claude Sonnet 4.6上，不安全应用率相对于最安全基线从82.2%降至10.3%。

Conclusion: 所提方法有效提升了无线网络操作中LLM智能体的执行安全性，为自主无线网络操作的行动保障提供了新的评测基准和解决方案。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are emerging as planners for autonomous wireless network operations. Yet a task answer that is correct at proposal time can still be unsafe at execution time if supporting telemetry is stale or inconsistent. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate task solving from fixed observations and leave support checking at execution time untested. We introduce WirelessOptBench, a benchmark for action assurance in wireless operations. It turns wireless tasks into execution state decision episodes with controlled telemetry faults and action constraints. We further develop WirelessOpsAgent, which grounds candidate actions in current evidence and repairs recoverable support failures before execution. Across three backbone evaluations with 600 episodes each, WirelessOpsAgent achieves up to 0.983 Exact Action Accuracy. On Claude Sonnet 4.6, the Unsafe APPLY Rate decreases from 82.2% to 10.3% relative to the safest baseline. We make WirelessOptBench available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/wirelessopsbench-artifact-D969/.

</details>


### [179] [PSP: Low-Overhead Packet-Level Load Balancing for Stale-State and Bandwidth-Asymmetric Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08425)
*Jiaqi Liu,Chunyang Zhang,Heng Pan,Yanbiao Li*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出概率状态比例（PSP）分组级负载均衡算法，通过基于带状的离散状态表示和局部概率映射降低硬件复杂度，有效解决AI数据中心网络中的微突发流量问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型训练和生成式AI服务的快速增长使数据中心网络面临严重的微突发流量和高并发挑战。传统基于哈希的流级负载均衡无法感知链路状态，导致哈希冲突、热点拥塞和尾延迟；现有分组级方案则受限于陈旧状态信息、高硬件复杂度和对异构链路适应性差。

Method: 提出概率状态比例（PSP）分组级负载均衡算法。采用基于带状的离散状态表示，用局部概率映射替代全局排序，在抑制陈旧状态引起的群集和振荡问题的同时降低硬件复杂度。

Result: 在周期精确模拟器上的实验表明，PSP在端口规模、带宽受限路径和固定流干扰场景下表现稳健。在丢包率、99分位缓冲区占用和可扩展性方面优于最短队列优先（JSQ）调度和Random算法，在较低硬件成本下与Top-k算法保持竞争力。

Conclusion: PSP为AI数据中心提供了性能、稳定性和开销之间的有效平衡，是一种实用且高效的负载均衡解决方案。

Abstract: With the rapid growth of large language model training and generative artificial intelligence services, data center networks face severe micro-burst traffic and high concurrency. Traditional hash-based flow-level load balancing cannot sense link states, leading to hash collisions, hotspot congestion, and tail latency in multipath Clos networks. Existing packet-level schemes are constrained by stale state information, high hardware complexity, and poor adaptation to heterogeneous links.
  To address these issues, this paper proposes probabilistic state-proportional (PSP) dispatching, a packet-level load balancing algorithm. Using a Band-based discrete state representation, PSP replaces global sorting with local probability mapping, reducing hardware complexity while suppressing herding and oscillations caused by stale states.
  Experiments on a cycle-accurate simulator show that PSP is robust across port scales, bandwidth-limited paths, and fixed-flow interference. It outperforms join-the-shortest-queue (JSQ) scheduling and Random in loss rate, 99th-percentile buffer occupancy, and scalability, while remaining competitive with Top-k at lower hardware cost. PSP provides an effective balance among performance, stability, and overhead for artificial intelligence data centers.

</details>


### [180] [Carrier Leakage Suppression and Power Difference Equalization for TFDMA Coherent PON](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08444)
*Ji Zhou,Haide Wang,Liangchuan Li,Changyuan Yu,Xiangjun Xin*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文展示了基于半导体光放大器(SOA)的载流子泄漏抑制和功率差均衡技术，用于TFDMA相干PON系统，并提出了非线性补偿算法来解决SOA引入的非线性失真问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在TFDMA(时分频分多址)相干无源光网络(PON)系统中，半导体光放大器(SOA)存在载流子泄漏和非线性失真问题，影响系统性能和功率均衡，需要开发有效的抑制和补偿技术。

Method: 采用基于SOA的技术实现载流子泄漏抑制和功率差均衡；开发非线性补偿算法来处理SOA引入的非线性失真。

Result: 成功展示了载流子泄漏抑制和功率差均衡效果，所提出的非线性补偿算法能够有效处理SOA引起的非线性失真问题。

Conclusion: 基于SOA的技术方案结合非线性补偿算法为TFDMA相干PON系统提供了有效的性能优化解决方案，改善了系统的传输质量和功率管理能力。

Abstract: In this invited talk, we demonstrate the carrier leakage suppression and power difference equalization based on semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) for TFDMA-based coherent PON, and propose a nonlinearity compensation algorithm to deal with SOA-induced nonlinear distortion.

</details>


### [181] [Active Hemispherical Metasurface Transmitarray Antenna for Wide-Angle 3D Beam Steering and Target Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08991)
*Somayeh Komeylian,Christopher Paolini*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文开发了一种工作在250 GHz的堆叠多层半球形石墨烯透射阵列天线，实现了-78°到78°仰角和360°全方位的宽带波束扫描。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为实现宽角度三维波束扫描，需要开发能够在高频段(250 GHz)工作并具有稳定辐射特性的新型天线结构。传统天线难以同时实现宽带阻抗匹配、高效率和宽角度扫描能力。

Method: 开发了首个完全自动化的CST Studio Suite宏，用于构建多层半球形几何结构并配置121个独立可调的石墨烯扇区。通过将电压控制石墨烯扇区与FCC金贴片集成，实现了对天线辐射特性的动态调控。

Result: 天线实现了-78°到78°的仰角扫描范围和360°全方位覆盖，保持稳定的辐射特性和40%相对带宽的宽带阻抗匹配(|S11| < -10 dB)。天线指向性为11.38-14.72 dBi，副瓣电平为-6.8到-9.8 dB，天线效率达71%-80%，整个扫描范围内性能退化仅5%。

Conclusion: 该天线在宽角度波束扫描、宽带阻抗匹配和高效率方面展现出优异性能，是实际移动目标跟踪应用的有前景的候选方案。自动化设计方法为复杂多层半球形天线结构的开发提供了有效工具。

Abstract: A stacked multilayer hemispherical graphene-based transmitarray antenna operating at 250 GHz is developed to achieve wide-angle 3D beam steering. This work presents the first fully automated CST Studio Suite macro for constructing the multilayer hemispherical geometry and configuring 121 independently tunable graphene sectors. Numerical results confirm that the integration of voltage-controlled graphene sectors with FCC gold patches enables wide-angle beam steering, achieving an elevation scanning range of -78° to 78° in θ and full 360° azimuthal coverage while maintaining stable radiation characteristics and broadband impedance matching (|S11| < -10 dB) with a relative bandwidth of 40%. The antenna achieves a directivity range of 11.38 - 14.72 dBi and an SLL range of -6.8 to -9.8 dB across all investigated steering directions. It also maintains high antenna efficiencies from 71% to 80% with a 5% degradation due to imperfections across the entire scanning range, making it a promising candidate in practical moving-target-tracking applications.

</details>


### [182] [SparsePilot: Belief-Guided Network Planning under Sparse Wireless Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09199)
*Xuanhao Luo,Jiayuan Huang,Longyu Zhou,Mingzhe Chen,Yuchen Liu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出了SparsePilot框架，在仅使用约3.1%的测量预算条件下，解决了严重观测约束下的UAV无线覆盖规划问题，实现了优异的覆盖恢复性能和跨场景泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的UAV控制方法通常依赖密集的用户级RSS测量，但这种全观测假设在现实部署中因高成本和有限可用性而难以满足。稀疏反馈决策成为根本性挑战。

Method: 提出SparsePilot感知-控制框架：将空间探测建模为网格单元上的多臂老虎机问题，采用UCB探测选择信息区域，将稀疏RSS测量聚合为覆盖信念地图；深度强化学习控制器基于信念状态生成连续UAV移动动作，无需访问完整无线状态。

Result: 在七个城市数字孪生实验中，SparsePilot仅使用约3.1%的全观测测量预算即实现优越的覆盖恢复性能，并在未见过的城市级无线环境中展现出强跨场景泛化能力。

Conclusion: 提供了连接稀疏探测、信念估计误差和稀疏反馈性能差距的理论分析，证明了所提框架在测量效率、覆盖性能和泛化能力方面的有效性。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have emerged as a promising solution for on-demand wireless coverage planning in urban environments. Existing learning-based UAV control methods, however, typically rely on continuous access to dense user-level received signal strength (RSS) measurements. Such full-observation assumptions are difficult to satisfy in real-world deployments due to the high cost and limited availability of dense wireless feedback. Sparse-feedback decision making under severe observation constraints therefore represents a fundamental challenge. To fill this gap, we propose SparsePilot, a measurement-efficient sensing-control framework that couples active wireless probing with belief-guided network control. SparsePilot formulates spatial probing as a multi-armed bandit problem over grid cells, uses upper confidence bound probing to select informative regions, and aggregates sparse RSS measurements into a coverage belief map. A deep reinforcement learning controller then uses this belief state to generate continuous UAV mobility actions, while the full wireless state remains hidden from the policy. We further provide a theoretical analysis connecting sparse probing, belief estimation error, and the sparse-feedback performance gap. Experiments across seven urban digital twins show that SparsePilot achieves superior coverage restoration performance while using only about 3.1% of the full-observation measurement budget and demonstrates strong cross-scene generalization to unseen urban-scale wireless environments.

</details>


### [183] [Automated Synthesis of Deterministic Cross-Domain Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09312)
*Konstantinos Christodoulopoulos,Antonis Selentis-Boulntadakis*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个自动合成确定性网络域间合约的框架，利用LLM代理搜索配置机制并构建网络模型，结合网络演算内核和独立验证器，实现了静态和动态合约的自动生成，在5G前传和TSN桥接场景中验证了其有效性和高效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有确定性网络跨域合约依赖手工制定，静态且过度配置，难以适应动态流量变化。虽然端到端合约组合已有标准，但各域合约的推导缺乏自动化方法，亟需一种能自动合成静态和动态合约的框架。

Method: 框架包含两个LLM驱动的推理模块：（1）代理模块接收客户端流量声明并搜索载波配置机制；（2）处理模块从基底的类型化披露构建网络模型，调用网络演算内核处理硬约束项，并利用独立预言机（仿真器/测试床/现网）验证候选方案并发现重配置的安全时机。实现了LLM构建模型、形式化工具保证数值正确性的分工协作。

Result: 在TDM-PON承载5G上行前传场景中，六次LLM采样均成功生成可行且经过验证的动态合约，时延紧至约1.2μs，满足100μs截止时间（反应式调度无法达成），带宽效率达静态过度配置的3.5倍。相比之下，直接让LLM计算最坏时延时六次中有五次不可靠。同一框架在第二基底上成功合成了静态5G-TSN桥接合约。

Conclusion: 该框架成功实现了确定性网络域间合约的自动合成，证明了LLM与形式化工具分工的有效性：LLM负责模型构建，形式化工具掌握数值权威。框架在静态和动态合约合成中均表现良好，显著提升了带宽效率并降低了过度配置，为动态确定性网络提供了可行的自动化解决方案。

Abstract: Deterministic networking spans heterogeneous domains. At each boundary, two domains must agree on an assume--guarantee contract: what traffic the client may inject, and the QoS the carrier will hold for it. Composing such contracts into an end-to-end guarantee is standardized, but deriving each domain's contract is not. Today they are hand-crafted, static, and over-provisioned. The difficulty rises when traffic changes and the contract must become dynamic. We present a framework that automatically synthesizes the per-domain contract for both static and dynamic classes, along with the registration the dynamic one rests on. Two reasoning modules implemented with large language models (LLMs) drive it: an agent takes the client's traffic declaration and searches the carrier's configuration mechanisms, and a handler builds the network model from a typed disclosure of the substrate. The handler calls a network-calculus kernel for the model's hard terms, and an independent oracle---a faithful simulator, testbed, or live network---which verifies each candidate and discovers what lacks an a-priori algebraic form: when a reconfiguration is safe, and the instant to apply it. We synthesized a dynamic contract for uplink 5G fronthaul over a TDM-PON, grounded against a packet-level simulator. Across six draws from two LLM families, every synthesis produced a feasible, verified contract tight to ${\sim}1.2\,μ$s, holding a $100$-$μ$s deadline that reactive scheduling cannot meet, at up to $3.5$ times the bandwidth efficiency of static over-provisioning. Tasked instead with computing the worst-case delay directly, the LLMs were unsound in five of six attempts---evidence for the division of labor: LLMs construct the model, formal tools hold numeric authority. The same framework, unchanged, synthesized a static 5G--TSN bridge contract on a second substrate.

</details>


### [184] [Enabling Beyond-Visual-Line-of-Sight Drones Operation over Open RAN 5G Networks with Slicing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09481)
*Pau Baguer,Esteban Municio,Gines Garcia-Aviles,Xavier Costa-Pérez*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文部署了一个基于5G O-RAN开源技术的BVLoS无人机操作系统，通过切片技术解决了5G链路拥塞问题，显著降低延迟并满足BVLoS操作的严格要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着5G向6G演进，超视距（BVLoS）无人机操作成为物联网机器人应用的关键使能技术。然而BVLoS操作对性能和可靠性有严格要求，当前5G技术在吞吐量和延迟方面虽能满足需求，但在实际部署中如何实现完全可靠性缺乏研究，且缺乏有效的监管框架和实验验证平台。

Method: 部署了一个最先进的5G O-RAN开源BVLoS操作系统，利用O-RAN原生支持的网络切片（Slicing）能力来解决5G链路拥塞问题，并通过实验验证了系统的有效性。

Result: 提出的部署方案最小化了因5G链路拥塞导致的轨迹误差，延迟远低于3GPP为BVLoS操作定义的限值，有效满足了BVLoS操作的性能和可靠性要求。

Conclusion: O-RAN标准的开放性为BVLoS无人机操作提供了集成化、原生的解决方案，切片技术能有效解决可靠性问题。未来仍面临挑战，但5G O-RAN网络为BVLoS无人机操作带来了新的机遇。

Abstract: Among the foretold claims of the transition from 5G to 6G, Beyond-Visual-Line-of-Sight (BVLoS) drone operation has emerged as a prominent Internet-of-Robots enabler. However, safety concerns have been raised since BVLoS imposes strict requirements on performance and dependability on the technology, and requires robust regulatory frameworks. While current 5G technologies promise to meet the performance requirements in terms of throughput and latency, there is a lack of studies regarding how to achieve full reliability in practice. To address this challenge, the research community is actively working on open-source projects that allow for experimental validation in the field. Fortunately, new Open RAN (O-RAN) standards are paving the way for such approaches in an integrated, native manner. In this work, we deploy a state-of-the-art 5G O-RAN open-source BVLoS operational system, report current limitations, and address them via advanced capabilities natively available in O-RAN: Slicing. Our proposed deployment minimizes trajectory errors due to 5G link congestion and keeps latency well below the 3GPP limits defined for BVLoS operation. Finally, we discuss on the challenges ahead and the opportunities that 5G O-RAN-enabled networks may bring to BVLoS drone operation.

</details>


### [185] [A Semantic Communication Approach to Fiducial Marker Processing in 5G-Enabled Edge SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09620)
*Boris Radovanovic,Vukan Ninkovic,Katarina Vidojevic,Buda Bajic Papuga,Dejan Vukobratovic*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向5G边缘SLAM的语义分割推理框架，通过将DeepTag卷积神经网络在机器人和边缘服务器之间进行分割，实现了基于语义信息的基准标记处理，在真实5G测试平台上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主机器人依赖边缘计算卸载计算密集型感知任务以保持实时性，但传统基准标记检测流程缺乏高效的任务分割机会，难以适应通信感知的边缘部署需求。

Method: 提出语义分割推理框架，将DeepTag启发的卷积神经网络在机器人端和边缘服务器端进行分割，中间特征表示作为任务导向的语义信息通过无线链路传输；框架集成到ROS2机器人架构中并在真实5G通信测试平台上进行验证。

Result: 实验结果表明该方法能够实现准确的关键点估计，展示了对下游位姿估计的影响，并量化了不同分割点带来的通信-计算权衡关系。

Conclusion: 该框架为连接机器人系统中深度视觉感知的通信感知部署提供了实用见解，证明了分割推理在5G边缘计算场景下的有效性。

Abstract: Autonomous robots increasingly rely on edge computing to offload computationally intensive perception tasks while maintaining real-time operation over 5G networks. However, conventional fiducial marker detection pipelines provide limited opportunities for efficient task partitioning, making them poorly suited for communication-aware edge deployment. This paper proposes a semantic split inference framework for fiducial marker processing in 5G-enabled Edge SLAM. A DeepTag-inspired convolutional neural network is partitioned between the robot and the edge server, where intermediate feature representations serve as task-oriented semantic information transmitted over the wireless link. The framework is integrated into a ROS2-based robotic architecture and characterized over a real 5G communication testbed. Experimental results demonstrate accurate keypoint estimation, illustrate the impact on downstream pose estimation, and quantify the communication--computation trade-offs associated with different split points, providing practical insights for communication-aware deployment of deep visual perception in connected robotic systems.

</details>


### [186] [Abstractions for Network Intelligence: A Reference Architecture for AI at the Wireless Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09640)
*Salil Reddy,Haohuang Wen,Ness Shroff,Venki Ramaswamy,Zhiqiang Lin,Elisa Bertino,Jim Kurose,Anish Arora*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出AI-EDGE参考架构，通过信息腰支持智能应用与智能网络的协同交互，解决当前互联网架构中感知共享支持不足的问题，并在O-RAN和MEC等平台上提供组件级设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络和AI应用正在相互融合，感知共享有望提升网络利用率和应用性能，但现有互联网架构对此支持不足，缺乏有效的协同机制。

Method: 提出AI-EDGE参考架构，引入信息腰抽象支持智能应用与网络的协同交互；基于O-RAN蜂窝网络和ETSI MEC等现有平台，设计核心抽象的参考组件级架构。

Result: 成功设计了支持感知共享、可移植性、原型开发和验证的架构；从不同用户视角展示了代表性用例，验证了架构在意识共享、可移植性、原型开发和验证方面的优势。

Conclusion: AI-EDGE架构能够有效支持网络与AI应用的协同，为未来智能网络中的感知共享和服务提供了可行的架构方案和实验基础。

Abstract: Networks are increasingly adopting AI as are AI applications leveraging networks. Awareness sharing between networks and AI applications promises to unlock higher levels of network utilization and application performance, but is inadequately supported in the current architecture of the Internet. In this paper, we describe a reference architecture that abstractly enables the synergistic interaction of intelligent applications and the intelligent network, via an information waist, and also supports the network intelligence services in the emerging intelligence plane in networks. We discuss the rationale for our AI-EDGE architecture, its functional requirements, and the core abstractions. We present a reference component-level design of the core abstractions to support experimentation and development on existing platforms for wireless networking (i.e., based on O-RAN cellular networks) and edge computing (i.e., based on 3GPP Edge App and ETSI MEC). Moreover, we provide representative use cases from the perspective of different types of users that demonstrate the benefits of the architecture in contexts of awareness sharing, portability, prototyping, and validation.

</details>


<div id='cs.OS'></div>

# cs.OS [[Back]](#toc)

### [187] [Velosiraptor: Code Synthesis for Memory Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07966)
*Reto Achermann,Em Chu,Ryan Mehri,Ilias Karimalis,Margo Seltzer*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: Velosiraptor是一个自动生成操作系统内存硬件配置代码的系统，通过软件合成技术将高级硬件描述转换为验证过的实现，解决了手动适配新硬件带来的安全风险和开发负担。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 操作系统的安全性高度依赖于正确配置内存硬件，但硬件机制不断演进导致操作系统代码适配成为手动、重复且耗时的任务，容易引入破坏安全隔离保证的关键漏洞。

Method: 采用软件合成技术，利用问题的领域特异性提高合成效率。开发者仅需编写内存硬件映射行为和操作系统环境的高级描述，工具链将其转换为可直接链接到操作系统的验证实现。

Result: Velosiraptor成功实现了从高级规范自动生成正确的内存硬件配置代码，支持操作系统移植到新硬件平台，同时同一规范还可用于生成硬件组件。

Conclusion: 该系统解放了操作系统开发者免于手动编写内存硬件配置代码，实现了跨平台移植并支持新翻译机制的研究，显著提升了开发效率和安全性保证。

Abstract: Security is among the top concerns of operating system (OS) developers. A secure runtime environment relies on the OS to correctly configure the memory hardware on which it runs. This is mission-critical as it provides essential security-relevant features and abstractions that ensure the integrity and isolation of untrusted applications running alongside each other. Configuring a platform's memory hardware is not a one-off effort as designers constantly develop new mechanisms for translation and protection with different features and means of configuration. Adapting the OS code to the new hardware is not only a manual, repetitive and time consuming task, it may also introduce subtle, but security critical bugs that break security and isolation guarantees.
  We present Velosiraptor, a system that automatically generates correct, low-level OS code that programs the memory hardware of a machine. Velosiraptor leverages software synthesis techniques and exploits the domain specificity of the problem to make the synthesis process efficient. With Velosiraptor, developers write only a high-level description of the memory hardware's mapping behavior and OS environment.
  The Velosiraptor toolchain transforms this specification into a verified implementation that can be linked directly with the rest of the operating system. Incorporating the OS environment into this process allows porting an OS to new hardware platforms without worrying about writing code to configure the memory hardware. We can also use the same specification to generate hardware components. This enables research in new translation mechanisms, freeing up OS developers from manually writing OS code.

</details>


<div id='cs.MA'></div>
