### [188] [MasDrift: Benchmarking Authorization Preservation Across Multi-Agent Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07556)
*Zhuoning Xu,Xiucheng Zhang,Hanjun Luo,Yingbin Jin,Yinpeng Dong,Hanan Salam*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 该论文提出了MasDrift基准，用于评估多智能体系统中的授权边界漂移问题，发现集中式架构虽然任务完成率高但未授权操作更多，并提出两种防御机制，其中重新锚定策略效果更佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体系统安全基准主要关注对抗性攻击，而对于委托目标在传递过程中可能偏离原始授权边界的问题缺乏系统性的架构级别评估。当任务在监督者和子智能体之间分解时，委托的目标可能不再携带其原始的授权边界，这可能导致智能体执行未授权的操作。

Method: 提出MasDrift基准测试，包含8个领域的600个良性生产力任务，每个任务都配对必需工作和保留操作。比较了单智能体、集中式和分散式协调架构，同时改变层级深度和对等宽度两个维度。测量任务完成率和授权保留率两个指标。进一步比较了两种防御机制：一种是将每个待处理调用重新锚定到原始用户请求，另一种是沿委托链传递衰减策略。

Result: 在通用多智能体条件下，集中式层级架构任务完成率达93.9-98.6%，而对等网络为85.7-87.0%；但未授权操作发生率分别为2.7-19.8%和0.6-0.8%，且差距随层级深度增加而扩大。重新锚定策略在所有模型配置中均能减少未授权操作，代价是任务完成率降低1.6个百分点；链式传播策略反而阻断了必需的工作，损失高达36.3个百分点。异构案例研究证实该失败源于协调机制而非模型能力。

Conclusion: MasDrift揭示了集中式架构在任务完成率和授权保留之间存在权衡：集中式层级虽然任务完成率更高，但未授权操作发生率也更高。重新锚定策略是更有效的防御机制。该基准使授权保留成为多智能体系统设计中可量化的属性，为未来安全的多智能体系统设计提供了重要参考。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) decompose long-horizon tasks across supervisors and subagents, but delegated goals do not necessarily carry their original authorization boundaries. Existing safety benchmarks mainly study adversarial compromise, while work on constraint drift lacks controlled architecture-level evaluation. We introduce MasDrift, a benchmark of 600 benign productivity tasks across eight domains. Each task pairs required work with reserved actions. MasDrift compares single-agent, centralized, and decentralized coordination while varying hierarchy depth and peer width, measuring task completion and authorization preservation. Across generic multi-agent conditions, centralized hierarchies achieve 93.9--98.6% task completion versus 85.7--87.0% for peer networks, while unauthorized actions occur in 2.7--19.8% of tasks versus 0.6--0.8%, a gap that widens with hierarchy depth. We further compare two defenses that differ in where authorization evidence resides. One re-anchors every pending call to the original user request. The other carries an attenuated policy along the delegation chain. Re-anchoring reduces unauthorized actions in every model configuration we evaluate, at a cost of 1.6 points of pooled completion. Chain propagation blocks required work instead, forfeiting up to 36.3 points. A heterogeneous case study confirms that the failure follows from coordination rather than model strength. MasDrift exposes a centralization tradeoff and makes authorization preservation a measurable property of MAS design.

</details>


### [189] [Mobility, Memory, and Network Structure in Agent-Based Models of Convention Tipping and Convergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07810)
*Joe Shymanski,Garrick Springer,Sandip Sen*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本研究通过透明代理模型分析了committed minority推动人口转变临界点的过程。发现转变几乎必然发生，mobility是主导加速因素，memory和connectivity系统性调节收敛速度。建立了预测收敛时间的统一模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在填补临界点动力学中结构性因素（网络拓扑、流动性）和行为因素（记忆限制）如何共同影响社会规范转变阈值和时间尺度的知识空白，超越仅关注是否发生转变的传统研究视角。

Method: 构建透明agent-based model，agents持有两种行为状态之一，mobile committed minority试图推翻现有规范。使用自定义agent-based仿真框架，系统研究localized mobility、bounded agent memory和network topology三者的联合影响机制。

Result: 发现在多数配置下转变具有必然性——给定足够时间，人口总是收敛到minority状态。mobility是收敛速度的主导加速器，memory和connectivity以系统性方式调节收敛过程。建立了能准确预测完全采用所需时间的统一预测模型。

Conclusion: 将经典临界点研究扩展到时间维度，证明结构和行为参数不仅决定规范转变可能性，还决定其展开的时间尺度。该机制适用于规范变迁及其他contagion-like社会过程，为理解社会动力学提供了更完整的理论框架。

Abstract: Tipping-point dynamics describe the critical conditions under which a committed minority drives a population to abandon an established convention in favor of a new one. We present a transparent agent-based model of this process, in which agents hold one of two behavioral states and a mobile committed minority attempts to overturn the incumbent convention. Our goal was to examine how localized mobility, bounded agent memory, and network topology jointly influence the tipping threshold. Using a custom agent-based simulation framework, we found that in many configurations, tipping becomes effectively inevitable: given sufficient time, the population always converges to the minority state. This observation motivated a complementary analysis focused on the pace of convergence rather than its feasibility. We introduce a unified predictive model that accurately estimates how structural and behavioral parameters determine the time required for complete adoption, showing that mobility is the dominant accelerator while memory and connectivity modulate convergence in systematic ways. Together, these results extend classical tipping-point research by linking structural and behavioral factors not only to the likelihood of convention change but also to the timescale on which it unfolds. While we frame the model in terms of convention-like binary behavioral adoption, the same mechanisms bear on norm change and other contagion-like social processes.

</details>


### [190] [Per-Shipment Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Intermodal Freight Routing Under Hurricane Disruption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07824)
*Aliza Sharmin,Xudong Wang,Mustafa Can Camur,Xueping Li*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 该研究将多式联运路径规划建模为Dec-POMDP，在15个枢纽网络的飓风干扰场景下训练IPPO算法，并与两种启发式基线进行对比。结果显示不同策略各有优劣：IPPO吞吐量(+12.7%)和交付率最优，容量感知启发式在韧性和延迟方面领先；需求激增时IPPO的韧性优势更明显；MAPPO变体因训练-评估队列不匹配而崩溃，IPPO在此场景下表现更稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多式联运网络面临气候极端事件（如飓风）带来的日益增长的干扰风险，这些事件会同时导致多条运输走廊受损，传统方法难以有效应对此类多走廊并发干扰问题，需要一种能够动态响应干扰的智能路径规划方法。

Method: 研究将货运路径规划问题建模为具有每批次货物行动粒度的Dec-POMDP（去中心化部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程），采用集中训练-去中心化执行(CTDE)框架训练独立PPO(IPPO)算法，在15个枢纽的网络模型中模拟飓风干扰场景，并与两种具有特权状态访问权限的启发式基线进行对比，同时测试MAPPO变体以比较不同的多智能体强化学习方法。

Result: 在30个匹配情景的测试中：(1)IPPO实现了最高的吞吐量(+12.7%)和交付率；(2)容量感知启发式在韧性指数(RI)和延迟方面领先；(3)在需求激增(2.9:1容量比)条件下，IPPO的韧性优势扩大到+6.4%，表明容量稀缺时学习型路由更有价值；(4)MAPPO变体因训练-评估队列不匹配而崩溃(RI=0.811)，重新训练后恢复至1.018，但IPPO仍在吞吐量上领先。

Conclusion: 研究发现在多式联运干扰管理中不存在单一最优策略，不同策略在不同指标上各有优势：IPPO在吞吐量和需求激增场景下表现优异，启发式方法在韧性指数和延迟控制方面更有优势。学习型路由在容量稀缺时价值更大。MAPPO中集中式评论器在每批次货物调度场景下存在局限性，IPPO展现出更好的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Intermodal freight networks face growing disruption risk from climate extremes that degrade multiple corridors simultaneously. To address this, we formulate freight routing as a Dec-POMDP with per-shipment action granularity and train Independent PPO (IPPO) under Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution, comparing against two heuristic baselines with privileged state access on a 15-hub network under hurricane disruption. Across 30 matched episodes, no single policy dominates: IPPO achieves the highest throughput ($+12.7\%$) and delivery rate while a capacity-aware heuristic leads on Resilience Index (RI) and delay. Under demand surge (2.9:1 capacity ratio), IPPO's RI advantage grows to $+6.4\%$, suggesting learned routing is most valuable when capacity is scarce. A Multi-Agent PPO (MAPPO) variant collapses under train-eval queue mismatch ($\mathrm{RI} = 0.811$); retraining recovers RI to $1.018$ but IPPO still leads on throughput, pointing to residual limitations in centralized critics under per-shipment dispatch.

</details>


### [191] [Decentralized Multi-Agent Urban Traffic Management via Spatio-Temporal Mobility Profile Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08035)
*Lorenzo Mario Amorosa,Lorenzo Farina,Vittorio Todisco,Alessandro Bazzi*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 提出了VeloCity框架，一种面向网联自动驾驶车辆的去中心化多智能体时空移动规划方法，在大规模城市路网中实现了更低的行程时间、确定性的避撞保障和良好的可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常仅优化局部交互而非系统整体效率，存在通信开销大、缺乏安全运动执行的确定性保障等问题；现有扩展性有限，难以应用于大规模复杂城市路网，亟需一种可扩展且具确定性保障的框架。

Method: 提出VeloCity框架，将移动profile优化下放至各车辆。车辆向局部协调器查询预约表，独立计算最快且无冲突的移动profile，并将所需时空槽预约回协调器。该方法原生适配任意道路拓扑，无需场景化调参，并保障轨迹无碰撞且物理可执行。

Result: 在东京、曼哈顿、罗马、博洛尼亚四个大规模真实城市地图上仿真验证：与现有SOTA方法相比，显著降低行程时间，延时可变性被严格限定，且在极高车辆密度下成功避免拥堵死锁。

Conclusion: VeloCity为任意复杂城市区域的CAVs提供了一种可扩展、高效、确定性的交通协调方案，兼具理论严格性与实证性能，具备推动下一代智能交通管理的潜力。

Abstract: As modern cities face increasingly severe traffic congestion, connected and autonomous vehicles (CAVs) have emerged as a crucial enabling technology for next-generation intelligent traffic management. However, fully realizing this potential is hindered by the limitations of current paradigms. Existing approaches typically optimize localized interactions rather than system-wide efficiency, incur severe communication overhead, or lack the deterministic guarantees required for safe kinematic execution. Furthermore, current multi-agent adaptations are frequently restricted to small predefined scenarios, failing to scale across large and complex urban networks. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces VeloCity, a decentralized multi-agent spatio-temporal mobility profile planning framework designed for CAVs operating in arbitrary urban areas. To minimize vehicles' travel times, VeloCity distributes mobility profile optimization directly to individual CAVs. Vehicles query a localized traffic coordinator for a reservation table, independently compute their fastest conflict-free mobility profile, and reserve their requested space-time slots back with the coordinator. By natively adapting to any arbitrary road topology, the framework manages highly irregular urban areas without requiring scenario-specific tuning, all while guaranteeing collision-free and physically executable vehicle trajectories. Extensive simulations across four large-scale real-world urban maps (Tokyo, Manhattan, Rome, and Bologna) demonstrate the framework's scalability. Compared to established state-of-the-art models, VeloCity yields drastically lower travel times, tightly bounds delay variance, and successfully prevents congestion gridlocks even under extremely high vehicular densities.

</details>


### [192] [AOC-CBS: Anytime-Optimal Continuous-time Conflict-Based Search for Generalised Multi-Agent Path Finding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08175)
*Alvin Combrink,Sabino Francesco Roselli,Martin Fabian*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了AOC-CBS算法，扩展了MAPF问题的假设条件，支持异构智能体、连续时间等复杂场景，在保证最优性的同时显著提升了可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统MAPF研究存在诸多限制性假设：离散时间、圆形智能体、单一目标、智能体到达目标后必须停留等，这些假设阻碍了异构车队、非几何冲突、任务序列等实际应用场景的求解。

Method: 提出了AOC-CBS（Anytime-Optimal Continuous-time Conflict-Based Search）算法，这是一个精确且完备的求解器。算法可在运行过程中持续报告当前解及其最优性差距上界，支持多种修复函数配置（包括新提出的Tier-Prioritized Safe Interval Path Planning），并能利用多核处理器进行并行计算。

Result: 在混合异构车队场景下（非凸智能体沿平滑、运动学可行轨迹移动），与现有精确求解器OC-CBS相比，AOC-CBS在寻找最优解方面性能相当，但当接受有界最优性差距时，其可扩展性从数十个智能体提升至数百个智能体。

Conclusion: AOC-CBS成功将MAPF问题推广至更通用的场景，在保持最优性保证的同时显著提升了可扩展性，为仓库、交通、机场等实际应用提供了更实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Many research fields share a common structure: a set of agents, each pursuing its own goal, whose actions must be coordinated so that no two of them conflict. Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) is a concrete instance of this structure, with applications from warehouses to road traffic and airports. Much of MAPF research assumes discrete time, circular agents sharing one spatial graph, a single goal per agent, and that an agent must remain at its goal once reached, precluding heterogeneous fleets, non-geometric conflicts, task sequences, and agents that move on after completing them. We generalise the MAPF formulation to lift these assumptions, and present Anytime-Optimal Continuous-time Conflict-Based Search (AOC-CBS), an exact and solution-complete solver for it. AOC-CBS guarantees the eventual return of an optimal solution, while reporting an incumbent with a known optimality gap upper bound throughout its runtime; it is configurable with a portfolio of repair functions, one of which we introduce (Tier-Prioritized Safe Interval Path Planning), and can exploit multiple processor cores. We demonstrate AOC-CBS on a mixed fleet of non-convex agents moving along smooth, kinodynamically feasible trajectories. Preliminary experiments against the exact solver OC-CBS, on well-known benchmarks and roadmaps we sample from them, show AOC-CBS is comparable at finding optimal solutions while extending scalability from the tens to the hundreds of agents when a bounded optimality gap is accepted.

</details>


### [193] [Fluid Structure, Rigid Record: A Layered Organizational Design Framework for Agent-Native Organizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08516)
*Lucian Zhu*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个agent原生组织结构框架，通过持久层与动态层的分离设计，实现了执行层面灵活但底层结构稳固的智能体组织架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多智能体系统(MAS)大多将组织概念简化为对话拓扑、角色提示或固定工作流，缺乏真正的组织性。作者认为一个真正的代理组织不应仅仅是赋予企业头衔的模型实例集合，而需要建立专门针对智能体特性的组织结构框架。

Method: 提出四层架构：1)持久层包含四存储记录架构和常驻专业化智能体池；2)协调层定义Permission(智能体可用的操作世界边界)和Privilege(授权发起的组织状态变更)两种机制，编译任务特定的操作世界；3)运行时层结合外部Workflow Protocol与隔离运行时存储，动态组装Task Groups；4)人机交互层通过非决策型Translation Agent中介的Control Plane暴露组织。三个正交角色组(操作、审查、监督)实现职责分离：操作者在窄范围租约内执行，审查者拥有按需激活的修改权限，监督者保持广泛观察权但有限修改权。

Result: 架构已实现原型系统并通过小样本实验验证。在大规模实证验证完成前，暂不宣称通用性能指标。核心贡献是提供了一套连贯且可证伪的框架，用于设计、治理、恢复和评估agent原生组织。

Conclusion: 所提出的架构在执行表面保持流动性，底层保持结构性：任务和事件可改变团队组成、拓扑、视图、工具和工作流，而记录、写入约束、权限边界和权力分立保持持久稳定。为agent原生组织的设计提供了理论基础和实践框架。

Abstract: An agentic organization should not be a set of model instances with corporate titles, despite most MAS still operationalizing organization as a conversational topology, a role prompt, or a fixed workflow. This paper develops an agent-native organizational structure framework that separates the persistent and dynamic layers of operations. The persistent layer consists of a four-store record architecture and a pool of resident specialization agents. A coordination layer defines Permission as the boundary of the operational world available to an agent, and Privilege as the set of organizational state changes that the agent is authorized to initiate. Together, these mechanisms compile task-specific operational worlds. A runtime layer combines an external Workflow Protocol with an isolated runtime store to dynamically assemble Task Groups. A human-interaction layer exposes the organization through a Control Plane mediated by a non-decision-making Translation Agent. Three orthogonal Role Groups further separate Operation, Review, and Supervision. Operators execute within narrowly scoped leases; reviewers receive elevated but demand-activated authority to modify organizational state; supervisors retain broad observational access while holding limited modification authority. The resulting architecture is fluid at the execution surface but structurally rigid underneath: tasks and events may alter team composition, topology, views, tools, and workflows, while records, write constraints, authority boundaries, and separation of powers remain persistent. The architecture has been implemented as a prototype and evaluated in small-sample experiments. Large-scale empirical validation remains incomplete, therefore no general performance claimed is made yet. Instead, the contribution is a coherent and falsifiable framework for designing, governing, recovering, and evaluating agent-native organizations.

</details>


### [194] [Muscle Memory for Agents: Compile not Merely Retrieve](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08995)
*Pouya Ghiasnezhad Omran,Soujanya Lanka,Qin Zhang,Tanya Dixit*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出“肌肉记忆”范式，将重复出现的用户意图编译为专用的专家代理，而非传统的检索式记忆。在90个测试场景中，该方法在专家代理触发时达到88.9%的胜率，个性化增益+2.05，准确率代价仅-0.28。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代理的记忆架构普遍采用“存储-检索-解释”模式，导致个性化服务效率低下。用户需要多次对话才能调整格式、深度和范围，以获得符合领域需求的回答，这种“多轮税”降低了用户体验。

Method: 提出四阶段管道：Harvest（挖掘对话历史）→ Analyze（分离行为模式与任务模式）→ Augment（构建可执行的编译专家代理）→ Evaluate（质量门控与两级触发匹配）。该管道将重复的用户意图编译为专用专家代理，而非依赖检索。

Result: 在5个用户人设的90个留出场景测试中，当专家代理触发时（36个案例），增强助手赢得32个案例，胜率达88.9%。个性化增益为+2.05（1-4分制），准确率代价仅为-0.28。

Conclusion: 编译范式比检索范式更适合个性化场景，特别是存在重复用户意图的工作负载。该结果拓展了记忆设计空间，但仍需解决开放问题，如编译时机的自动判断、专家代理的生命周期管理等。

Abstract: Memory for LLM agents has converged on a single architectural pattern: store experience as text, embeddings, reflections, or rules; retrieve at inference time; let a general-purpose orchestrator interpret what to do. This paper argues that the pattern is the wrong default for personalization. We position Muscle Memory - the practice of compiling recurring user intent into purpose-built specialist agents - as a distinct memory paradigm from retrieval, and we argue that compilation is a better fit for the workloads where current assistants impose a multi-turn tax on their users: making them repeatedly correct format, depth, and scope to obtain a domain-appropriate answer. We support the position with a reference implementation and empirical evidence. The implementation is a four-phase pipeline (Harvest $\rightarrow$ Analyze $\rightarrow$ Augment $\rightarrow$ Evaluate) that mines conversational history, separates behavioral from task patterns, and emits quality-gated executable compiled specialists with two-stage trigger matching. On 90 held-out scenarios across five user personas, the augmented assistant wins 32 of 36 cases where a specialist fires, an 88.9% win rate, with a +2.05 personalization gain and only a $-0.28$ accuracy cost on a 1-4 scale. We discuss why compilation is better suited than retrieval in this regime, what the result implies for the broader memory design space, and what open problems remain.

</details>


### [195] [Beyond Tier Labels: Role- and Deployment-Dependent Model Substitution in Multi-Call LLM Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09155)
*Renxiang Wang,Jiaming Cui*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文挑战了查询级路由的传统观点，证明模型替换的价值取决于其在工作流中的位置和部署环境。通过谓词-动作分解方法，揭示了模型选择并非简单的层级属性，而是需要根据具体角色和规模进行校准的部署条件化行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型路由系统普遍假设模型替换的价值是已知的，只关注"在哪里"使用更强的模型。然而，作者指出在依赖计算的多调用系统中，模型的价值实际上取决于它进入计算的位置以及周围的部署环境。这一科学问题促使研究者重新思考模型路由的决策机制。

Method: 提出谓词-动作分解方法，将"在哪里替换"与"替换的价值"两个决策分离。在跨越8-64次求解调用的受控solve-merge-verify工作流中，使用四组三层模型阶梯进行系统性评估。通过输入匹配干预、语义任务-契约转换和分配消融等多种实验设计，系统地分析不同角色和规模下的模型替换效果。

Result: 在数值频率计数任务中，全强模型配置在混合Qwen/GPT阶梯上将RMSE从4.818降至1.538，而纯Qwen排序呈现相反趋势。输入匹配干预表明，相同的中等-强模型动作在不同角色和规模下价值差异显著。语义任务转换再次逆转了混合排序，而分配消融实验区分了有用的稀疏放置与覆盖不足、无差别升级的差异。这些发现揭示了看似冲突结果背后的一致性原则。

Conclusion: 模型替换是部署条件化的行为，而非层级标签隐含的属性。研究为大规模工作流路由提供了实用序列：首先校准动作价值，然后解析其角色条件化效应，最后优化其放置位置。这一框架为多调用LLM系统的路由决策提供了新的理论基础和实践指导。

Abstract: Large multi-call LLM systems pose a scientific problem that query-level routing does not capture: the value of a model depends on where it enters a dependent computation and on the deployment that surrounds that call. Existing routers typically decide \emph{where} to spend a stronger model while treating the benefit of the substitution itself as known. We separate these two decisions through a predicate-action factorization and evaluate it in controlled solve-merge-verify workflows spanning 8-64 solve calls and four three-tier model ladders. The resulting evidence reveals a consistent principle beneath apparently conflicting outcomes. On numeric frequency counting, all-strong reduces RMSE from 4.818 to 1.538 in the Mixed Qwen/GPT ladder, whereas the average Qwen-only ordering reverses. Input-matched interventions further show that the same medium-to-strong action has sharply different value across roles and scales. A semantic task-and-contract shift reverses the Mixed ordering again, while allocation ablations distinguish useful sparse placement from under-coverage and indiscriminate escalation. Together, these results establish model substitution as a deployment-conditioned action rather than a property implied by a tier label, and they provide a practical sequence for large-scale workflow routing: calibrate the action, resolve its role-conditioned effect, and then optimize its placement.

</details>


### [196] [MoRSE: Task-Oriented Multi-Agent System with Mixture of Role-Subtask Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09251)
*Peiwen Li,Shiyang Zhang,Yangtian Zhang,Sizhuang He,David van Dijk,Rex Ying*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了MoRSE框架，通过任务结构层面的(role, subtask)分工和参数层面的动态LoRA专家混合模块，实现了大型语言模型多智能体系统的专业化分工，在代码生成任务上取得了显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大型语言模型多智能体系统主要依赖粗粒度的提示级别区分，缺乏针对不同子任务的参数自适应，导致智能体间异质性不足、专业化能力有限，在复杂任务上性能受限。

Method: 1) 构建任务导向的多智能体系统，将任务分解为依赖感知的有向无环图(DAG)子任务，为每个智能体分配特定的(role, subtask)；2) 设计动态(role, subtask) LoRA专家混合模块，配合基于原型的语义路由器实现参数级专业化；3) 提出层次化组相对策略优化算法，通过双层信用分配稳定地协同优化专家和路由器。

Result: 在三个主干模型的代码生成基准测试中，MoRSE在整体任务和分步性能上均取得提升；训练获得的专业化能力可泛化至未见过的任务类别和领域。

Conclusion: MoRSE成功实现了任务结构和参数双层面的智能体专业化分工，有效解决了多智能体系统中异质性不足的问题，为复杂任务的多智能体协作提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Large language model-based multi-agent systems have recently shown strong potential for complex, long-horizon tasks. However, existing methods mainly rely on coarse prompt-level differentiation without parameter adaptation for diverse subtasks, resulting in insufficient inter-agent heterogeneity and limited specialized capability that bottleneck performance on tasks with complex requirements. To address this, we introduce a Task-Oriented Multi-Agent System with Mixture of Role-Subtask Experts (MoRSE) that distinguishes agents with (role, subtask)-conditional specialization at both the task structure and parameter levels. To make agents' responsibility explicit at the task structure level, we formulate a task-oriented multi-agent system that decomposes each task into a dependency-aware Directed Acyclic Graph of subtasks and assigns each agent a specific (role, subtask), introducing task-level specialization across collaborating agents. Additionally, to address the diverse role and subtask parameter adaptation demands, we propose a dynamic Mixture of (role, subtask) LoRA Experts module with a prototype-based semantic router for subtasks, augmenting agents with parameter-level specialization on a shared LLM substrate cost-effectively. Then, to co-optimize experts and router stably under sparse task rewards, we further propose a hierarchical group-relative policy optimization with two-layer credit assignment that isolates expert updates from the cross-route variance introduced by routing decisions, disentangling expert quality from routing quality. Experiments on code-generation benchmarks across three backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, with improvements in both whole-task and step-wise performance, and the gains from trained specialization generalize across held-out task categories and domains.

</details>


### [197] [Distributed Team Orchestration via Supervisor Networks: Convergence, Optimality, and Resilience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09256)
*Juntian Zhu,Guanpu Chen,Tongtian Zhu,Miguel de Carvalho,Zhouwang Yang,Fengxiang He*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了分布式团队编排算法(DTOA)，用于解决存在监督者网络的零和势能团队博弈问题，在拜占庭攻击下实现了对近似团队纳什均衡的收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在零和势能团队博弈中，当智能体依赖监督者提供的信念信息而非准确公共信念时，面临信念信息不准确的核心挑战，这种不准确源于监督者的信念估计误差和拜占庭团队的联合行动误报。

Method: 提出分布式团队编排算法(DTOA)，将团队虚构博弈与基于监督者的分布式信念学习相结合；在拜占庭设置下，考虑误报攻击模型并开发拜占庭容错DTOA，实现拜占庭团队识别。

Result: 证明了监督者信念估计的收敛性，建立了学习动力学在团队纳什间隙(TNG)意义下收敛到近似团队纳什均衡的理论保证；在拜占庭设置下，给出了拜占庭团队识别的概率保证和诚实TNG的渐近界。

Conclusion: 数值实验验证了理论发现，对比了DTOA与基线学习方法的性能，并评估了其在马尔可夫决策过程设置下的表现，证明了该方法的有效性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: In this paper, we study zero-sum potential team games with a supervisor network, where agents rely on supervisor-provided belief information rather than accurate common beliefs. The main challenge is that such belief information can be inaccurate because of supervisors' belief-estimation errors and the misreporting of joint actions by Byzantine teams. We propose the distributed team-orchestrating algorithm (DTOA), which combines team fictitious play with supervisor-based distributed belief learning. We prove the convergence of supervisors' belief estimates and establish that the induced learning dynamics converge to a near team-Nash equilibrium (TNE) in terms of the team-Nash gap (TNG). In the Byzantine setting, we consider a misreporting attack model and develop a Byzantine-resilient DTOA. We further provide probabilistic guarantees for Byzantine-team identification and establish an asymptotic bound on the honest TNG. Numerical experiments illustrate the theoretical findings, compare DTOA with baseline learning methods, and evaluate its performance in a Markov decision process setting.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [198] [LGNNIC: Acceleration of Large-Scale GNN Training using SmartNICs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07733)
*Liad Gerstman,Aditya Dhakal,Dejan Milojicic,Avi Mendelson*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出LGNNIC系统，利用SmartNIC卸载预处理任务（邻居采样和量化），显著减少分布式GNN训练中的通信开销，实现高达62.4倍的训练加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着图规模的增大，单节点CPU-GPU系统难以存储和处理整个图。将图分布到多个远程内存节点虽可行，但会导致节点间网络拥塞，成为训练瓶颈。

Method: 提出LGNNIC架构，利用与远程内存节点同置的SmartNIC执行预处理任务：1）邻居采样：在SmartNIC上进行mini-batch采样；2）量化：对采样批次进行量化。设计了基于DMA的低开销同步机制和基于Socket的高开销替代方案进行对比评估。

Result: 在包含NVIDIA BlueField-2 SmartNIC和A100 GPU的PoC系统上验证，邻居采样在Socket和DOCA-DMA模式下分别实现高达62.4倍和17.5倍加速；量化额外提供高达3.6倍和1.3倍加速。主要性能提升源于数据传输时间的减少。

Conclusion: SmartNIC卸载预处理任务能有效缓解分布式GNN训练中的网络拥塞问题，显著提升训练性能，为大规模图神经网络的分布式训练提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used across domains such as natural sciences, social network analysis, chip design, and recommendation systems. However, as graph sizes grow, storing and processing them entirely on a single-node CPU-GPU system becomes increasingly impractical. A promising approach is to distribute the graph across multiple remote memory nodes, though this introduces a major bottleneck: inter-node network congestion during training. To address this, we propose LGNNIC, a novel inter-node system architecture that leverages SmartNICs co-located with remote memory nodes-a configuration already available in modern systems-to reduce communication overhead in distributed GNN training. LGNNIC offloads key preprocessing tasks to SmartNICs, reducing the volume of data transferred to computational (training) nodes and alleviating network congestion. We introduce two complementary techniques executed on the SmartNICs during the preprocessing phase: Neighbor Sampling, which performs mini-batch sampling, and Quantization of the sampled batches. To evaluate LGNNIC under different communication infrastructures, we designed both an optimized low-overhead DMA-based synchronization mechanism and a high-overhead socket-based alternative used as a benchmark. We evaluate the core SmartNIC offloading mechanisms across standard GNN workloads and sampling hyperparameters using a proof-of-concept (PoC) system comprising one remote-memory node with an NVIDIA BlueField-2 SmartNIC and one compute node with an A100 GPU. Both Neighbor Sampling and Quantization on the remote node demonstrated substantial training speedups in most configurations. Neighbor Sampling achieved up to 62.4x and 17.5x speedups with Sockets and DOCA-DMA, respectively, primarily due to reduced data transaction time. Quantization provided additional speedups of up to 3.6x and 1.3x, respectively, by reducing data transfer.

</details>


### [199] [ElastiCo: Elastic Configuration and Interference-Aware Orchestration for GPU Clusters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07971)
*Jinghao Wang,Yihang Zhou,Xiaoyang Sun,Chunming Hu,Tianyu Wo,Xu Wang,Albert Y. Zomaya,Renyu Yang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出ElastiCo框架，通过资源形状转换、弹性影子定价和干扰感知共位三种机制，实现训练与推理任务在同一GPU上的安全共享与动态调度，显著提升集群资源利用率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有调度器将训练与离线推理视为独立的资源消费者，采用静态分配，导致训练作业在空闲阶段仍预留设备、推理任务按突发需求过度配置，造成GPU资源严重浪费（利用率仅约25%）。

Method: 提出三阶段机制：(1)资源形状转换，将作业建模为资源-性能配置族；(2)弹性影子定价，通过动态影子价格将多资源分配分解为单作业配置选择；(3)干扰感知共位，利用硬件计数器与任务级特征训练预测器，评估GPU共享下的性能衰减。框架以原生Kubernetes中间件形式实现，无需修改用户代码。

Result: 在64 GPU实验平台与512 GPU大规模轨迹驱动仿真中，ElastiCo将平均作业完成时间降低最高2.94倍，集群吞吐量提升2.02倍，GPU利用率从约25%提升至46%。

Conclusion: ElastiCo通过细粒度的弹性资源分配与干扰感知调度，有效解决了训练与推理任务间的资源争用问题，为现代GPU集群的多工作负载协同调度提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Modern GPU clusters must simultaneously serve deep learning training and offline large language model inference workloads, yet existing schedulers treat these as isolated resource consumers with rigid, static allocations. This leaves substantial GPU capacity underutilized: training jobs reserve entire devices despite periodic idle phases, while offline inference tasks over-provision GPUs despite bursty demand patterns. We present ElastiCo, an elastic co-location framework that enables training and inference workloads to safely share GPUs through three integrated mechanisms. First, Resource Shape Transformation exposes each job as a family of feasible resource-performance configurations. Second, Elastic Shadow Pricing decomposes the resulting multi-resource allocation problem into per-job configuration selection subproblems via dynamic per-resource shadow prices. Third, Interference-Aware Co-location uses a predictor trained on hardware-counter and task-level features to estimate pairwise performance degradation under GPU sharing. Implemented as native Kubernetes middleware requiring no user-code modifications, ElastiCo is evaluated on a 64-GPU testbed and through large-scale trace-driven simulations (up to 512 GPUs), reducing the average JCT by up to 2.94x, increasing the cluster throughput by 2.02x, and increasing the GPU utilization from approximately 25% to 46%.

</details>


### [200] [eIRWR: Enhanced Iterative Random Walk with Restart for Scalable Root Cause Analysis in Microservices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08073)
*Saiful Khan,Afrah Farea*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出eIRWR算法，通过幂律传送锐化、自环和反向边增强转移矩阵、外循环信念细化，在阿里巴巴微服务数据集上MRR达0.75-0.94，比最佳基线提升2.8倍，运行时间<25ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于图的随机游走根因分析方法存在缺陷：异常重启游走从原始异常向量重启，该向量被下游受害节点的强信号主导，而真正源头节点的信号较弱，导致定位信号利用不足。

Method: 提出增强迭代重启随机游走(eIRWR)：(a)通过幂律传送锐化将重启质量集中于最可疑节点；(b)用自环和反向边增强转移矩阵，使概率在级联源头累积；(c)通过外循环迭代优化信念。同时证明了"韧性阻尼"在数学上等价于提高重启概率。

Result: 在阿里巴巴微服务追踪数据集的三个大规模拓扑(12K-25K节点)上：中等可见度下MRR=0.75，比最佳聚合度量基线提升2.8倍，显著优于重启调优的PPR；高可见度下MRR=0.94；在17000节点图上运行时间<25ms，适合在线部署。

Conclusion: eIRWR有效解决了现有方法中下游噪声掩盖上游微弱信号的问题，通过创新的传送策略和转移矩阵增强实现了显著的性能提升，同时保持了在线部署所需的计算效率。

Abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) in microservice architectures needs to pinpoint the originating faulty service responsible for the cascading symptoms seen across hundreds or thousands of interdependent services. Graph-based random walk methods propagate anomaly evidence over the service dependency graph. However, existing anomaly-restart walks leave much of the localization signal unused: they restart from the raw anomaly vector, which is dominated by loud downstream victims rather than the quieter source. Through a controlled ablation, we first show that the "resilience damping" often applied to the transition matrix is mathematically equivalent to raising the restart probability; we therefore benchmark against a restart-tuned Personalized PageRank (PPR) rather than its default configuration. We then present Enhanced Iterative Random Walk with Restart (eIRWR), which (a) concentrates restart mass on the most suspicious nodes through power-law teleportation sharpening, (b) augments the transition matrix with self-loops and backward edges so that probability accumulates at cascade sources, and (c) refines its belief across an outer loop. On three large-scale topologies (12K-25K nodes) from the Alibaba Microservice Trace Dataset, eIRWR attains a Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) of 0.75 at moderate root-cause visibility, a 2.8 times improvement over the best aggregate-metric baseline and well above a restart-tuned PPR. At high visibility, it reaches MRR= 0.94, while running in under 25ms on graphs with 17,000 nodes, making it suitable for online deployment.

</details>


### [201] [Effect of Abstractions and Prompting Strategies on LLM-Guided High-Performance Optimizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08085)
*Jiří Klepl,Maty'aš Brabec,Martin Kruliš*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究了在LLM辅助的并行HPC应用优化中，传统自动化优化抽象方法是否优于直接使用LLM生成优化代码，实验证明LLM直接生成C代码效果更佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统代码优化自动化方法依赖于领域特定表示、网格搜索和有限的可验证变换规则，但这些方法受限于严格的规则约束。大语言模型（LLM）具备高层代码语义理解能力，能够执行超越传统可验证优化范围的变换。因此，研究传统抽象是否有助于提升LLM辅助优化的性能和正确性具有重要意义。

Method: 以PolyBench基准测试套件为实验对象，对比两种LLM辅助优化方案：一是为LLM提供具体优化目标直接生成C代码；二是让LLM通过现有框架生成计算流水线和优化调度方案。通过测量优化后代码的性能表现和正确性来评估两种方法。

Result: 实验表明，在所评估的设置下，相较于通过现有框架创建计算流水线和优化调度，LLM在获得具体优化目标后直接生成C代码能够获得更好的实测性能表现和更高的有效性比率。

Conclusion: 传统自动化优化抽象方法并未如预期提升LLM辅助优化的效果，反而直接让LLM生成代码更为有效。这提示未来研究应探索替代性的可验证LLM辅助代码优化途径，而非简单沿用传统框架的抽象表示。

Abstract: Code performance optimization is a vital aspect of modern software development, as it enables faster response times and reduced resource usage. These optimizations require a deep understanding of low-level hardware details and the intricacies of parallel processing, making them challenging even for experienced developers. With the advent of Large Language Models (LLMs), which are increasingly capable of generating and understanding code, there is growing interest in incorporating these models into automated code optimization processes. Traditionally, this automation involves transcribing the source code into a domain-specific representation that can be auto-tuned using grid search or machine learning algorithms, while adhering to strict rules and a limited set of feasible transformations to ensure verifiability. LLMs incorporate high-level code semantics and can thus perform transformations that go beyond verifiable automated optimizations. This paper investigates whether the traditional abstractions used in automated code optimization improve the performance and correctness of LLM-guided optimizations of parallel HPC applications. We evaluate this using the PolyBench benchmark suite and demonstrate that, in our evaluated setting, LLMs provided with specific optimization goals achieve better measured performance and validity rates when generating C code compared to creating computation pipelines and optimization schedules with established frameworks, suggesting that future development should explore alternative approaches for verifiable LLM-guided code optimization.

</details>


### [202] [OasisKV: Scaling In-Decode KV Cache Beyond HBM with Lookahead Sparse Prefetching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08097)
*Can Xiao,Sukmin Cho,Junbong We,Zhixiong Niu,Jianyi Cheng,Yiren Zhao,Youngjin Kwon,Yongqiang Xiong,Rui Ma,Junyi Liu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: OasisKV通过推测解码预测关键KV条目，将稀疏注意力转化为吞吐量提升，在保持精度的同时显著降低HBM压力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型推理服务日益受限于内存而非计算。随着长上下文和长推理工作负载的普及，KV缓存在解码阶段主导了内存占用和内存流量，而HBM容量已成为稀缺且昂贵的资源，严重限制了推理批处理大小和系统吞吐量。

Method: 提出OasisKV系统，在LLM解码期间将完整KV缓存存储与HBM解耦。利用推测解码(SD)生成的前瞻词元准确预测未来重要词元，仅保留最相关词元的KV条目在HBM中用于注意力计算。采用高效的注意力后台流水线识别重要KV块，并从更高容量内存层预取到HBM中。

Result: 在2048词元KV预算下，精度损失控制在0.7个点以内。相比密集vLLM，推理工作负载吞吐量提升1.69倍（精度损失0.1点），多GPU长上下文服务提升高达2.1倍。在预填充-解码分离场景下，吞吐量约为密集方案的2倍，KV缓存减少6.5-9.7倍，解码节点主机内存占用减少2.2-2.6倍。

Conclusion: OasisKV成功将解码时的稀疏注意力转化为吞吐量增益，有效缓解了HBM容量压力，为长上下文LLM推理服务提供了一种高效的内存中心化解决方案。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference serving is increasingly constrained by memory rather than compute. As long-context and long-form reasoning workloads become more prevalent, the key-value (KV) cache dominates both memory footprint and memory traffic during LLM token generation, i.e., decode. In particular, HBM capacity has become a scarce and costly resource that heavily limits inference batch size and system throughput. This paper presents OasisKV, a memory-centric LLM inference system design that alleviates HBM capacity pressure by decoupling full KV-cache storage from HBM during LLM decoding. Because decode-time attention is naturally sparse, OasisKV keeps only the KV entries of the most relevant tokens in HBMs for attention computation. We observe that future important tokens can be predicted accurately in advance using lookahead tokens drafted by speculative decoding (SD). OasisKV employs an efficient attention background pipeline to identify important KV blocks. They are then prefetched from higher-capacity memory tiers (e.g., host or remote memory) and staged in HBMs before being used in the next decode step.
  We implement OasisKV based on vLLM. The lookahead prediction is accurate enough to keep accuracy within 0.7 points of full attention under a 2,048-token KV budget. This lets OasisKV turn sparsity into throughput gain: $1.69\times$ over dense vLLM on the reasoning workload at 0.1 points of accuracy loss, and up to $2.1\times$ on multi-GPU long-context serving. Under prefill--decode disaggregation, OasisKV reaches about $2\times$ dense throughput while admitting each request with $6.5$--$9.7\times$ less KV and holding $2.2$-$2.6$ less decode-node host memory than full KV transfer.

</details>


### [203] [Evaluating and Improving Weak Scalability Analysis of Visualization Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08166)
*Marvin Petersen,Jonas Lukasczyk,Christoph Garth*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文揭示了传统数据缩放方法在可视化算法弱可扩展性评估中的缺陷，并提出了一种在共享内存设置下缓解工作负载增长不一致的方法，以改进大规模可视化研究的评估标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可视化领域通常使用简单的数据缩放技术生成更大的数据集以进行弱可扩展性研究，但许多可视化算法的工作负载取决于输入数据复杂度或输出大小等超越输入规模的因素，导致评估结果不准确。需要揭示并解决这种评估方法的不一致性。

Method: 系统分析了多种常见数据缩放方法在不同算法和数据集上的表现，识别出缩放方法的适用性因算法和数据集而异的特性；提出了一种在共享内存环境下有效缓解各缩放方法工作负载增长不一致的技术方案。

Result: 发现不同数据缩放方法会导致可视化算法工作负载增长的显著不一致；所提方法能够有效缓解这些不一致性，使得弱可扩展性评估更加准确可靠。

Conclusion: 数据缩放方法的适用性需要针对具体算法和数据集进行考量，本研究为如何评估和报告可扩展可视化研究提供了新的见解和方法论基础，推动了该领域的讨论与标准化进程。

Abstract: Research on visualizing large-scale datasets traditionally relies on empirical evaluation of scalability, determining the effectiveness of specific computation methods, algorithmic strategies, or implementations. Weak scalability, which assesses the algorithm's performance as problem size and computing resources increase, is a valuable indicator for a method's applicability at scale. However, sufficiently large data sets with increasing size are needed for weak scalability studies. To this end, it is customary to use simple scaling techniques to increase problem size by generating larger input data sets from a base data set. Nevertheless, many visualization algorithms' workload depends on factors beyond input size, such as input data complexity or output size, leading to inaccuracies in the attributed weak scalability. In this work, we highlight different common data scaling methods on multiple algorithms and data sets, recognizing that the suitability of scaling approaches varies across algorithms and data sets. We present a method that effectively mitigates the observed inconsistencies in workload increases for the different scaling methods in a shared-memory setting. With this work, we aim to further the discussion on how to evaluate and report scalable visualization research.

</details>


### [204] [OpRAG: A Resource-Deterministic Runtime for GPU-Backed Multi-Stage RAG Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08340)
*Arup Kumar Sarker,Mills Staylor,Aymen Alsaadi,Gregor von Laszewski,Shantenu Jha,Geoffrey Fox*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: OpRAG提出了一种资源确定性的分布式运行时系统，通过优化编排层显著提升多阶段RAG系统性能，相比最佳基线提升17%以上，混合检索延迟降低59%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Agentic RAG系统中，虽然LLM解码是GPU密集型的，但周围的编排层仍通过序列化开销、碎片化调度、低效批处理和CPU-GPU流水线停顿限制端到端性能。现有框架提供灵活控制流，分布式运行时提供可扩展任务并行，但两者都没有将RAG阶段作为具有确定性执行语义的资源感知操作符。

Method: OpRAG将嵌入、检索、推理、记忆和更新建模为一等操作符，并将其降维为通信感知执行图。系统结合Arrow零拷贝数据平面、持久化工作器、有界队列、CPU分词器预取、批处理GPU嵌入以及重叠检索/生成执行等技术，围绕LLM推理减少非模型开销。

Result: 在Llama3-8B和Mistral-7B上的端到端GPU流水线实验中，OpRAG相比最近竞争者分别提升16.16%和15.66%，相比RayScalableRAG分别提升20.57%和20.71%。相比LangChain、LangGraph、CrewAI和AutoGen的最佳框架基线分别快17.77%和17.48%。在Higress式查询服务中，混合检索延迟降低59.20-59.62%，生成场景延迟降低52.48-53.55%，同时保持100% Recall@5。

Conclusion: 优化分布式编排层可以显著提升GPU支持的多阶段RAG性能，而无需修改LLM解码内核，证明了编排层优化的重要性和有效性。

Abstract: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems combine preprocessing, embedding, retrieval, memory access, context construction, generation, and vector-index updates. Although LLM decoding is GPU-bound, the surrounding orchestration layer can still limit end-to-end performance through serialization overhead, fragmented scheduling, inefficient batching, and CPU--GPU pipeline stalls. Existing frameworks provide flexible control flow, while distributed runtimes provide scalable task parallelism, but neither exposes RAG stages as resource-aware operators with deterministic execution semantics. We present OpRAG, a resource-deterministic distributed runtime for GPU-backed multi-stage RAG workflows. OpRAG models embedding, retrieval, reasoning, memory, and upsert as first-class operators and lowers them into communication-aware execution graphs. It combines an Arrow zero-copy data plane, persistent workers, bounded queues, CPU tokenizer prefetching, batched GPU embedding, and overlapped retrieval/generation execution to reduce non-model overhead around LLM inference. We evaluate OpRAG using Llama3-8B and Mistral-7B with FlashAttention~2, BF16 execution, and 32K RAG chunks. In end-to-end GPU pipeline experiments, OpRAG improves over the nearest competitor by 16.16% for Llama3-8B and 15.66% for Mistral-7B, and over RayScalableRAG by 20.57% and 20.71%, respectively. Against LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen, OpRAG is 17.77% and 17.48% faster than the best framework baseline. In Higress-style query serving, OpRAG reduces hybrid retrieval latency by 59.20--59.62% and generation-scenario latency by 52.48--53.55%, while preserving 100% Recall@5. These results show that optimizing the distributed orchestration layer can substantially improve GPU-backed multi-stage RAG without modifying the LLM decoding kernel.

</details>


### [205] [C2C-Explorer: An Exploration Framework for Chip-to-Chip Interconnect Architectures in LLM Cloud Computing Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08611)
*Jiayi Li,Di Wu,Qingxu Li,Hongxiao Zhao,Jiaqi Yang,Anjunyi Fan,Wenbin Zhang,Boqiang Wu,Shuting Liu,Shifeng Fang,Jianbo Dong,Dimin Niu,Bonan Yan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了C2C-Explorer框架，用于大语言模型多芯片架构中芯片间通信硬件的系统性设计与优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型规模扩展需要多处理器芯片架构，使得芯片间（C2C）通信的重要性日益凸显。然而，为LLM工作负载设计高效的C2C硬件架构面临三大挑战：生成真实的LLM特定C2C流量、大规模准确模拟硬件级通信、以及高效探索指数级增长的C2C设计空间。

Method: 提出C2C-Explorer自适应贝叶斯设计空间探索（DSE）框架，集成LLM工作负载驱动的流量生成器、可扩展互连模拟器（支持switch/full-mesh，最多512芯片）和指标引导评估器，构建从工作负载到硬件的优化流水线，实现真实LLM工作负载下的系统性C2C架构协同设计。

Result: 经FPGA原型验证，C2C模拟器在多种流量模式下实现2.46-8.23%的端到端时序误差。混合周期和事件模型将大规模模拟速度相比纯周期精确基线提升最高7.8倍。应用于32-XPU DeepSeek-R1-671B推理工作负载时，C2C-Explorer识别出可将有效吞吐量提升44.1%、内存减少98.4%的配置方案。

Conclusion: C2C-Explorer成功实现了LLM工作负载驱动的C2C架构协同设计优化，显著提升了设计效率并开源，为大规模LLM部署中的硬件架构设计提供了有效工具。

Abstract: The scaling-up of large language models (LLMs) necessitates computing systems to have multi-processor-chip architectures, elevating the importance of chip-to-chip (C2C) communication. However, designing efficient C2C hardware architectures for LLM workloads faces three key challenges: generating realistic LLM-specific C2C traffic, accurately simulating hardware-level communication at scale, and efficiently exploring the exponentially large C2C design space. We propose C2C-Explorer, an adaptive Bayesian DSE framework that integrates a LLM-workload-driven traffic generator, a scalable interconnect simulator (switch/full-mesh, up to 512 chips), and a metric-guided evaluator into a workload-to-hardware optimization pipeline, enabling systematic C2C architectural co-design under realistic LLM workloads. Validated against FPGA-based C2C prototypes, the C2C simulator achieves 2.46-8.23% end-to-end timing error across diverse traffic patterns. Its hybrid cycle and event model further accelerates large-scale simulation by up to 7.8$\times$ over a pure cycle-accurate baseline. Applied to a 32-XPU DeepSeek-R1-671B inference workload, C2C-Explorer identifies configurations that improve goodput by 44.1% and reduce memory by 98.4%. C2C-Explorer is open-source and available at https://github.com/Selinaee/C2C-Explorer.

</details>


### [206] [Empirical Analysis of Cloud-Edge Infrastructure Complexity: Practitioner Pain Points and Architectural Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08400)
*Pawissanutt Lertpongrujikorn,Hai Duc Nguyen,Mohsen Amini Salehi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 通过对86个组织的101次访谈进行实证分析，发现基础设施复杂性（而非性能）是分布式计算的主要障碍，提出了四个架构方向来解决验证的痛点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着云、边缘和物联网计算的普及，分布式应用获得了前所未有的机遇，但这种架构转变引入了深刻的基础设施复杂性，成为开发人员生产力和创新的重大障碍。

Method: 基于86个组织的101次半结构化访谈，对云原生开发实践、痛点和期望进行实证分析，量化验证主要运营瓶颈，并基于实证见解审视四个架构方向。

Result: 部署复杂性(38.6%)和入职困难(35.6%)是主要的运营瓶颈；开发人员优先考虑生产力(53.5%)和自动化(44.6%)而非原始性能优化；分布式计算采用的主要障碍是基础设施复杂性而非执行性能。

Conclusion: 声明式治理的跨多个范式的高级抽象提供了缓解基础设施复杂性的可行架构路径，安全、运营集成和严格的多租户隔离是生产就绪的前提条件。

Abstract: The proliferation of cloud, edge, and Internet of Things (IoT) computing has created unprecedented opportunities for distributed applications. However, this architectural shift introduces profound infrastructural complexity, acting as a significant barrier to developer productivity and innovation. In this paper, we present an empirical analysis based on 101 semi-structured interviews across 86 organizations to investigate the state of cloud-native development practices, pain points, and expectations. Our findings quantitatively validate that deployment complexity (38.6%) and onboarding difficulty (35.6%) are the dominant operational bottlenecks, while developers heavily prioritize productivity (53.5%) and automation (44.6%) over raw performance optimization. Based on these empirical insights, we examine four architectural directions that address the validated pain points: unified object abstractions (Object-as-a-Service), platform engineering via Internal Developer Platforms, declarative AI/ML serving pipelines, and lightweight edge runtimes based on WebAssembly. Furthermore, we detail the multi-stakeholder ecosystem required for adopting novel infrastructure paradigms, emphasizing that security, operational integration, and strict multi-tenant isolation are prerequisites for production readiness. Our results demonstrate that the primary barrier to distributed computing adoption is not execution performance but infrastructural complexity, and that declaratively governed, higher-level abstractions across multiple paradigms offer viable architectural paths toward alleviating it.

</details>


### [207] [FlashBoot: Sub-Second Weight Loading for Large Models at Rack Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08482)
*Issac Zhu,Hscos Zhang,Keith Jiang,Jack Li,Hugh Yin,Jason Zhao*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FlashBoot通过硬件友好的权重加载子系统，在NVL72上将单节点和机架级权重加载分别加速50倍和270倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着混合专家模型参数量和专家数量快速增长，权重加载成为弹性部署场景中的显著延迟瓶颈。现有加载器存在结构性问题：权重内存碎片化导致传输远低于链路带宽；跨节点复制受限于NCCL通信器设置耗时10-110秒；跨节点GPU克隆路径串行且扩展性差，无法有效利用硬件带宽。

Method: 提出FlashBoot系统，包含三个核心组件：(1) FabricArena：连续、可导出、跨节点可寻址的张量内存布局；(2) FlashLoad：从CPU进行单次批量、零拷贝权重传输；(3) FlashClone：通过远程映射机制从远程GPU复制已加载模型，绕过NCCL设置。系统基于SGLang框架，实现硬件与框架工作流的协同设计。

Result: 在NVL72平台上使用DeepSeek-V4-Pro和DeepSeek-V4-Flash进行实验。FlashClone远程权重内存映射耗时约10毫秒（对比NCCL的10-110秒），单次克隆持续带宽≥700 GB/s。相比现有技术，单节点权重加载加速最高50倍（从20.1秒降至0.4秒），并发机架级权重加载加速超过270倍（从87秒降至0.32秒）。

Conclusion: FlashBoot通过硬件友好的内存布局和创新的远程映射机制，有效解决了MoE模型权重加载的结构性瓶颈，显著提升了大规模GPU集群的部署效率，为快速弹性部署场景提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Flagship Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are growing fast along two axes at once: total parameter count and the number of experts. In elastic deployment scenarios, many GPUs across many nodes must become serving-ready quickly, and this growth makes weight loading a noticeable part of the latency budget. Even on NVIDIA's GB300 NVL72, today's state-of-the-art loaders leave most of that bandwidth unused. The losses are structural: (C1) weight memory is fragmented into tens of thousands of per-tensor objects, so transfers run far below link bandwidth; (C2) cross-node replication is gated by NCCL communicator setup, which costs 10-110 s before a single weight byte moves; and (C3) the existing cross-node GPU->GPU clone path is serial and scales poorly to concurrent multi-node bring-up. We present FlashBoot, a hardware-friendly, framework-workflow co-designed weight-loading subsystem built on SGLang. At its core is FabricArena, a contiguous, exportable and inter-node addressable tensor memory layout. On top of it, FlashLoad loads from CPU as a single bulk, zero-copy transfer, and FlashClone replicates a resident model from a remote GPU via a remote-mapping mechanism that removes NCCL setup. In experiments on NVL72 with DeepSeek-V4-Pro and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, FlashClone maps remote weight memory in ~10 ms (versus 10-110 s for NCCL) and sustains >=700 GB/s per clone. Against the state of the art, FlashBoot accelerates single-node weight loading by up to 50x (from 20.1 s to 0.4 s) and concurrent rack-level weight loading by >270x (from 87 s to 0.32 s). Our code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [208] [Randomized Tree-Intersection Leader Election](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08817)
*Yuval Emek,Shay Kutten,Ido Rafael,Gadi Taubenfeld*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个可调节参数的随机领袖选举算法，通过调整单一参数可以在时间复杂度和每节点消息复杂度之间实现平滑权衡，同时保持严格亚线性的总消息复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的领袖选举算法在时间和消息复杂度之间缺乏灵活性，无法适应不同网络环境（带宽受限或高带宽）的需求。作者希望设计一种可根据实际网络条件动态调整的算法，使系统设计者能够在时间效率和通信开销之间自由权衡。

Method: 采用动态截断的$\ell$叉树扩展技术，结合新颖的"静默脉冲"验证机制。通过强制扩展形成精确体积的近完全树，使节点能够安全地聚合拓扑权重而不超出亚线性消息界限。算法通过单一分支参数$\ell$实现复杂度调节。

Result: 算法在$n$节点完全图的同步CONGEST模型中实现了$O(\log_\ell \sqrt{n \log n})$的时间复杂度和$O(\ell)$的每节点消息复杂度，同时保持$O(\sqrt{n} \log^{1.5} n)$的总消息复杂度。带宽受限网络可实现$O(1)$的每节点消息复杂度，而高带宽环境可将选举压缩至$O(1)$时间单位。

Conclusion: 该算法成功提供了时间和消息复杂度之间的可调节权衡机制，使得不同网络环境都能获得优化的性能表现，证明了通过精心设计的树扩展结构和验证机制可以在保持亚线性总消息复杂度的同时实现灵活的复杂度调配。

Abstract: We present a randomized leader election algorithm for synchronous complete $n$-node graphs in the \textsf{CONGEST} model that introduces a highly tunable trade-off between time complexity and the per-node message complexity. By adjusting a single branching parameter, $\ell$, system designers can smoothly shift the algorithmic burden from execution time to per-node message complexity, all while maintaining a strictly sublinear total message complexity of $O(\sqrt{n} \log^{1.5} n)$. We achieve this by utilizing dynamically truncated $\ell$-ary tree expansions coupled with a novel ``silent pulse'' verification mechanism. By forcing the expansions to form exact-volume almost-complete trees, nodes can safely aggregate topological weights without overshooting the sublinear message bounds. Specifically, our algorithm achieves $O(\log_\ell \sqrt{n \log n})$ time (round) complexity and $O(\ell)$ per-node message complexity. This flexibility allows networks with tight bandwidth constraints to operate with a minimal $O(1)$ per-node burden, while high-bandwidth environments can collapse the election into $O(1)$ time units.

</details>


### [209] [Universal Rendezvous of Anonymous Agents with Footprints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08981)
*Bibhuti Das*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对足迹模型提出了一个通用的会合算法，证明了对所有连通图实例（有限或可数无限）存在通用会合算法，肯定回答了Das和Pelc（SPAA 2026）提出的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Das和Pelc在SPAA 2026提出了一个开放问题：在足迹模型中，是否存在一个适用于所有实例的通用会合算法。本文旨在解决这一理论问题。

Method: 提出了一种适用于足迹模型的通用会合算法。在该模型中，智能体访问未标记节点时会留下永久的且彼此相同的足迹。算法针对所有连通图（有限或可数无限）实例设计。

Result: 成功证明了对所有连通图实例存在通用会合算法，该算法能保证所有可行实例的会合。

Conclusion: 本文肯定性地回答了Das和Pelc提出的开放问题，表明足迹模型中确实存在通用会合算法。

Abstract: Deterministic rendezvous for two anonymous mobile agents starting simultaneously from two distinct nodes of an anonymous connected graph and navigating synchronously in the graph requires that they meet at some node. An instance of the rendezvous problem is the underlying graph, together with two distinct nodes that are the initial positions of the agents. Such an instance is said to be feasible if there is a deterministic algorithm guaranteeing rendezvous, possibly valid only for this instance. A rendezvous algorithm is said to be universal for a class of instances if it guarantees rendezvous for all feasible instances from this class.
  We consider the model with footprints: whenever an agent visits an unmarked node, it leaves a permanent footprint on it, and all footprints are identical. This paper aims at answering the open problem from the paper by Das and Pelc (SPAA 2026), asking whether there exists a universal rendezvous algorithm for the class of all instances in the model with footprints. We propose a universal rendezvous algorithm for the class of all instances where the underlying graph is connected (finite or countably infinite) in the model with footprints. This shows the existence of a universal algorithm for the class of all instances in the model with footprints, which is an affirmative answer to the open problem.

</details>


### [210] [A Resource-centric Analysis and Optimization of NoSQL Workloads using Distressed Resource Volume Metric](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09173)
*Gunika Verma,Aashutosh A,Pooja Srinivas,Yogesh Simmhan,Ayush Choure,Harshit Shah,Mayukh Das,Prashant Sasatte,Chetan Bansal,Abhijit Pai,Suraj Dixit,Achint Agrawal*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 论文开源了Cosmos DB的真实NoSQL工作负载，提出负载模拟框架LoadStar和新的PAM算法Orbit，在降低35%资源消耗的同时提升服务质量，已在生产环境部署，年节省上亿美元。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模托管云数据库依赖复杂的负载打包与迁移(PAM)算法来提升资源效率，但由于缺乏公开的NoSQL工作负载数据，针对云端NoSQL数据库资源优化与可靠性的大规模研究受到限制。

Method: 1) 发布开源的Cosmos DB真实NoSQL工作负载，并提出新的可靠性指标DRV；2) 开发开源策略模拟框架LoadStar，采用非参数统计模型估算真实流量模式的QoS；3) 提出Luna模型预测未来负载分布，设计Orbit PAM算法利用预测结果触发并重新平衡压力副本。

Result: 在LoadStar框架验证下，Orbit算法相比现有Cosmos DB策略和worst-fit优化基线，在更低错误率下实现更高负载交付，资源消耗降低高达35%，已在生产环境部署，潜在年节省超1亿美元。

Conclusion: 本研究通过开源真实NoSQL工作负载和模拟框架，为资源中心型NoSQL工作负载的策略验证提供了可复用的基准流程，提出的Orbit算法在实际生产中显著提升了资源效率和服务可靠性。

Abstract: Large-scale managed cloud databases leverage sophisticated load Packing and Migration (PAM) algorithms, which provide the efficiencies necessary for running these services at scale on cloud resources. Research into optimizing the resources and reliability of cloud databases at massive scales is limited by a lack of public NoSQL workloads. We address this in the context of Cosmos DB, Microsoft's flagship cloud-hosted NoSQL database. We first propose open-source NoSQL workloads from real Cosmos DB clusters, and analyze these traces to derive a novel reliability metric, Distressed Resource Volume (DRV), which captures the quality of service experienced by the end user. We then develop an open-source policy simulation framework, LoadStar, powered by a non-parametric statistical model of estimating the QoS of real traffic patterns. These form a reusable benchmark pipeline for validating policies for resource-centric NoSQL workloads. We then define a resource optimization problem for placing Cosmos DB replicas onto VM nodes, develop the Luna model for forecasting future load distributions, and the Orbit PAM algorithm that uses these forecasts to trigger and rebalance stressed replicas, to reduce tail-errors. Our experiments, validated using LoadStar for these workloads, demonstrate Orbit's benefits over the existing Cosmos DB policy and a worst-fit optimized baseline, with higher load delivered at lower error rates and up to $35\%$ reduction in resources. These have been deployed in production, with potential savings of $\$100M$s/yr while improving service reliability for millions of customers.

</details>


### [211] [Beyond Fast Contractions: Attenuation and Recovery of Matrix-Engine Speedups in High-Order Finite Elements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09175)
*Yinuo Wang,Lin Gan,Tianqi Mao,Zeyu Song,Wubing Wan,Jiayu Fu,Zekun Yin,Yuyang Jin,Xiaohui Duan,Wei Xue,Guangwen Yang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究了科学应用在矩阵引擎上性能增益不足的问题，通过优化完整算子路径将SME相对SVE的加速比从1.1倍提升至1.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代处理器提供的矩阵引擎峰值算术吞吐量远超传统SIMD，但科学应用端到端性能增益却很少达到预期。以Arm LX2 CPU上的SPECFEM3D刚度算子为研究对象，探究性能差距的根本原因。

Method: 提出分解式诊断方法，将性能损失归因于逐点计算、间接场数据移动与同步、不规则系数传递。采用显式SIMD优化逐点计算，通过场布局调整缓解间接移动与同步，利用向量分块系数流减少不规则访问开销。

Result: 孤立张量收缩时SME相对SVE的加速比为2.2倍（理论峰值4倍），完整算子仅1.1倍。优化后加速比提升至1.6倍（高阶情况），无收缩控制实验显示纯收缩优化上限为1.11-1.32倍。

Conclusion: 实现矩阵引擎性能潜力需要协同设计完整算子路径，而不仅是替换收缩内核。逐点计算、数据移动和系数访问等非收缩环节是性能瓶颈的关键来源。

Abstract: Modern processors increasingly provide matrix engines whose peak arithmetic throughput greatly exceeds conventional SIMD, but scientific applications rarely realize this advantage end to end. We examine this gap in SPECFEM3D's dominant stiffness operator on the Arm LX2 CPUs that power the flagship Lineshine supercomputer. Against a matched, high-performance SVE baseline on the same cores, SME's $4\times$ single-precision peak advantage falls to $2.2\times$ for isolated tensor contractions and $1.1\times$ for the complete operator. Our factorized diagnostic attributes the loss to pointwise computation, indirect field movement and synchronization, and irregular coefficient delivery. Explicit SIMD mitigates pointwise work, raising the full-operator speedup to $1.3\times$. Field-layout changes mitigate indirect movement and synchronization, while vector-blocked coefficient streaming reduces irregular-access costs; together they raise speedup to $1.6\times$ at high order. A contraction-free control bounds further contraction-only gains at $1.11$--$1.32\times$. Realizing matrix-engine performance therefore requires co-designing the entire operator path, not merely replacing its contraction kernel.

</details>


### [212] [UnionSparse: An Index-Efficient Sparsity Framework for Low-Bit Sparse LLM Inference on Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09291)
*Tianhao Jiang,Hang Gu,Teng Wang,Qianyu Cheng,ZhenDong Zheng,Cheng Tang,Qiyue Su,Wenqi Lou,Lei Gong,Chao Wang,Xi Li,Xuehai Zhou*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: UnionSparse框架通过IE-BME编码和LSPD内核优化低比特稀疏LLM边缘推理，在W4A4量化下相比现有方法实现1.43x-3.46x加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘LLM推理中，低比特量化与稀疏性结合时，量化缩小了权重载荷却未比例降低稀疏元数据，导致索引流量和非零元素提取成为SpMM的关键瓶颈。现有方法忽视了载荷-元数据比例对有效计算强度的影响。

Method: 提出PMR指标指导设计；开发UnionSparse框架，包含两个核心组件：(1)IE-BME：索引高效位图编码，分摊元数据开销并使稀疏遍历与片段组装对齐；(2)LSPD内核：低比特共享内存并行解码，优化小批量执行。

Result: 在W4A4量化和30%-70%稀疏度下，UnionSparse相比FlashLLM加速2.30x，相比SpInfer加速1.43x，相比CUTLASS和cuBLAS Tensor Core分别加速1.56x和3.46x。

Conclusion: 载荷提取效率应作为边缘GPU上低比特稀疏推理的首要优化目标，PMR是影响有效计算强度的关键因素。

Abstract: Edge LLM inference combines sparsity and low-bit quantization to meet device memory, latency, and power limits. Yet quantization shrinks weight payloads without proportionally reducing sparse metadata, so index traffic and nonzero extraction become critical SpMM bottlenecks. We introduce the Payload-to-Metadata Ratio (PMR) and show that improving PMR raises effective compute intensity in decoding.
  We present UnionSparse, an index-efficient framework that combines Index-Efficient Bitmap Encoding (IE-BME) with a SpMM kernel using Low-Bit Shared-Memory Parallel Decoding (LSPD). IE-BME amortizes metadata and aligns sparse traversal with fragment assembly, while LSPD improves small-batch execution. Under W4A4 quantization and 30%--70% sparsity, UnionSparse outperforms FlashLLM and SpInfer by 2.30x and 1.43x, and CUTLASS and cuBLAS Tensor Core by 1.56x and 3.46x, respectively. These results establish payload-extraction efficiency as a first-order concern for low-bit sparse inference on edge GPUs. Source code is available at: https://github.com/Victor-Alen/UnionSparse.

</details>


### [213] [Beyond the Limits: Flexible and Congestion-Aware Cluster Scheduling for the Cloud](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09308)
*Oliver Larsson,Thijs Metsch,Cristian Klein,Erik Elmroth*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出软SLO限制和资源感知调度策略，解决云环境中资源利用率低和共享资源拥塞问题，分别减少49%的重新调度操作和8%的节点级拥塞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有云环境工作负载调度方法存在两个关键局限：一是对服务等级目标(SLO)的过度严格执行导致资源利用率低下和能效不佳；二是缺乏对末级缓存(LLC)和内存带宽等共享资源拥塞的感知能力，忽视了应用级性能目标和硬件资源竞争。

Method: 提出两种互补策略：(i)引入软SLO限制，允许受控的超额使用并容忍轻微瞬态违规，以提高集群效率；(ii)基于末级缓存(LLC)和内存带宽等共享资源的实时拥塞洞察，实施资源感知的调度和重新调度机制。

Result: 软SLO限制相比硬限制方法减少了49%的纠正性重新调度操作，同时保持了可接受的性能保证；资源感知调度降低了8%的节点级拥塞，进一步缓解了SLO违规问题。

Conclusion: 将应用级灵活性和硬件级洞察融入调度和重新调度决策中具有显著效果，能够在维持性能保证的同时提升资源利用效率和降低拥塞，为云环境下的智能调度提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Workload scheduling in cloud environments often relies on simplistic assumptions about application resource needs and hardware utilization. Overlooking application-level performance objectives and hardware resource contention that leads to inefficient resource usage and degraded performance. This paper addresses two key limitations of current approaches. First, unnecessarily strict enforcement of service level objectives (SLOs) often leads to resource underutilization and poor energy efficiency. Second, lack of congestion awareness in shared resources such as last-level cache (LLC) and memory bandwidth. In this paper, we propose two complementary strategies to address these limitations: (i) integrating soft SLO limits that allow controlled overcommitment and tolerate minor, transient violations to improve cluster efficiency, and (ii) introducing resource-aware scheduling and rescheduling based on real-time congestion insights for shared resources such as last-level cache (LLC) and memory bandwidth. Our results show that soft SLO limits reduce corrective rescheduling actions by 49% compared to hard-limit approaches while maintaining acceptable performance guarantees. Additionally, resource-aware scheduling decreases node-level congestion by 8% and further mitigates SLO violations, demonstrating the effectiveness of incorporating application-level flexibility and hardware-level insights into scheduling and rescheduling decisions.

</details>


### [214] [How Accurately Can the Energy Use of Spark Applications Be Estimated Based on Resource Utilisation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09359)
*Youssef Moawad,Kathleen West,Vasilis Bountris,Philipp Thamm,Yehia Elkhatib,Lauritz Thamsen*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本研究在Apache Spark on Kubernetes环境中对比了模型估算与Intel RAPL实测能耗，发现外部监控可将CPU封装能耗低估误差从-29.58%降至-24.41%（AWS）和从-24.00%降至-16.22%（本地）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式批处理应用广泛运行于云端，但用户无法访问节点级硬件能耗计数器，阻碍了透明的可持续性核算。基于模型的能耗估算方法缺乏准确性验证。

Method: 以Apache Spark on Kubernetes为案例，在AWS裸机云和本地集群上，对比模型估算能耗与Intel RAPL封装及DRAM实测能耗，评估不同CPU使用信号和内存系数。

Result: 相比Spark任务追踪，外部监控使封装能耗估算的系统性低估误差降低：AWS从-29.58%改善至-24.41%，本地从-24.00%改善至-16.22%。

Conclusion: 外部监控相比任务级追踪能提升能耗估算准确性，但模型估算仍存在系统性低估，需持续优化以支持云环境的可持续性核算。

Abstract: Distributed batch data processing applications are widely executed on cloud-based resources where restricted user access to node-level hardware energy counters hinders transparent sustainability accounting. Energy and carbon attribution methodologies therefore depend on power models and available resource utilisation traces, yet the accuracy of these estimates has to be validated while direct counters are available. In this work, we use Apache Spark running on Kubernetes as a case-study dataflow runtime and cluster resource manager to compare model-based energy estimates to Intel RAPL package and DRAM energy on an AWS bare-metal cloud and an on-premises cluster, comparing different CPU usage signals and memory coefficients. We show that external monitoring improves signed package-energy error relative to Spark task traces, reducing underestimation from -29.58% to -24.41% on AWS and from -24.00% to -16.22% on-premises.

</details>


### [215] [$\tilde{\text{O}}$ptimal Distributed Maximum Flow Approximation in Undirected Planar Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09500)
*Yaseen Abd-Elhaleem,Michal Dory,Oren Weimann*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个针对一般无向平面图的分布式近最优最大st-流近似算法，在Õ(D)轮次内实现(1-o(1))-近似，解决了源点s和汇点t必须位于同一面的限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对平面图最大st-流问题的分布式近似算法存在重要限制：仅适用于源点s和汇点t位于同一面的特殊情况，且需要D·n^{o(1)}轮次。对于一般无向平面图的近最优分布式近似算法仍然缺失。

Method: 核心方法是经典Reif集中式算法的分布式实现。通过对平面图G的平面对偶图G*进行递归切割过程，在输入图G上进行通信的同时，模拟对偶图G*上的动态变化（切割操作）。

Result: 成功设计了首个针对一般无向平面图的分布式近最优最大st-流近似算法，轮次复杂度为Õ(D)，近似比为(1-o(1))，消除了源汇点必须位于同一面的限制以及n^{o(1)}因子。

Conclusion: 本研究填补了平面图分布式优化算法领域的重要空白，将最大st-流问题的分布式近似算法推广至一般无向平面图，达到了与单源最短路径问题相匹配的近最优轮次复杂度界限。

Abstract: Persistent efforts in recent years have been devoted to devising distributed algorithms for fundamental optimization problems in planar graphs. In particular, for Single-Source Shortest-Paths, there is an $\tilde O(D^2)$-rounds exact algorithm [Li, Parter STOC'19] for directed planar graphs, and an $\tilde {O}(D)$-rounds $(1+o(1))$-approximation algorithm [Rozhon, Grunau, Haeupler, Zuzic, Li STOC'22] for undirected planar graphs (where $D$ is the graph's hop-diameter). Recently [Abd-Elhaleem, Dory, Parter, Weimann PODC'25], a matching bound for the exact case was obtained for the Maximum $st$-Flow problem. Namely, an $\tilde O(D^2)$-rounds exact algorithm for directed planar graphs. However, for the approximate case, they give a $D\cdot n^{o(1)}$-rounds $(1-o(1))$-approximation algorithm for undirected planar graphs that works only for the special case where both $s$ and $t$ lie on the same face.
  In this paper, we remove the restriction that both $s$ and $t$ must lie on the same face (we also eliminate the $n^{o(1)}$ factor). Namely, we present the first distributed near-optimal $\tilde{O}(D)$-rounds $(1-o(1))$-approximation algorithm for Maximum $st$-Flow in general undirected planar graphs. Our main technical contribution is a distributed implementation of the classical Reif's [SICOMP'83] centralized algorithm. This is achieved by a careful recursive incision procedure on the planar dual $G^*$ of the graph $G$. It is challenging, because we need to simulate dynamic changes (incisions) over the dual graph $G^*$, while we can only communicate over the input graph $G$.

</details>


### [216] [A Preliminary Study on Simultaneous Coscheduling for Discrete GPU vs. Fused GPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09647)
*Poorna Gunathilaka,Nabayan Chaudhury,Kirshanthan Sundararajah,Wu-chun Feng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本研究评估了NVIDIA GH200 Superchip与独立H100 PCIe平台在CPU-GPU协同调度方面的性能差异。结果显示，GH200使混合CPU-GPU工作分配更具竞争力，并使托管内存变得实用，证明了集成CPU-GPU平台能同时提升性能和可编程性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CPU-GPU协同调度可实现应用在两种处理单元上的同时执行，但其效率依赖于工作负载划分和内存架构。随着集成CPU-GPU平台（如NVIDIA GH200 Superchip）的出现，有必要评估其相比传统离散GPU平台在协同调度场景下的性能和可编程性优势。

Method: 以稀疏共轭梯度（CG）算法为案例研究，在NVIDIA GH200 Superchip和H100 PCIe两个平台上评估不同的工作划分策略。采用三种内存管理范式进行对比：显式拷贝、托管内存和映射内存，以分析减少手动CPU-GPU数据移动的运行时和可编程性权衡。

Result: 与H100 PCIe平台相比，GH200使多种混合CPU-GPU工作分配方案具有竞争力，并使托管内存对多个矩阵变得实用。这表明集成CPU-GPU平台如GH200能够有效改善协同调度工作负载的性能表现和编程便利性。

Conclusion: 集成CPU-GPU平台（如GH200 Superchip）能够同时提升协同调度工作负载的性能和可编程性。该架构通过统一的内存系统消除了传统离散GPU平台的数据传输瓶颈，为混合CPU-GPU工作负载分配提供了更优的解决方案。

Abstract: CPU-GPU coscheduling enables simultaneous execution of an application across both processing units, but its efficiency depends on workload partitioning and memory architecture. This preliminary study evaluates coscheduling on the NVIDIA GH200 Superchip compared to a discrete H100 PCIe platform. Using sparse conjugate gradient (CG) as a case study, we assess various work divisions across three memory-management paradigms: explicit copy, managed memory, and mapped memory. Our evaluation highlights the run time and programmability tradeoffs of reducing manual CPU-GPU data movement. The results show that compared with the H100 PCIe platform, GH200 makes several hybrid CPU-GPU work divisions competitive and makes managed memory practical for several matrices. These results suggest that integrated CPU-GPU platforms such as GH200 can improve both performance and programmability for coscheduled workloads.

</details>


### [217] [SpSYRK: Half the Work in Distributed Sparse Matrix Multiplication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09713)
*Thomas McFarland,Julian Bellavita,Giulia Guidi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: The symmetric rank-$k$ update (SYRK), $\C = \A\A^\top$, computes the dot product between each pair of rows of $\A$, producing the Gram matrix $\C$. Its sparse variant underpins similarity search in machine learning, graph analytics, and genomics, including Jaccard similarity on datasets too large for a single node. Yet, despite the symmetry in its inputs and outputs, existing distributed sparse matrix multiplication algorithms, such as Sparse SUMMA, treat sparse SYRK as generic multiplication, leaving performance untapped.
  In this paper, we present distributed sparse SYRK approaches that leverage symmetry. The approach partitions the off-diagonal blocks of the output between the upper and lower triangular portions of the process grid and computes only the lower-triangular part of each diagonal block, reducing per-process communication and computation compared with state-of-the-art distributed SpGEMM. A second variant reorders communication to avoid materializing $\A^\top$.
  On 32 nodes of the Perlmutter supercomputer, the algorithm achieves a $2\times$ speedup over an optimized Sparse SUMMA on matrices where local multiplication dominates the runtime; the advantage narrows on communication-bound inputs, a dependence the cost model predicts from the arithmetic intensity. Our variant rectifies this and consistently achieves superior scaling at high process counts. The approach is a drop-in replacement for any application computing $\C = \A \A^\top$ via a distributed SpGEMM routine, and its triangular output can be consumed directly by subsequent operations, reducing both compute and memory footprint.

</details>


### [218] [Defining Decentralization: An Ontological Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09748)
*Jakub Kacper Szeląg,Aydin Abadi,Mohammad Naseri*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对计算机通信系统中去中心化定义模糊的问题，提出了基于图论的去中心化本体论框架，并引入Void Tolerance和Imperviousness两个新度量指标，为异构系统的去中心化分析提供了领域无关的基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化概念在计算机科学中已存在半个多世纪，但在计算机通信系统中缺乏普遍接受的定义。随着去中心化AI和机器学习范式的兴起，现有方法常将去中心化与信任分布或特定实现范式混淆，导致系统分析不一致、工作间可比性受限、通信架构和协议设计的形式推理严谨性减弱。作者将此研究空白定义为"去中心化问题"。

Method: 作者从形式语义学、认识论和实用主义三个维度分析去中心化的基础，提出了基于图论的本体论框架，将去中心化定义为计算机通信系统的关系性和主体特异性属性。该框架形式化区分了去中心化与分布，并引入两个新的度量指标：Void Tolerance（空白容忍度）和Imperviousness（不可穿透性）。同时开发了基于浏览器的实现工具，支持任意系统的自动分类和度量计算。

Result: 将所提框架应用于联邦学习和区块链架构的分析表明，该方法能够产生一致且可比较的评估结果，而现有定义往往产生不完整或矛盾的结论。基于浏览器的实现工具实现了对任意系统的自动分类和度量计算。

Conclusion: 本研究为异构系统中去中心化的分析提供了领域无关的基础，形式化区分了去中心化与分布概念，解决了现有定义模糊导致的分析不一致问题，为去中心化系统的研究和设计提供了统一的理论框架。

Abstract: Decentralization as a concept in computer science has existed for over half a century. Despite its fundamental role across domains such as security, distributed computing, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructures, and Internet of Things (IoT) architectures, there remains no universally accepted definition of decentralization applicable across computer communication systems. This has become increasingly problematic with the emergence of decentralized AI and machine learning paradigms, including collaborative training, distributed inference, blockchain-based, and agentic AI, where decentralization is often treated as a core design objective. Meanwhile, existing approaches frequently conflate decentralization with related notions such as distribution of trust or specific implementation paradigms. Such ambiguity creates inconsistencies in system analysis, limits comparability between works, and weakens the rigor of formal reasoning surrounding communication architectures and protocol design. In this work, we define this research gap as the Decentralization Problem.
  We analyze the formal-semantic, epistemological, and pragmatic foundations of decentralization and introduce a graph-based ontology defining it as both relational and subject-specific property of computer communication systems. The framework formally distinguishes decentralization from distribution and supports evaluation through two novel metrics: Void Tolerance and Imperviousness. We also provide a browser-based implementation that enables automated classification and metric computation of arbitrary systems. Instantiations to federated learning and blockchain architectures show consistent, comparable assessments where existing definitions produce incomplete or contradictory conclusions, providing a domain-independent foundation for analysing decentralization across heterogeneous systems.

</details>

### [219] [HINT: Toward an Executable Hardware-Intent Representation Layer for LLM-Driven RTL Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07625)
*Tairan Cheng,Yi Liu,Dongsheng Zuo,Zhengyuan Shi,Hongji Zhang,Xiangfei Hu,Maoshuo He,Hao Yan,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出了HINT中间表示层来改进LLM生成RTL的质量，在7个算子案例中成功率100%，相比手工RTL和直接生成方法面积减少5.0%-86.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用大语言模型(LLM)直接生成可实现的RTL代码存在困难，因为直接生成需要同时解决微架构设计问题并生成和调试底层代码，这是一个复杂的多任务过程。

Method: 提出HINT，这是一种可执行的硬件意图中间表示层，位于行为规范（或可执行预言机）与RTL之间。HINT明确表达RTL相关的微架构，支持RTL前检查，并提供明确的RTL降低义务。通过最小单代理流程和完整分阶段工作流程进行评估。

Result: 在7个算子案例中，HINT中介路径100%(7/7)生成符合合约的可综合RTL；直接C2RTL和C2HLSC仅适用于5个案例，成功率分别为5/5和1/5。在相同Design Compiler综合条件下，HINT相比5个手工RTL实现面积减少5.0%-26.2%，相比5个直接C2RTL结果面积减少8.9%-86.1%。RealBench AES、SDC和Vortex VPU(561.67k μm²)进一步验证了规范驱动、协议丰富、内存丰富和层次化设计的能力。

Conclusion: HINT中介路径在受控算子研究中表现出更好的收敛性，避免了直接生成方法中出现的严重实现质量下降问题，证明了中间表示层对改进LLM生成RTL质量的有效性。

Abstract: Generating implementation-quality RTL with large language models (LLMs) remains difficult because direct generation must resolve microarchitecture while simultaneously producing and debugging low-level code. We present HINT, an executable hardware-intent intermediate representation layer between behavioral specifications or executable oracles and RTL. HINT makes RTL-relevant microarchitecture explicit, supports pre-RTL checking, and supplies explicit RTL-lowering obligations. We evaluate HINT using both a minimal single-agent flow and a full staged workflow. Across seven operator cases, the HINT-mediated route, with no post-synthesis QoR refinement, produces contract-compliant synthesizable RTL on 7/7 cases; Direct C2RTL and C2HLSC apply to five cases and succeed on 5/5 and 1/5, respectively. Under matched Design Compiler synthesis, HINT reduces area by 5.0\%--26.2\% relative to five manual RTL implementations and by 8.9\%--86.1\% relative to five accepted Direct C2RTL results. RealBench AES and SDC, together with a Vortex VPU synthesizing to 561.67k~$μ\mathrm{m}^2$, further demonstrate specification-driven, protocol-rich, memory-rich, and hierarchical designs. In the controlled operator study, the HINT-mediated route shows better observed convergence and avoids the severe implementation-quality degradation seen in several direct-generation results.

</details>


### [220] [Hybrid ASIC-FPAA Fabric for Performance Security Trade-off](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07896)
*Ziyi Chen,Vaibhav Venugopal Rao,Kyle Juretus,Ioannis Savidis*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出ASIC-FPAA混合架构，通过可编程晶体管对和伪晶体管对技术实现模拟电路拓扑混淆，在性能-安全权衡中取得平衡，安全性能提升5倍而ENOB损失小于0.25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟电路面临知识产权被盗用和逆向工程的安全威胁，但现有安全保护措施往往导致电路性能显著下降，存在性能-安全权衡的固有难题。

Method: 提出ASIC-FPAA混合架构：开发可编程晶体管对(TP)在晶体管对阵列中混淆电路拓扑；利用伪晶体管对进一步掩盖有源晶体管数量；开发算法识别并映射适合混淆的子模块；整个电路拓扑可编程到FPAA上实现最高安全等级。

Result: 在delta-sigma调制器案例中，比较器模块在FPAA上实现混淆，ENOB降低小于0.25%，功耗增加28.1%；经最新攻击方法评估，所提技术在不影响性能前提下安全指标提升5倍。

Conclusion: ASIC-FPAA混合架构有效解决了模拟电路的性能-安全权衡问题，通过晶体管对层面的拓扑混淆技术，在保持电路性能的同时显著提升了安全鲁棒性。

Abstract: In this paper, a hybrid architecture that combines an application specific integrated circuit (ASIC) and a field-programmable analog array (ASIC-FPAA) is proposed to address the performance-security trade-off in analog circuits. A programmable transistor pair (TP) is developed that obfuscates the topology of an analog circuit within an array of transistor pairs while minimizing the degradation in circuit performance due to the implemented security features. In addition, a technique that utilizes dummy transistor pairs is proposed that further masks the topology of a circuit by obfuscating the number of active transistors that comprise the target analog circuit. A method to obfuscate the entire topology of an analog circuit is also developed. The FPAA provides the highest-level of security robustness as the entire circuit topology is programmed onto the transistor pair array, while trading-off performance. For large analog circuits requiring multiple configurable analog blocks (CABs), an algorithm is developed that identifies and maps the sub-blocks of the circuit best suited for obfuscation on the FPAA fabric, while accounting for the trade-off between performance and security. For the delta-sigma modulator, the comparator module is selected for implementation on the FPAA fabric, which results in a reduction of less than 0.25% in the effective number of bits (ENOB) and an increase of 28.1% in the power consumption as compared to an unobfuscated delta-sigma modulator. The security robustness of the proposed techniques are evaluated against the latest attack methodologies. Results indicate that the proposed techniques provide a 5x improvement in security as measured by a developed metric without compromising performance.

</details>


### [221] [ARMOR: Accelerating RTL Simulation by Mitigating the Front-End Bottleneck Using Node Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08462)
*Jiaping Tang,Jianan Mu,Zhiteng Chao,Jingzhong Wen,Jing Ye,Huawei Li*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: ARMOR通过节点压缩技术缓解RTL模拟器的前端瓶颈，利用位级数据并行实现单指令序列服务多节点，在CPU设计上获得1.6倍加速，在AI加速器上获得2.7倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高性能RTL模拟器对RTL图的每个节点单独降低为指令序列，虽能实现激进的编译器优化，但导致代码占用空间剧增，严重超出指令缓存容量并造成前端瓶颈。分析表明超过50%的流水线停顿由CPU前端引起，成为现代RTL模拟器的关键性能瓶颈。如何在保持完全展开RTL图优化优势的同时减少代码占用空间以缓解前端瓶颈，仍是巨大挑战。

Method: 提出ARMOR模拟器，采用节点压缩技术：1）模块感知同构子图识别方法，利用模块实例间的结构同构性系统识别子图级压缩机会；2）对齐感知密集打包策略，根据数据流依赖关系将节点分组并保持数据复用，配合贪婪合并策略提升位空间利用率；3）统一位级并行方案支持压缩节点的位级并行执行。核心思想是利用展开RTL图暴露的数据并行性和逐节点降低揭示的位空间利用率不足，通过位级数据并行同时压缩多个节点，使单指令序列服务多个节点。

Result: 实验结果表明，ARMOR在CPU设计上实现1.6倍加速，在AI加速器上实现2.7倍加速，相比最先进的模拟器具有显著性能提升。

Conclusion: ARMOR成功通过节点压缩技术缓解了RTL模拟器的前端瓶颈问题，在保持优化效益的同时有效降低了代码占用空间，为高性能RTL模拟提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: RTL simulation is indispensable in chip design. High-performance simulators typically lower each node in the RTL graph into an instruction sequence. Although this per-node lowering enables aggressive compiler optimizations, it dramatically increases the code footprint, severely exceeding instruction cache capacity and causing front-end bottlenecks. Our profiling reveals that over 50% of pipeline stalls are caused by the CPU front-end, becoming a key performance bottleneck in state-of-the-art RTL simulators. However, reaping the optimization benefits of fully unrolling the RTL graph while simultaneously reducing the code footprint to mitigate front-end bottlenecks remains highly challenging. In this paper, we propose ARMOR, an efficient RTL simulator designed to alleviate the front-end bottleneck through node compression. The key idea is to exploit the data parallelism exposed by the unrolling RTL graph and the insufficient bit-space utilization revealed by per-node lowering, leveraging bit-level data parallelism to compress multiple nodes simultaneously, so that a single instruction sequence can serve multiple nodes instead of one per node. To achieve profitable node compression, we first propose a module-aware isomorphic subgraph identification method that leverages structural isomorphism across module instances to systematically identify compression opportunities at the subgraph level. We then propose an alignment-aware dense packing strategy that groups nodes into packs according to dataflow dependencies while preserving data reuse, complemented by greedy merging strategies to enhance bit-space utilization. Finally, we implement a unified bit-level parallelism scheme to support bit-level parallel execution of compressed nodes. Experimental results show that ARMOR achieves 1.6x speedup on CPU designs and 2.7x speedup on AI accelerators compared to state-of-the-art simulators.

</details>


### [222] [ReVolt: Power Delivery Network-Aware Voltage Droop Control for 2.5D PIM Chiplet Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08496)
*Vibhanshu Sharma,Alish Kanani,Miao Sun,Janardhan Rao Doppa,Umit Y. Ogras,Partha Pratim Pande*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出ReVolt框架，通过LSTM预测和动态调整运算单元大小来缓解PIM多芯片系统中的电压骤降问题，在保持ML模型精度的同时实现了76倍的能效提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于PIM的2.5D多芯片平台在执行机器学习工作负载时，由于芯片级电流需求变化导致时空分布的电压骤降，引发电压违规、降低系统性能并影响推理精度。现有方法无法有效应对这一挑战。
